Nadhir Benbouali.summary: Ahmed Nadhir Benbouali (Arabic: أحمد نذير بن بوعلي; born 17 April 2000) is an Algerian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Nemzeti Bajnokság I club Győr and the Algeria national team.
Nadhir Benbouali.note: Benbouali's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Watch how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Away from that moment, he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Nadhir Benbouali.noteZh: 看Nadhir Benbouali的作用，关键是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Nathan Saliba.name: Nathan Saliba
Nathan Saliba.summary: Nathan-Dylan Saliba (born February 7, 2004) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays for Belgian Pro League club Anderlecht and the Canada national team.
Nathan Saliba.note: For Saliba, the foundation is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Look first at how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate point is how he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Nathan Saliba.noteZh: Nathan Saliba的优势在于选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。最直接的表现是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个值得观察的细节是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Nathaniel Brown.name: Nathaniel Brown
Nathaniel Brown.summary: Nathaniel Christopher Brown (born 16 June 2003) is a German professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt and the Germany national team.
Nathaniel Brown.note: Brown's signature is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. Watch how he turns early and closes the runner before the box. For a wider read, also watch whether he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Nathaniel Brown.noteZh: Nathaniel Brown的优势在于防线暴露后的回追速度。最直接的表现是他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。想看得更完整，还要观察他是否会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Nestory Irankunda.name: Nestory Irankunda
Nestory Irankunda.summary: Nestory Irankunda (/nɛstəriː ɪrəŋkʊndɑ/ NEST-ər-EE ir-əng-KUN-da; Kirundi: [iɾaŋkunda]; born 9 February 2006) is a professional soccer player who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Watford. Born in Tanzania, he plays for the Australia national team.
Nestory Irankunda.note: For Irankunda, the foundation is explosive speed once open grass appears. Look first at how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Also watch how he uses a clean first touch to open a shooting lane from distance.
Nestory Irankunda.noteZh: 看到空当后的爆发速度是理解Nestory Irankunda踢法的关键。先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。到了另一个比赛环节，他会用干净的第一脚触球打开远射线路。

Neymar.name: Neymar
Neymar.summary: Neymar da Silva Santos Júnior (Brazilian Portuguese pronunciation: [nejˈmaʁ dɐ ˈsiwvɐ ˈsɐ̃tuz ˈʒuni.oʁ] ; born 5 February 1992), simply known as Neymar Júnior (shortened to Neymar Jr) or mononymously as Neymar, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays...
Neymar.note: Watch Neymar for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. The clearest example is how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. A separate clue is how Neymar shapes toward one option before releasing the ball into another lane.
Neymar.noteZh: 看Neymar的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会身体先朝向一个选项，再把球送入另一条线路。

Nico Schlotterbeck.name: Nico Schlotterbeck
Nico Schlotterbeck.summary: Nico Cédric Schlotterbeck (German pronunciation: [ˈniːko ˈʃlɔtɐˌbɛk]; born 1 December 1999) is a German professional footballer who plays primarily as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Borussia Dortmund and the Germany national team.
Nico Schlotterbeck.note: For Schlotterbeck, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Beyond the first action, he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Nico Schlotterbeck.noteZh: 最能体现Nico Schlotterbeck特点的是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。这一点直接体现在他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，他也会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Nico Williams.name: Nico Williams
Nico Williams.summary: Nicholas Williams Arthuer (born 12 July 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a winger for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao and the Spain national team. He is recognised for his speed and dribbling skills.
Nico Williams.note: The key to Williams is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. One more thing to notice is how Williams pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Nico Williams.noteZh: 看到空当后的爆发速度是理解Nico Williams踢法的关键。先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。到了另一个比赛环节，他会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Nicolas Jackson.name: Nicolas Jackson
Nicolas Jackson.summary: Nicolas Jackson (born 20 June 2001) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a striker and winger for Premier League club Chelsea, and the Senegal national team.
Nicolas Jackson.note: The key to Jackson is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. There is another side to his game: he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Nicolas Jackson.noteZh: Nicolas Jackson的优势在于防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。最直接的表现是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Noah Sadiki.name: Noah Sadiki
Noah Sadiki.summary: Noah Junior Sadiki (born 17 December 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Premier League club Sunderland. Born in Belgium, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Noah Sadiki.note: For Sadiki, the foundation is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Look first at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Also watch how he changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Noah Sadiki.noteZh: Noah Sadiki的比赛建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定之上。首先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。另一个方面是他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Noor Al-Rawabdeh.name: Noor Al-Rawabdeh
Noor Al-Rawabdeh.summary: Noor Al-Deen Mahmoud Ali Al-Rawabdeh (Arabic: نُور الدِّيْن مَحمُود عَلِيّ الرَّوَّابدَة; born 24 February 1997) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Malaysia Super League club Selangor and the Jordan national team.
Noor Al-Rawabdeh.note: Al-Rawabdeh's signature is organizing the nearby unit before the next phase begins. Watch how he uses short cues to keep nearby passing and pressing options connected. Separately, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Noor Al-Rawabdeh.noteZh: Noor Al-Rawabdeh的优势在于下一阶段开始前组织身边队友。最直接的表现是他会用简短提醒让附近的传球与逼抢选择保持连接。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Nuno Mendes.name: Nuno Mendes
Nuno Mendes.summary: Nuno Alexandre Tavares Mendes (Portuguese pronunciation: [ˈnunu ˈmẽdɨʃ]; born 19 June 2002) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Portugal national team.
Nuno Mendes.note: What separates Mendes is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. Mendes turns early and closes the runner before the box. A separate detail appears when he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Nuno Mendes.noteZh: 观察Nuno Mendes时，可以先看防线暴露后的回追速度。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。另一个比赛细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Omar Marmoush.name: Omar Marmoush
Omar Marmoush.summary: Omar Khaled Mohamed Abdelsalam Marmoush (Egyptian Arabic: عمر خالد محمد عبد السلام مرموش; born 7 February 1999) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Manchester City and the Egypt national team.
Omar Marmoush.note: Marmoush stands out for making defenders respect the shot from outside the box. He uses a clean first touch to open a shooting lane from distance. Marmoush also changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Omar Marmoush.noteZh: 理解Omar Marmoush，要先看让防守者必须提防禁区外远射。他会用干净的第一脚触球打开远射线路。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Omar Rekik.name: Omar Rekik
Omar Rekik.summary: Omar Rekik (Arabic: عمر رقيق; born 20 December 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Slovenian PrvaLiga club Maribor. Born in the Netherlands, he represents the Tunisia national team.
Omar Rekik.note: Watch Rekik for dealing with aerial balls in his defensive area. The clearest example is how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle. A separate question is whether Rekik waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Omar Rekik.noteZh: Omar Rekik的优势在于处理防守区域内的高空球。最直接的表现是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。想看得更完整，还要观察他是否会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Ousmane Dembele.name: Ousmane Dembele
Ousmane Dembele.summary: Masour Ousmane Dembélé (French pronunciation: [us.man dɛm.be.le]; born 15 May 1997) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward or right winger for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the France national team.
Ousmane Dembele.note: Watch Dembélé for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. The clearest example is how he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. In a different phase, Dembélé draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Ousmane Dembele.noteZh: 理解Ousmane Dembélé，要先看防线重组前制造干净射门。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Patrik Schick.name: Patrik Schick
Patrik Schick.summary: Patrik Schick (born 24 January 1996) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the Czech Republic national team.
Patrik Schick.note: For Schick, the foundation is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Look first at how he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. Also watch how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Patrik Schick.noteZh: 防线重组前制造干净射门是理解Patrik Schick踢法的关键。先看他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。到了另一个比赛环节，他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Pedri.name: Pedri
Pedri.summary: Pedro González López (born 25 November 2002), more commonly known as Pedri, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team. Pedri is considered one of the best midfielders in the world.
Pedri.note: Pedri's signature is receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. Watch how he opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. Another detail is how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Pedri.noteZh: 观察Pedri时，可以先看狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。他会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。另一个比赛细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Petar Musa.name: Petar Musa
Petar Musa.summary: Petar Musa (Croatian pronunciation: [pětar mûsa]; born 4 March 1998) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas and the Croatia national team.
Petar Musa.note: Musa's signature is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Watch how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Another detail is how he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Petar Musa.noteZh: Petar Musa的比赛建立在等防守者注意力转移后再启动之上。首先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个方面是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Piero Hincapie.name: Piero Hincapie
Piero Hincapie.summary: Piero Martín Hincapié Reyna (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈpjeɾo iŋkaˈpje]; born 9 January 2002) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Arsenal, on loan from Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen, and the...
Piero Hincapie.note: The key to Hincapié is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. A separate part of his game is how Hincapié changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Piero Hincapie.noteZh: 理解Piero Hincapié，要先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Rafael Leao.name: Rafael Leao
Rafael Leao.summary: Rafael "Rafa" Alexandre da Conceição Leão (Portuguese pronunciation: [ʁɐfɐˈɛl ˈljɐ̃w]; born 10 June 1999) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a left winger and forward for Serie A club AC Milan and the Portugal national team.
Rafael Leao.note: The key to Leão is using strength without slowing the next action. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. There is another side to his game: he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Rafael Leao.noteZh: Rafael Leão的优势在于对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。最直接的表现是他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。另一个值得观察的细节是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Ramin Rezaeian.name: Ramin Rezaeian
Ramin Rezaeian.summary: Ramin Rezaeian Semeskandi (born 21 March 1990) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Persian Gulf Pro League club Esteghlal and the Iran national team. He started his career as a right-back, but he often plays as a winger.
Ramin Rezaeian.note: The key to Rezaeian is delivering the ball without needing much space. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. The next thing to watch is whether he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Ramin Rezaeian.noteZh: Ramin Rezaeian的比赛建立在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力之上。首先看他如何在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。换到另一个阶段，要看他是否会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Raul Jimenez.name: Raul Jimenez
Raul Jimenez.summary: Raúl Alonso Jiménez Rodríguez (Latin American Spanish: [raˈul xiˈmenes]; born 5 May 1991) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Mexico national team.
Raul Jimenez.note: Jiménez stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Jiménez also protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Raul Jimenez.noteZh: Raúl Jiménez的比赛建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球之上。首先看他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个方面是他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Ritsu Doan.name: Ritsu Doan
Ritsu Doan.summary: Ritsu Dōan (堂安 律, Dōan Ritsu; born 16 June 1998) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt and the Japan national team.
Ritsu Doan.note: The key to Dōan is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He shifts onto his left foot and shoots with little backlift. In another phase, Dōan draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Ritsu Doan.noteZh: 理解Ritsu Dōan，要先看防线重组前制造干净射门。他会把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Riyad Mahrez.name: Riyad Mahrez
Riyad Mahrez.summary: Riyad Karim Mahrez (born 21 February 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Al-Ahli. Born in France, he captains the Algeria national team.
Riyad Mahrez.note: Watch Mahrez for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. The clearest example is how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Also watch how Mahrez moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Riyad Mahrez.noteZh: 理解Riyad Mahrez，要先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Roberto Lopes.name: Roberto Lopes
Roberto Lopes.summary: Roberto Carlos Lopes (Portuguese: [ʀu.ˈbɛ.tu ˈkaɾ.luʒ ˈlɔpɨʃ]; born 17 June 1992), also known as Pico (Kabuverdianu: [ˈpi.ku]), is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Shamrock Rovers.
Roberto Lopes.note: For Lopes, the foundation is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Look first at how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Also watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Roberto Lopes.noteZh: 最能体现Pico Lopes特点的是危险出现前组织好队友。这一点直接体现在他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。除此之外，他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Romano Schmid.name: Romano Schmid
Romano Schmid.summary: Romano Christian Schmid (born 27 January 2000) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen and the Austria national team.
Romano Schmid.note: For Schmid, the foundation is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Look first at how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Also watch how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Romano Schmid.noteZh: 理解Romano Schmid，要先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Romelu Lukaku.name: Romelu Lukaku
Romelu Lukaku.summary: Romelu Lukaku Bolingoli (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈroːmeːlu luˈkaːku]; born 13 May 1993) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Serie A club Napoli and the Belgium national team.
Romelu Lukaku.note: For Lukaku, the foundation is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. Look first at how he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. Beyond that, watch how he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Romelu Lukaku.noteZh: 理解Romelu Lukaku，要先看让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Ronald Araujo.name: Ronald Araujo
Ronald Araujo.summary: Ronald Federico Araújo da Silva (Spanish pronunciation: [roˈnald aɾaˈuxo]; born 7 March 1999) is an Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Barcelona, whom he captains, and the Uruguay national team.
Ronald Araujo.note: For Araújo, the foundation is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. Look first at how he turns early and protects the route toward goal. Beyond that, watch how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ronald Araujo.noteZh: 最能体现Ronald Araújo特点的是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。除此之外，他也会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Ronwen Williams.name: Ronwen Williams
Ronwen Williams.summary: Ronwen Hayden Williams (born 21 January 1992) is a South African soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier Soccer League club Mamelodi Sundowns and captains the South Africa national team.
Ronwen Williams.note: Williams's signature is the patience to read a penalty taker's last movement. Watch how he waits for the strike before committing. He also keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Ronwen Williams.noteZh: 耐心判断点球手最后一下动作构成Ronwen Williams踢法的核心。他会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。除此之外，值得留意他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Ruben Dias.name: Ruben Dias
Ruben Dias.summary: Rúben dos Santos Gato Alves Dias (born 14 May 1997) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Manchester City and the Portugal national team. He is regarded as one of the best centre-backs in the world.
Ruben Dias.note: Watch Dias for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. The clearest example is how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. In a different phase, Dias holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Ruben Dias.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友是理解Rúben Dias踢法的关键。先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。到了另一个比赛环节，他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ruben Vargas.name: Ruben Vargas
Ruben Vargas.summary: Rubén Estephan Vargas Martínez (born 5 August 1998) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Spanish La Liga club Sevilla and the Switzerland national team.
Ruben Vargas.note: Watch Vargas for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. In a different phase, Vargas meets the pass without adding an extra touch.
Ruben Vargas.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动构成Rubén Vargas踢法的核心。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。除此之外，值得留意他会迎球直接完成射门，不增加调整触球。

Rustamjon Ashurmatov.name: Rustamjon Ashurmatov
Rustamjon Ashurmatov.summary: Rustam Ashurmatov (Uzbek: Рустам Ашурматов; born 7 July 1996), sometimes spelt as Rustamjon Ashurmatov, is an Uzbek footballer who plays as a defender for Iranian club Esteghlal and the Uzbekistan national team.
Rustamjon Ashurmatov.note: Ashurmatov stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. A different detail is how Ashurmatov keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Rustamjon Ashurmatov.noteZh: 最能体现Rustam Ashurmatov特点的是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。这一点直接体现在他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Ryan Mendes.name: Ryan Mendes
Ryan Mendes.summary: Ryan Isaac Mendes da Graça (Portuguese: [ʀi.ˈɐ̃ i.ˈzak ˈmẽ.dɨʒ dɐ ˈɡɾa.sɐ]; born 8 January 1990) is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a winger for TFF 1. Lig club Iğdır and the Cape Verde national team.
Ryan Mendes.note: Mendes's signature is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. Watch how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. At another point in the move, he slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Ryan Mendes.noteZh: 防守者仍盯着球时提前启动是理解Ryan Mendes踢法的关键。先看他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。到了另一个比赛环节，他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Sadio Mane.name: Sadio Mane
Sadio Mane.summary: Sadio Mané (born 10 April 1992) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr and the Senegal national team.
Sadio Mane.note: Mané's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Watch how he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. Another detail is how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Sadio Mane.noteZh: 观察Sadio Mané时，可以先看防线重组前制造干净射门。他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。另一个比赛细节是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Salem Al-Dawsari.name: Salem Al-Dawsari
Salem Al-Dawsari.summary: Salem Mohammed Shafi Al-Dawsari (Arabic: سَالِم مُحَمَّد شَافِي الدَّوْسَرِيّ; born 19 August 1991) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a left winger and captains both Saudi Pro League club Al-Hilal and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Salem Al-Dawsari.note: The key to Al-Dawsari is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. There is another side to his game: he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Salem Al-Dawsari.noteZh: 理解Salem Al-Dawsari，要先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Saman Ghoddos.name: Saman Ghoddos
Saman Ghoddos.summary: Saman Ghoddos (Persian: سامان قدّوس; born 6 September 1993), known as Seyed Saman Ghoddoos in Iran, is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or striker for the Iran national team and Kalba in UAE Pro League.
Saman Ghoddos.note: Ghoddos's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Watch how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Away from that moment, he varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Saman Ghoddos.noteZh: 最能体现Saman Ghoddos特点的是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。这一点直接体现在他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。除此之外，他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Santiago Gimenez.name: Santiago Gimenez
Santiago Gimenez.summary: Santiago Tomás “Santi” Giménez Zolotarchuk (Spanish pronunciation: [sanˈtjaɣo toˈmas xiˈmenes]; born 18 April 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for Serie A club AC Milan. Born in Argentina, he represents the Mexico national team.
Santiago Gimenez.note: Watch Giménez for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. The clearest example is how he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. Also notice how Giménez arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Santiago Gimenez.noteZh: 最能体现Santiago Giménez特点的是防线重组前制造干净射门。这一点直接体现在他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。除此之外，他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Sarpreet Singh.name: Sarpreet Singh
Sarpreet Singh.summary: Sarpreet Singh (born 20 February 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for A-League Men club Wellington Phoenix, on loan from Serbian SuperLiga club TSC and the New Zealand national team.
Sarpreet Singh.note: For Singh, the foundation is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Look first at how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Beyond that, watch how he opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Sarpreet Singh.noteZh: 看Sarpreet Singh的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Scott McTominay.name: Scott McTominay
Scott McTominay.summary: Scott Francis McTominay (born 8 December 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Napoli. Born in England, he plays for the Scotland national team.
Scott McTominay.note: Watch McTominay for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. In a different phase, McTominay uses a clean first touch to open a shooting lane from distance.
Scott McTominay.noteZh: Scott McTominay的优势在于等防守者注意力转移后再启动。最直接的表现是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个值得观察的细节是他会用干净的第一脚触球打开远射线路。

Sead Kolasinac.name: Sead Kolasinac
Sead Kolasinac.summary: Sead Kolašinac (pronounced [sěad kolaʃîːnats]; born 20 June 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Atalanta. Born in Germany, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Sead Kolasinac.note: For Kolašinac, the foundation is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Look first at how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Beyond the first action, he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Sead Kolasinac.noteZh: 看Sead Kolašinac的作用，关键是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Simon Adingra.name: Simon Adingra
Simon Adingra.summary: Simon Adingra (born 1 January 2002) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Monaco, on loan from Premier League club Sunderland, and the Ivory Coast national team.
Simon Adingra.note: Watch Adingra for changing direction without losing control of the ball. The clearest example is how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Also notice how Adingra pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Simon Adingra.noteZh: 理解Simon Adingra，要先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Son Heung-min.name: Son Heung-min
Son Heung-min.summary: Son Heung-min is South Korea's captain and Los Angeles FC forward, giving the national team elite movement, two-footed finishing, and transition threat.
Son Heung-min.note: What separates Son is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Son positions the ball to finish with either foot before the defender can reset. Also note how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Son Heung-min.noteZh: Son Heung-min最鲜明的特点是防线重组前制造干净射门。一个直接线索是他会把球放到左右脚都能直接射门的位置，在防守者重组前完成射门。另一个独立细节是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Stephen Eustaquio.name: Stephen Eustaquio
Stephen Eustaquio.summary: Stephen Antunes Eustáquio ( STEF-ən; born 21 December 1996) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Los Angeles FC, on loan from Primeira Liga club Porto, and vice-captains the Canada national team.
Stephen Eustaquio.club: Los Angeles FC (on loan from Porto)
Stephen Eustaquio.note: Eustáquio's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Separately, he varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Stephen Eustaquio.noteZh: 观察Stephen Eustáquio时，可以先看压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。另一个比赛细节是他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Tahith Chong.name: Tahith Chong
Tahith Chong.summary: Tahith Jose Girigorio Djorkaef Chong (born 4 December 1999) is a Curaçaoan professional footballer who plays as a wide midfielder or attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Sheffield United and the Curaçao national team.
Tahith Chong.note: Chong's signature is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. Watch how he changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He also draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Tahith Chong.noteZh: Tahith Chong的优势在于多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。最直接的表现是他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。另一个值得观察的细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Takefusa Kubo.name: Takefusa Kubo
Takefusa Kubo.summary: Takefusa Kubo (born 4 June 2001), commonly known as Take Kubo, is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a right winger for La Liga club Real Sociedad and the Japan national team.
Takefusa Kubo.note: What separates Kubo is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Kubo draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. At another point, he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Takefusa Kubo.noteZh: 观察Takefusa Kubo时，可以先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个比赛细节是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Teboho Mokoena.name: Teboho Mokoena
Teboho Mokoena.summary: Teboho Mokoena (born 24 January 1997) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Premiership side Mamelodi Sundowns and the South Africa national team.
Teboho Mokoena.note: Watch Mokoena for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. The clearest example is how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Elsewhere, Mokoena uses a clean first touch to open a shooting lane from distance.
Teboho Mokoena.noteZh: 压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定构成Teboho Mokoena踢法的核心。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。除此之外，值得留意他会用干净的第一脚触球打开远射线路。

Thomas Partey.name: Thomas Partey
Thomas Partey.summary: Thomas Teye Partey (born 13 June 1993) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Villarreal and the Ghana national team.
Thomas Partey.note: Watch Partey for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. The clearest example is how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Also watch how Partey waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Thomas Partey.noteZh: 最能体现Thomas Partey特点的是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。这一点直接体现在他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。除此之外，他也会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Tomas Soucek.name: Tomas Soucek
Tomas Soucek.summary: Tomáš Souček (Czech pronunciation: [ˈtomaːʃ ˈsoutʃɛk]; born 27 February 1995) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club West Ham United and the Czech Republic national team.
Tomas Soucek.note: Souček stands out for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Another aspect is how Souček meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Tomas Soucek.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动构成Tomáš Souček踢法的核心。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。除此之外，值得留意他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Trezeguet.name: Trezeguet
Trezeguet.summary: Mahmoud Ahmed Ibrahim Hassan (Arabic: محمود أحمد إبراهيم حسن; born 1 October 1994), commonly known as Trézéguet (Arabic: تريزيجيه), is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Egypt...
Trezeguet.note: For Trézéguet, the foundation is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Look first at how he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. Beyond the first action, he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Trezeguet.noteZh: 防线重组前制造干净射门是理解Trézéguet踢法的关键。先看他如何保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。到了另一个比赛环节，他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Tyler Adams.name: Tyler Adams
Tyler Adams.summary: Tyler Shaan Adams (born February 14, 1999) is an American professional soccer player who plays for Premier League club Bournemouth and the United States national team.
Tyler Adams.note: Watch Adams for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. The clearest example is how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Elsewhere, Adams angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Tyler Adams.noteZh: Tyler Adams的比赛建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定之上。首先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。另一个方面是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Viktor Gyokeres.name: Viktor Gyokeres
Viktor Gyokeres.summary: Viktor Einar Gyökeres (Swedish: [ˈvɪ̌kːtɔr ˈjø̂ːkɛrɛs]; born 4 June 1998) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Arsenal and the Sweden national team.
Viktor Gyokeres.note: For Gyökeres, the foundation is using strength without slowing the next action. Look first at how he absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. A separate point is how he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Viktor Gyokeres.noteZh: Viktor Gyökeres的比赛建立在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步之上。首先看他如何承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。另一个方面是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Vinicius Junior.name: Vinicius Junior
Vinicius Junior.summary: Vinícius José Paixão de Oliveira Júnior (Brazilian Portuguese: [viˈni.sjuz ʒoˈzɛ pajˈʃɐ̃w̃ dʒi oliˈvej.ɾɐ ˈʒu.njoʁ]; born 12 July 2000), commonly known as Vinícius Júnior or Vini Jr., is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for La Liga...
Vinicius Junior.note: For Vinícius, the foundation is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Look first at how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Beyond that, watch how he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Vinicius Junior.noteZh: Vinícius Júnior的比赛建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下之上。首先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个方面是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Virgil van Dijk.name: Virgil van Dijk
Virgil van Dijk.summary: Virgil van Dijk (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈvɪrdʑɪl vɑn ˈdɛik]; born 8 July 1991) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for and captains both Premier League club Liverpool and the Netherlands national team.
Virgil van Dijk.note: The key to van Dijk is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. The next thing to watch is whether he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Virgil van Dijk.noteZh: 看Virgil van Dijk的作用，关键是危险出现前组织好队友。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。想再多看一层，可以留意他是否会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Vitinha.name: Vitinha
Vitinha.summary: Vítor Machado Ferreira (born 13 February 2000), known as Vitinha (Portuguese pronunciation: [viˈtiɲɐ]), is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Portugal national team.
Vitinha.note: The key to Vitinha is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Elsewhere in the game, Vitinha uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Vitinha.noteZh: 理解Vitinha，要先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Vozinha.name: Vozinha
Vozinha.summary: Vozinha is a Cabo Verde goalkeeper from Chaves who gives the national team veteran command, shot stopping, and tournament experience.
Vozinha.note: Vozinha stands out for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. A different detail is how Vozinha sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Vozinha.noteZh: Vozinha的比赛建立在危险出现前组织好队友之上。首先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。另一个方面是他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Weston McKennie.name: Weston McKennie
Weston McKennie.summary: Weston James Earl McKennie (born August 28, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who plays primarily as a midfielder for Serie A club Juventus and the United States national team.
Weston McKennie.note: For McKennie, the foundation is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. Look first at how he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. Also watch how he absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Weston McKennie.noteZh: 最能体现Weston McKennie特点的是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。这一点直接体现在他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。除此之外，他也会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

William Saliba.name: William Saliba
William Saliba.summary: William Alain André Gabriel Saliba (French: [wiljam saliba]; born 24 March 2001) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Arsenal and the France national team.
William Saliba.note: Saliba stands out for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. Also look at how Saliba waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
William Saliba.noteZh: 理解William Saliba，要先看第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Yasin Ayari.name: Yasin Ayari
Yasin Ayari.summary: Yasin Ayari (Arabic: ياسين عباس عياري; born 6 October 2003) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion and the Sweden national team.
Yasin Ayari.note: The key to Ayari is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Elsewhere in the game, Ayari uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Yasin Ayari.noteZh: Yasin Ayari的比赛建立在用传球的力度和角度移动防线之上。首先看他如何在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。另一个方面是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Yoane Wissa.name: Yoane Wissa
Yoane Wissa.summary: Yoane Wissa (born 3 September 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or left winger for Premier League club Newcastle United. Born in France, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Yoane Wissa.note: What separates Wissa is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Wissa angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. A separate detail appears when he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Yoane Wissa.noteZh: 带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑构成Yoane Wissa踢法的核心。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。除此之外，值得留意他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Zidane Iqbal.name: Zidane Iqbal
Zidane Iqbal.summary: Zidane Aamar Iqbal (Arabic: زيدان عمار إقبال; Urdu: زیدان عمار اقبال; born 27 April 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Utrecht. Born in England, he plays for the Iraq national team.
Zidane Iqbal.note: Iqbal's signature is carrying momentum through open midfield. Watch how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Away from that moment, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Zidane Iqbal.noteZh: 最能体现Zidane Iqbal特点的是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。这一点直接体现在他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。除此之外，他也会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Ante Budimir.name: Ante Budimir
Ante Budimir.summary: Ante Budimir (Croatian pronunciation: [ǎːnte bûdimiːr]; born 22 July 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Osasuna. Born in Bosnia and Herzegovina, he plays for the Croatia national team.
Ante Budimir.note: Budimir stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. Another aspect is how Budimir pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Ante Budimir.noteZh: 最能体现Ante Budimir特点的是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。这一点直接体现在他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。除此之外，他也会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Ardon Jashari.name: Ardon Jashari
Ardon Jashari.summary: Ardon Jashari (born 30 July 2002) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Serie A club AC Milan and the Switzerland national team.
Ardon Jashari.note: The key to Jashari is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. The next thing to watch is whether he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it.
Ardon Jashari.noteZh: 理解Ardon Jashari，要先看压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。下一个值得观察的问题是，他是否会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。

Aurele Amenda.name: Aurele Amenda
Aurele Amenda.summary: Aurèle Florian Amenda (born 31 July 2003) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt and the Switzerland national team.
Aurele Amenda.note: Amenda's signature is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. Watch how he turns early and protects the route toward goal. Separately, he moves the ball to the next available teammate without holding it.
Aurele Amenda.noteZh: 看Aurèle Amenda的作用，关键是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会不拖延持球，把球交给下一名可接应的队友。

Cedric Itten.name: Cedric Itten
Cedric Itten.summary: Cedric Jan Itten (born 27 December 1996) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a centre forward for German 3. Liga club Fortuna Düsseldorf and the Switzerland national team. He will join Bundesliga club Werder Bremen on 1 July 2026.
Cedric Itten.note: What separates Itten is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. Itten starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. Away from that action, he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Cedric Itten.noteZh: 看Cedric Itten的作用，关键是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Christian Fassnacht.name: Christian Fassnacht
Christian Fassnacht.summary: Christian Andreas Fassnacht (born 11 November 1993) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Swiss Super League club Young Boys and the Switzerland national team.
Christian Fassnacht.note: Watch Fassnacht for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Elsewhere, Fassnacht holds the far-post lane, then attacks it as the cross leaves the passer.
Christian Fassnacht.noteZh: 理解Christian Fassnacht，要先看等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会先留在后点线路，等传中离脚后再启动攻击落点。

Dan Ndoye.name: Dan Ndoye
Dan Ndoye.summary: Dan Assane Ndoye (born 25 October 2000) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as winger for Premier League club Nottingham Forest and the Switzerland national team.
Dan Ndoye.note: For Ndoye, the foundation is explosive speed once open grass appears. Look first at how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Separately, look at how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Dan Ndoye.noteZh: 理解Dan Ndoye，要先看看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Denis Zakaria.name: Denis Zakaria
Denis Zakaria.summary: Denis Lemi Zakaria Lako Lado (born 20 November 1996) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Ligue 1 club Monaco, whom he captains, and the Switzerland national team.
Denis Zakaria.note: Zakaria stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Another aspect is how Zakaria plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Denis Zakaria.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Denis Zakaria踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Djibril Sow.name: Djibril Sow
Djibril Sow.summary: Mohameth Djibril Ibrahima Sow (born 6 February 1997) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Sevilla and the Switzerland national team.
Djibril Sow.note: Watch Sow for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. The clearest example is how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Also watch how Sow protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Djibril Sow.noteZh: 理解Djibril Sow，要先看用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Eray Coemert.name: Eray Coemert
Eray Coemert.summary: Eray Ervin Cömert (born 4 February 1998) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Spanish club Valencia and the Switzerland national team.
Eray Coemert.note: For Cömert, the foundation is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. Look first at how he protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. A separate point is how he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Eray Coemert.noteZh: 理解Eray Cömert，要先看对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Fabian Rieder.name: Fabian Rieder
Fabian Rieder.summary: Fabian Rieder (born 16 February 2002) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for German Bundesliga club FC Augsburg and the Switzerland national team.
Fabian Rieder.note: Rieder stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Also look at how Rieder serves corners and free kicks into the attacking area.
Fabian Rieder.noteZh: Fabian Rieder最鲜明的特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。一个直接线索是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个独立细节是他会把角球和任意球送入进攻区域。

Gregor Kobel.name: Gregor Kobel
Gregor Kobel.summary: Gregor Kobel (born 6 December 1997) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club Borussia Dortmund and the Switzerland national team.
Gregor Kobel.note: Kobel's signature is command of the crowded space around goal. Watch how he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders. Separately, he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Gregor Kobel.noteZh: Gregor Kobel的比赛建立在掌控门前拥挤空间的能力之上。首先看他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。另一个方面是他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Hassan Alhaydos.name: Hassan Alhaydos
Hassan Alhaydos.summary: Hassan Khalid Hassan Al-Haydos (Arabic: حَسَن خَالِد حَسَن الْهَيْدُوس; born 11 December 1990) is a Qatari professional footballer who plays as a forward for and captains Qatar Stars League club Al Sadd and the Qatar national team.
Hassan Alhaydos.note: What separates Al-Haydos is repeatable technique on dead balls. Al-Haydos varies the height and pace of his delivery. A separate detail appears when he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Hassan Alhaydos.noteZh: 定位球上稳定而多变的脚法是理解Hassan Al-Haydos踢法的关键。先看他如何通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。到了另一个比赛环节，他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Kerim Alajbegovic.name: Kerim Alajbegovic

Kerim Alajbegovic.note: Alajbegović's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. Watch how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Another detail is how he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Kerim Alajbegovic.noteZh: 理解Kerim Alajbegović，要先看看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Lenny Joseph.name: Lenny Joseph
Lenny Joseph.summary: Lenny Joseph (born 12 October 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Hungarian club Ferencváros. Born in France, he plays for the Haiti national team.

Lenny Joseph.noteZh: 最能体现Lenny Joseph特点的是防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。这一点直接体现在他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。除此之外，他也会迎球直接完成射门，不增加调整触球。

Luca Jaquez.noteZh: Luca Jaquez的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个方面是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Mahmoud Abunada.name: Mahmoud Abunada
Mahmoud Abunada.summary: Mahmud Ibrahim Abunada (Arabic: محمود إبراهيم أبو ندى; born 5 February 2000) is a Qatari professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Qatari Stars League club Al-Rayyan and the Qatar national team.

Mahmoud Abunada.noteZh: Mahmoud Abunada的比赛建立在掌控门前拥挤空间的能力之上。首先看他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。另一个方面是他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Marvin Keller.name: Marvin Keller
Marvin Keller.summary: Marvin Keller (born 3 July 2002) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Swiss club Young Boys and the Switzerland national team.
Marvin Keller.note: The key to Keller is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. A separate part of his game is how Keller chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Marvin Keller.noteZh: Marvin Keller最鲜明的特点是提前站位后的快速反应。一个直接线索是他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。另一个独立细节是他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Michel Aebischer.name: Michel Aebischer
Michel Aebischer.summary: Michel Aebischer (born 6 January 1997) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie B club Pisa, on loan from Serie A club Bologna, and the Switzerland national team.
Michel Aebischer.note: What separates Aebischer is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Aebischer arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Also note how he adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Michel Aebischer.noteZh: 看Michel Aebischer的作用，关键是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Nico Elvedi.name: Nico Elvedi
Nico Elvedi.summary: Nico Elvedi (born 30 September 1996) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Borussia Mönchengladbach and the Switzerland national team.
Nico Elvedi.note: Elvedi stands out for reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. Also look at how Elvedi moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Nico Elvedi.noteZh: Nico Elvedi的优势在于空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段。最直接的表现是他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。另一个值得观察的细节是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Noah Okafor.name: Noah Okafor

Remo Freuler.name: Remo Freuler
Remo Freuler.summary: Remo Marco Freuler (Swiss Standard German pronunciation: [ˈreː.mo ˈfrɔɪ.lər]; born 15 April 1992) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Bologna and the Switzerland national team.
Remo Freuler.note: For Freuler, the foundation is reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. Look first at how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. For a wider picture, notice whether he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it.
Remo Freuler.noteZh: Remo Freuler的优势在于对抗后球权松动时的第一反应。最直接的表现是他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。想看得更完整，还要观察他是否会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。

Ricardo Rodriguez.name: Ricardo Rodriguez
Ricardo Rodriguez.summary: Ricardo Iván Rodríguez Araya (born 25 August 1992) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a left-back for La Liga club Real Betis and the Switzerland national team.
Ricardo Rodriguez.note: The key to Rodríguez is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. A separate part of his game is how Rodríguez slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Ricardo Rodriguez.noteZh: 最能体现Ricardo Rodríguez特点的是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。这一点直接体现在他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。除此之外，他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Silvan Widmer.name: Silvan Widmer
Silvan Widmer.summary: Silvan Dominic Widmer (born 5 March 1993) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Bundesliga club Mainz 05, whom he captains, and the Switzerland national team.

Zeki Amdouni.note: For Amdouni, the foundation is making the next teammate's action easier. Look first at how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. Beyond that, watch how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Zeki Amdouni.noteZh: Zeki Amdouni的比赛建立在让队友下一步处理更轻松之上。首先看他如何用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。另一个方面是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Ali Ahmed.name: Ali Ahmed

Ali Ahmed.note: For Ahmed, the foundation is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Look first at how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Also watch how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Ali Ahmed.noteZh: 理解Ali Ahmed，要先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Alistair Johnston.name: Alistair Johnston
Alistair Johnston.summary: Alistair William Johnston (born October 8, 1998) is a Canadian professional football player who plays as a right-back for Scottish Premiership club Celtic and the Canada national team. Johnston began his senior career with Vaughan Azzurri.

Ismael Kone.name: Ismael Kone

Joel Waterman.name: Joel Waterman

Luc De Fougerolles.name: Luc De Fougerolles

Kieran Tierney.summary: Kieran Tierney (born 5 June 1997) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Scottish Premiership club Celtic and the Scotland national team.
Kieran Tierney.note: The key to Tierney is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. One more thing to notice is how Tierney holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Kieran Tierney.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机构成Kieran Tierney踢法的核心。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，值得留意他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Lawrence Shankland.name: Lawrence Shankland
Lawrence Shankland.summary: Lawrence Shankland (born 10 August 1995) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Scottish Premiership club Rangers and the Scotland national team.
Lawrence Shankland.note: What separates Shankland is the timing of his run across the nearest defender. Shankland attacks the near-post lane before the marker can turn. In another phase of play, he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Lawrence Shankland.noteZh: Lawrence Shankland的优势在于抢到近门柱身前的跑动时机。最直接的表现是他会在盯防者转身前冲向近门柱线路。另一个值得观察的细节是他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Lewis Ferguson.name: Lewis Ferguson
Lewis Ferguson.summary: Lewis Ferguson (born 24 August 1999) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Serie A club Bologna, whom he captains, and the Scotland national team.
Lewis Ferguson.note: For Ferguson, the foundation is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Look first at how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. A separate point is how he adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Lewis Ferguson.noteZh: Lewis Ferguson最鲜明的特点是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。一个直接线索是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个独立细节是他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Liam Kelly.name: Liam Kelly
Liam Kelly.summary: Liam Patrick Kelly (born 23 January 1996) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Scottish Premiership club Rangers and the Scotland national team.
Liam Kelly.note: Kelly's signature is the patience to read a penalty taker's last movement. Watch how he waits for the strike before committing. Separately, he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Liam Kelly.noteZh: 最能体现Liam Kelly特点的是耐心判断点球手最后一下动作。这一点直接体现在他会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。除此之外，他也会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Lyndon Dykes.name: Lyndon Dykes
Lyndon Dykes.summary: Lyndon John Dykes (born 7 October 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic. Born and raised in Australia to Scottish parents, he plays for the Scotland national team.
Lyndon Dykes.note: Watch Dykes for giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. The clearest example is how he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. A separate clue is how Dykes angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Lyndon Dykes.noteZh: 让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用构成Lyndon Dykes踢法的核心。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。除此之外，值得留意他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Nathan Patterson.name: Nathan Patterson
Nathan Patterson.summary: Nathan Kenneth Patterson (born 16 October 2001) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Premier League club Everton and the Scotland national team.
Nathan Patterson.note: Patterson stands out for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. Another aspect is how Patterson waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Nathan Patterson.noteZh: 观察Nathan Patterson时，可以先看防线暴露后的回追速度。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。另一个比赛细节是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Ross Stewart.name: Ross Stewart
Ross Stewart.summary: Ross Cameron Stewart (born 11 July 1996) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Southampton and the Scotland national team.
Ross Stewart.note: The key to Stewart is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. A separate part of his game is how Stewart shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ross Stewart.noteZh: 最能体现Ross Stewart特点的是让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。这一点直接体现在他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。除此之外，他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ryan Christie.name: Ryan Christie
Ryan Christie.summary: Ryan Christie (born 22 February 1995) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for Premier League club Bournemouth and the Scotland national team.
Ryan Christie.note: For Christie, the foundation is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Look first at how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Beyond that, watch how he opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Ryan Christie.noteZh: 观察Ryan Christie时，可以先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个比赛细节是他会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Tyler Fletcher.name: Tyler Fletcher

Ben Gannon-Doak.name: Ben Gannon-Doak

Ben Gannon-Doak.noteZh: Ben Gannon-Doak最鲜明的特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。一个直接线索是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个独立细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Kenny McLean.name: Kenny McLean
Kenny McLean.summary: Kenneth McLean (born 8 January 1992) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder or left midfielder for EFL Championship club Norwich City, whom he captains, and the Scotland national team.

Kenny McLean.noteZh: 理解Kenny McLean，要先看压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会用左脚送出眼前可行的传球。

Scott McKenna.name: Scott McKenna
Scott McKenna.summary: Scott Fraser McKenna (born 12 November 1996) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for HNL club Dinamo Zagreb and the Scotland national team.

Scott McKenna.noteZh: 最能体现Scott McKenna特点的是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。这一点直接体现在他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，他也会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Alex Sandro.note: What separates Sandro is staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. Sandro checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. At another point, he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.

Alisson Becker.note: The key to Becker is staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. In another phase, Becker leaves his line early when a through ball escapes the back line.
Alisson Becker.noteZh: 射门方向明确前保持身体平衡构成Alisson Becker踢法的核心。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。除此之外，值得留意他会在直塞球越过后防时及时出击。

Bremer.name: Bremer
Bremer.summary: Gleison Bremer Silva Nascimento (born 18 March 1997), known as Gleison Bremer (Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈɡlejsõ ˈbɾẽmeʁ]) or simply Bremer, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Juventus and the Brazil national team.
Bremer.note: Bremer's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Away from that moment, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Bremer.noteZh: 观察Bremer时，可以先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个比赛细节是他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Bruno Guimaraes.name: Bruno Guimaraes

Bruno Guimaraes.note: For Guimarães, the foundation is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Look first at how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Separately, look at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.

Danilo.name: Danilo

Danilo Santos.note: Watch Santos for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. The clearest example is how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate clue is how Santos pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it.

Ederson.name: Ederson
Ederson.summary: Ederson Santana de Moraes (born 17 August 1993), simply known as Ederson (Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈɛdɛʁsõ]), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe and the Brazil national team.

Endrick.summary: Endrick Felipe Moreira de Sousa Pessoa (born 21 July 2006), known as Endrick (Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈẽ(j̃)dɾik (i)]), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Ligue 1 club Lyon, on loan from La Liga club Real Madrid, and the Brazil...
