Weverton.noteZh: Weverton最鲜明的特点是长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。一个直接线索是他会在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。另一个独立细节是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Ahmed Reda Tagnaouti.name: Ahmed Reda Tagnaouti
Ahmed Reda Tagnaouti.summary: Ahmed Reda Tagnaouti (Arabic: أحمد رضا التكناوتي; born 5 April 1996) is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as goalkeeper for Botola Pro club AS FAR and the Morocco national team.
Ahmed Reda Tagnaouti.note: Watch Tagnaouti for turning a save into the first pass of an attack. The clearest example is how he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. Also watch how Tagnaouti sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Ahmed Reda Tagnaouti.noteZh: 最能体现Ahmed Reda Tagnaouti特点的是把一次扑救变成进攻第一传。这一点直接体现在他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。除此之外，他也会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Amine Sbai.name: Amine Sbai
Amine Sbai.summary: Mohamed Amine Sbaï (born 5 November 2000) is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Angers and the Morocco national team.
Amine Sbai.note: Watch Sbaï for changing direction without losing control of the ball. The clearest example is how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. A separate question is whether Sbaï changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Amine Sbai.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Amine Sbaï踢法的关键。先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个问题是，Amine Sbaï是否会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Anass Salah Eddine.name: Anass Salah Eddine
Anass Salah Eddine.summary: Anass Salah-Eddine (Arabic: أنس صلاح الدين; born 18 January 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for Eredivisie club PSV, on loan from Serie A club Roma, and the Morocco national team.
Anass Salah Eddine.note: For Salah-Eddine, the foundation is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Look first at how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Separately, look at how he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Anass Salah Eddine.noteZh: 最能体现Anass Salah-Eddine特点的是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。这一点直接体现在他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。除此之外，他也会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Ayoube Amaimouni.name: Ayoube Amaimouni
Ayoube Amaimouni.summary: Ayoube Amaimouni-Echghouyabe (Arabic: أيوب الميموني; born 30 November 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for German Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt. Born in Spain, he plays for the Morocco national team.
Ayoube Amaimouni.note: Amaimouni-Echghouyab stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Another aspect is how Amaimouni-Echghouyab changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Ayoube Amaimouni.noteZh: 看到空当后的爆发速度构成Ayoube Amaimouni-Echghouyab踢法的核心。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。除此之外，值得留意他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Ayyoub Bouaddi.name: Ayyoub Bouaddi
Ayyoub Bouaddi.summary: Ayyoub Bouaddi (Arabic: أيوب بوعدي, Berber languages: ⴰⵢⵢⵓⴱ ⴱⵓⵄⴰⴷⴷⵉ; born 2 October 2007) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Lille. Born in France, he plays for the Morocco national team.
Ayyoub Bouaddi.note: Bouaddi's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. For a wider read, also watch whether he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it.
Ayyoub Bouaddi.noteZh: 看Ayyoub Bouaddi的作用，关键是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。想再多看一层，可以留意他是否会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。

Azzedine Ounahi.name: Azzedine Ounahi
Azzedine Ounahi.summary: Azzedine Ounahi (Arabic: عز الدين أوناحي, pronounced [ʕiz ʔad.di:n u:na:ħi:]; born 19 April 2000) is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Segunda División club Girona and the Morocco national team.
Azzedine Ounahi.note: The key to Ounahi is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Elsewhere in the game, Ounahi uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Azzedine Ounahi.noteZh: 观察Azzedine Ounahi时，可以先看用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。另一个比赛细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Chadi Riad.name: Chadi Riad
Chadi Riad.summary: Chadi Riad Dnanou (Arabic: شادي رياض دنانو; born 17 June 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Crystal Palace. Born in Spain, he plays for the Morocco national team.
Chadi Riad.note: What separates Riad is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Riad holds the route into the box until support arrives. At another point, he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Chadi Riad.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Chadi Riad踢法的关键。先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Chemsdine Talbi.name: Chemsdine Talbi
Chemsdine Talbi.summary: Chemsdine Talbi (Arabic: شَمْس الدِّين الطَّالِبِيّ; born 9 May 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Sunderland. Born in Belgium, he plays for the Morocco national team.
Chemsdine Talbi.note: Watch Talbi for explosive speed once open grass appears. The clearest example is how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Also watch how Talbi looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Chemsdine Talbi.noteZh: 看到空当后的爆发速度构成Chemsdine Talbi踢法的核心。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。除此之外，值得留意他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Gessime Yassine.name: Gessime Yassine
Gessime Yassine.summary: Gessime Ben Youssef Mustapha Yassine (born 22 November 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Born in France, he represents the Morocco national team.
Gessime Yassine.note: For Yassine, the foundation is explosive speed once open grass appears. Look first at how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Also watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Gessime Yassine.noteZh: Gessime Yassine的优势在于看到空当后的爆发速度。最直接的表现是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个值得观察的细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Issa Diop.name: Issa Diop
Issa Diop.summary: Issa Diop is a Morocco centre-back who plays for Fulham and adds aerial defending, physical duels, and back-line depth to the national team.
Issa Diop.note: What separates Diop is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Diop waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Also note how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Issa Diop.noteZh: Issa Diop的优势在于选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。最直接的表现是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个值得观察的细节是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Marwane Saadane.name: Marwane Saadane
Marwane Saadane.summary: Marwane Saâdane (Arabic: مروان سعدان; born 17 January 1992) is a Moroccan professional football player who plays for Saudi Professional League club Al-Fateh and the Morocco national team.
Marwane Saadane.note: The key to Saâdane is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. One more thing to notice is how Saâdane moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Marwane Saadane.noteZh: 对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择构成Marwane Saâdane踢法的核心。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Noussair Mazraoui.name: Noussair Mazraoui
Noussair Mazraoui.summary: Noussair Mazraoui (Arabic: نُصَيْر مَزرَاوِيّ; born 14 November 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Premier League club Manchester United and the Morocco national team.
Noussair Mazraoui.note: Mazraoui's signature is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Watch how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. At another point in the move, he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Noussair Mazraoui.noteZh: 看Noussair Mazraoui的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Redouane Halhal.name: Redouane Halhal
Redouane Halhal.summary: Redouane Halhal (Arabic: رضوان حلحل; born 5 March 2003) is a footballer who plays as a defender for Belgian club Mechelen. Born in France, he represents the Morocco national team.
Redouane Halhal.note: Halhal stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A different detail is how Halhal meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Redouane Halhal.noteZh: 最能体现Redouane Halhal特点的是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。这一点直接体现在他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Sofyan Amrabat.name: Sofyan Amrabat
Sofyan Amrabat.summary: Sofyan Amrabat (Arabic: سفيان أمرابط, Berber languages: ⵙⵓⴼⵢⴰⵏ ⴰⵎⵕⴰⴱⵟ; born 21 August 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Real Betis, on loan from Süper Lig side Fenerbahçe, and the Morocco national team.
Sofyan Amrabat.note: Amrabat's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. At another point in the move, he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Sofyan Amrabat.noteZh: 看Sofyan Amrabat的作用，关键是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Youssef Belammari.name: Youssef Belammari
Youssef Belammari.summary: Youssef Belammari (Arabic: يُوسُف بَلْعُمَرِيّ; born 20 September 1998) is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Morocco national team.
Youssef Belammari.note: For Belammari, the foundation is staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. Look first at how he checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. Also watch how he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Youssef Belammari.noteZh: 观察Youssef Belammari时，可以先看球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动。他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。另一个比赛细节是他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Bilal El Khannouss.name: Bilal El Khannouss
Bilal El Khannouss.summary: Bilal El Khannouss (Arabic: بلال الخنوس; born 10 May 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club VfB Stuttgart and the Morocco national team.
Bilal El Khannouss.note: The key to El Khannouss is receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. There is another side to his game: he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Bilal El Khannouss.noteZh: 最能体现Bilal El Khannouss特点的是狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。这一点直接体现在他会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。除此之外，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Munir El Kajoui.name: Munir El Kajoui
Munir El Kajoui.summary: Munir El Kajoui (Arabic: منير الكجوي; born 10 May 1989), known as Munir, is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Botola Pro club RS Berkane, whom he captains, and the Morocco national team.
Munir El Kajoui.note: El Kajoui stands out for staying ready through long quiet spells. He keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. A different detail is how El Kajoui leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Munir El Kajoui.noteZh: 长时间无事可做后依然保持专注是理解Munir El Kajoui踢法的关键。先看他如何在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。到了另一个比赛环节，他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Neil El Aynaoui.name: Neil El Aynaoui
Neil El Aynaoui.summary: Neil Yoni El Aynaoui (Arabic: نائل العيناوي; born 2 July 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Roma and the Morocco national team.
Neil El Aynaoui.note: What separates El Aynaoui is carrying momentum through open midfield. El Aynaoui pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. In another phase of play, he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Neil El Aynaoui.noteZh: Neil El Aynaoui的优势在于带球穿过开放中场的推进力。最直接的表现是他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。另一个值得观察的细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Samir El Mourabet.name: Samir El Mourabet
Samir El Mourabet.summary: Samir El Mourabet (Arabic: سمير المرابط; born 6 October 2005) is a professional football player who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Born in France, he represents the Morocco national team.
Samir El Mourabet.note: Watch El Mourabet for carrying momentum through open midfield. The clearest example is how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Also notice how El Mourabet uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Samir El Mourabet.noteZh: 最能体现Samir El Mourabet特点的是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。这一点直接体现在他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。除此之外，他也会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Soufiane Rahimi.name: Soufiane Rahimi
Soufiane Rahimi.summary: Soufiane Rahimi (Arabic: سُفْيَان رَحِيمِيّ; born 2 June 1996) is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as a forward for UAE Pro League club Al Ain and the Morocco national team.
Soufiane Rahimi.note: For Rahimi, the foundation is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Look first at how he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. Also watch how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Soufiane Rahimi.noteZh: Soufiane Rahimi最鲜明的特点是防线重组前制造干净射门。一个直接线索是他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。另一个独立细节是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Zakaria El Ouahdi.name: Zakaria El Ouahdi
Zakaria El Ouahdi.summary: Zakaria El Ouahdi (Moroccan Arabic: زكرياء الواحدي; born 31 December 2001), is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger or a right-back for Belgian Pro League club Genk. Born in Belgium, he plays for the Morocco national team.
Zakaria El Ouahdi.note: El Ouahdi's signature is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. Watch how he turns early and protects the route toward goal. He also waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Zakaria El Ouahdi.noteZh: 观察Zakaria El Ouahdi时，可以先看第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。另一个比赛细节是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Alexandre Pierre.name: Alexandre Pierre
Alexandre Pierre.summary: Alexandre Pierre (born 25 February 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 2 club Sochaux. Born in France, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Alexandre Pierre.note: Watch Pierre for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. The clearest example is how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. A separate clue is how Pierre sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Alexandre Pierre.noteZh: 最能体现Alexandre Pierre特点的是危险出现前组织好队友。这一点直接体现在他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。除此之外，他也会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Carl Sainte.name: Carl Sainte
Carl Sainte.summary: Carl Fred Sainté (born 9 August 2002) is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for USL Championship club El Paso Locomotive and the Haiti national team.
Carl Sainte.note: The key to Sainté is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. There is another side to his game: he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Carl Sainte.noteZh: Carl Sainté的优势在于选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。最直接的表现是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Carlens Arcus.name: Carlens Arcus
Carlens Arcus.summary: Carlens Arcus (born 28 June 1996) is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Angers and the Haiti national team.
Carlens Arcus.note: Watch Arcus for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Also notice how Arcus gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Carlens Arcus.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机构成Carlens Arcus踢法的核心。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，值得留意他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Danley Jean Jacques.name: Danley Jean Jacques
Danley Jean Jacques.summary: Danley Jean Jacques (born 20 May 2000) is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Philadelphia Union and the Haiti national team. He usually plays as a central midfielder or defensive midfielder.
Danley Jean Jacques.note: Jacques stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A different detail is how Jacques takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Danley Jean Jacques.noteZh: 观察Danley Jean Jacques时，可以先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Derrick Etienne.name: Derrick Etienne
Derrick Etienne.summary: Derrick Etienne Jr. is a Haiti winger who plays for Toronto FC and gives the national team direct carrying, left-side width, and transition speed.
Derrick Etienne.note: Etienne's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Away from that moment, he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Derrick Etienne.noteZh: 观察Derrick Etienne Jr.时，可以先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个比赛细节是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Dominique Simon.name: Dominique Simon
Dominique Simon.summary: Dominique Célidor Simon (born 29 July 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Slovak First Football League club Tatran Prešov. Born in France, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Dominique Simon.note: For Simon, the foundation is reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. Look first at how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. Also watch how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Dominique Simon.noteZh: 看Dominique Simon的作用，关键是对抗后球权松动时的第一反应。他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Garven Metusala.name: Garven Metusala
Garven Metusala.summary: Garven-Michée Metusala (born 31 December 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for USL Championship club Colorado Springs Switchbacks. Born in Canada, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Garven Metusala.note: What separates Metusala is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Metusala waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. At another point, he steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself.
Garven Metusala.noteZh: Garven Metusala的比赛建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢之上。首先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个方面是他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Hannes Delcroix.name: Hannes Delcroix
Hannes Delcroix.summary: Hannes Piterson Delcroix (born 28 February 1999) is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Swiss Super League club Lugano and the Haiti national team.
Hannes Delcroix.note: The key to Delcroix is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. One more thing to notice is how Delcroix checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Hannes Delcroix.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢构成Hannes Delcroix踢法的核心。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，值得留意他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Jean-Kevin Duverne.name: Jean-Kevin Duverne
Jean-Kevin Duverne.summary: Jean-Kévin Duverne (born 12 July 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Belgian Pro League club Gent on loan from French club Nantes. Born in France, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Jean-Kevin Duverne.note: Watch Duverne for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. The clearest example is how he changes position while keeping his priorities simple. Also notice how Duverne turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Jean-Kevin Duverne.noteZh: 多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构是理解Jean-Kévin Duverne踢法的关键。先看他如何改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。到了另一个比赛环节，他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Johny Placide.name: Johny Placide
Johny Placide.summary: Johny Placide (born 29 January 1988) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper. Born in France, he plays for and captains the Haiti national team since 2011.
Johny Placide.note: What separates Placide is the patience to read a penalty taker's last movement. Placide waits for the strike before committing. At another point, he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Johny Placide.noteZh: Johny Placide的优势在于耐心判断点球手最后一下动作。最直接的表现是他会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。另一个值得观察的细节是他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Josue Casimir.name: Josue Casimir
Josue Casimir.summary: Josué Casimir (born 24 September 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back, right wing-back or striker for French Ligue 1 club Auxerre. Born in Guadeloupe, he represents the Haiti national team.
Josue Casimir.note: Casimir stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Also look at how Casimir looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Josue Casimir.noteZh: Josué Casimir的优势在于带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。最直接的表现是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Josue Duverger.name: Josue Duverger
Josue Duverger.summary: Josué Duverger (born 27 April 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Rheinlandliga club Cosmos Koblenz. Born in Canada, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Josue Duverger.note: Duverger's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. Watch how he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. For a wider read, also watch whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Josue Duverger.noteZh: 理解Josué Duverger，要先看提前站位后的快速反应。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。下一个值得观察的问题是，他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Keeto Thermoncy.name: Keeto Thermoncy
Keeto Thermoncy.summary: Keeto Thermoncy (born 29 March 2006) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for the U21 team of Young Boys in the Promotion League. Born in Switzerland, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Keeto Thermoncy.note: For Thermoncy, the foundation is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. Look first at how he protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. A separate point is how he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Keeto Thermoncy.noteZh: Keeto Thermoncy最鲜明的特点是对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。一个直接线索是他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。另一个独立细节是他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Louicius Deedson.name: Louicius Deedson
Louicius Deedson.summary: Don Deedson Louicius (born 11 February 2001), commonly known as Louicius Deedson, is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a right winger for MLS club FC Dallas and the Haiti national team.
Louicius Deedson.note: For Deedson, the foundation is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Look first at how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Also watch how he pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Louicius Deedson.noteZh: 理解Louicius Deedson，要先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Markhus Lacroix.name: Markhus Lacroix
Markhus Lacroix.summary: Markhus "Duke" Lacroix (born 14 October 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a full-back for Colorado Springs Switchbacks in the USL Championship. Born in the United States, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Markhus Lacroix.note: Watch Lacroix for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. The clearest example is how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. A separate clue is how Lacroix slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Markhus Lacroix.noteZh: 理解Duke Lacroix，要先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Martin Experience.name: Martin Experience
Martin Experience.summary: Martin Yves Expérience (born 9 March 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for French Ligue 2 club Nancy. Born in France, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Martin Experience.note: Expérience's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He also turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Martin Experience.noteZh: Martin Expérience的比赛建立在从后场加入进攻的启动时机之上。首先看他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个方面是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ricardo Ade.name: Ricardo Ade
Ricardo Ade.summary: Ricardo Adé Kat (born 21 May 1990) is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Ecuadorian club L.D.U. Quito and the Haiti national team.
Ricardo Ade.note: What separates Adé is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Adé keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. A separate detail appears when he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Ricardo Ade.noteZh: 最能体现Ricardo Adé特点的是危险出现前组织好队友。这一点直接体现在他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。除此之外，他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Ruben Providence.name: Ruben Providence
Ruben Providence.summary: Ruben Fritzner Providence (born 7 July 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for Dutch Eerste Divisie club Almere City. Born in France, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Ruben Providence.note: Providence stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Also look at how Providence draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Ruben Providence.noteZh: 观察Ruben Providence时，可以先看看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个比赛细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Wilguens Paugain.name: Wilguens Paugain
Wilguens Paugain.summary: Wilguens Raphael Polynice Paugain (born 24 August 2001) is a Haitian professional football player who plays as right-back for Zulte Waregem. A former youth international for France, he plays for the Haiti national team.
Wilguens Paugain.note: The key to Paugain is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. In another phase, Paugain waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Wilguens Paugain.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢是理解Wilguens Paugain踢法的关键。先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。到了另一个比赛环节，他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Woodensky Pierre.name: Woodensky Pierre

Yassin Fortune.name: Yassin Fortune
Yassin Fortune.summary: Yassin Enzo Fortuné (born 30 January 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Liga Portugal 2 club Vizela. Born in France, he represents the Haiti national team.
Yassin Fortune.note: The key to Fortuné is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. A separate part of his game is how Fortuné changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Yassin Fortune.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动构成Yassin Fortuné踢法的核心。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。除此之外，值得留意他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Alexandr Sojka.name: Alexandr Sojka
Alexandr Sojka.summary: Alexandr Sojka (born 2 April 2003) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Viktoria Plzeň and the Czech Republic national team.
Alexandr Sojka.note: Sojka's signature is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Watch how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Away from that moment, he plays forward toward an available runner when the opening appears.
Alexandr Sojka.noteZh: 理解Alexandr Sojka，要先看用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会线路出现时向前送给可接应的跑动者。

David Jurasek.name: David Jurasek

Denis Visinsky.name: Denis Visinsky

Hugo Sochurek.name: Hugo Sochurek
Hugo Sochurek.summary: Hugo Sochůrek is a Czechia central midfielder from Sparta Prague who adds youthful passing range, pressure resistance, and long-term upside to the squad.
Hugo Sochurek.note: For Sochůrek, the foundation is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Look first at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. For a wider picture, notice whether he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it.
Hugo Sochurek.noteZh: 最能体现Hugo Sochůrek特点的是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。这一点直接体现在他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。接着可以问，他是否会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。

Jan Kuchta.name: Jan Kuchta
Jan Kuchta.summary: Jan Kuchta (born 8 January 1997) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a forward for Sparta Prague and the Czech Republic national team.

Jaroslav Zeleny.name: Jaroslav Zeleny
Jaroslav Zeleny.summary: Jaroslav Zelený is a Czechia defender from Sparta Prague who can cover centre-back or left-back and gives the squad experienced defensive balance.
Jaroslav Zeleny.note: Watch Zelený for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. The clearest example is how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Also notice how Zelený moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Jaroslav Zeleny.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢构成Jaroslav Zelený踢法的核心。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，值得留意他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Jindrich Stanek.name: Jindrich Stanek
Jindrich Stanek.summary: Jindřich Staněk (born 27 April 1996) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Czech First League side Slavia Prague and the Czech Republic national team.
Jindrich Stanek.note: What separates Staněk is command of the crowded space around goal. Staněk leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders. A separate detail appears when he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Jindrich Stanek.noteZh: Jindřich Staněk的优势在于掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。最直接的表现是他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。另一个值得观察的细节是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Lukas Cerv.noteZh: Lukáš Červ最鲜明的特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。一个直接线索是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个独立细节是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Lukas Hornicek.name: Lukas Hornicek

Lukas Provod.name: Lukas Provod
Lukas Provod.summary: Lukáš Provod (born 23 October 1996) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Czech First League club Slavia Prague and the Czech Republic national team.
Lukas Provod.note: The key to Provod is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. In another phase, Provod looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.

Matej Kovar.name: Matej Kovar
Matej Kovar.summary: Matěj Kovář (born 17 May 2000) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club PSV and the Czech Republic national team. Kovář joined the Manchester United youth system in 2018, from Czech club 1. FC Slovácko.
Matej Kovar.note: For Kovář, the foundation is starting high enough to protect the space behind his defense. Look first at how he leaves his line early when a through ball escapes the back line. Beyond the first action, he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Matej Kovar.noteZh: Matěj Kovář的比赛建立在用靠前站位保护后防身后空间之上。首先看他如何在直塞球越过后防时及时出击。另一个方面是他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Mojmir Chytil.name: Mojmir Chytil
Mojmir Chytil.summary: Mojmír Chytil (born 29 April 1999) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a forward for Slavia Prague and the Czech Republic national team.

Mojmir Chytil.noteZh: Mojmír Chytil的比赛建立在让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用之上。首先看他如何牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。另一个方面是他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。

Robin Hranac.name: Robin Hranac
Robin Hranac.summary: Robin Hranáč (Czech pronunciation: [ˈɦranaːt͡ʃ], born 29 January 2000) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a defender for Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim and the Czech Republic national team.
Robin Hranac.note: The key to Hranáč is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. Elsewhere in the game, Hranáč plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.

Stepan Chaloupek.name: Stepan Chaloupek

Stepan Chaloupek.noteZh: 观察Štěpán Chaloupek时，可以先看争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。另一个比赛细节是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Tomas Chory.name: Tomas Chory

Tomas Holes.name: Tomas Holes
Tomas Holes.summary: Tomáš Holeš (born 31 March 1993) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a centre-back, right-back or defensive midfielder for Fortuna Liga club Slavia Prague and the Czech national team.
Tomas Holes.note: What separates Holeš is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. Holeš changes position while keeping his priorities simple. A separate detail appears when he steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself.
Tomas Holes.noteZh: 多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构是理解Tomáš Holeš踢法的关键。先看他如何改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。到了另一个比赛环节，他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Vladimir Coufal.name: Vladimir Coufal

Vladimir Coufal.noteZh: 封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者是理解Vladimír Coufal踢法的关键。先看他如何靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Vladimir Darida.name: Vladimir Darida
Vladimir Darida.summary: Vladimír Darida (Czech pronunciation: [ˈvlaɟɪmiːr ˈdarɪda]; born 8 August 1990) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Czech First League club Hradec Králové and for the Czech Republic national team.

Vladimir Darida.noteZh: 压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定是理解Vladimír Darida踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。到了另一个比赛环节，他会不拖延持球，把球交给下一名可接应的队友。

Alexis Vega.name: Alexis Vega
Alexis Vega.summary: Alexis Vega is a Mexico left winger from Toluca who gives the national team direct dribbling, set-piece quality, and final-third invention.
Alexis Vega.note: Vega's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Separately, he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Alexis Vega.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Alexis Vega踢法的关键。先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。到了另一个比赛环节，他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Alvaro Fidalgo.name: Alvaro Fidalgo
Alvaro Fidalgo.summary: Álvaro Fidalgo Fernández (born 9 April 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Real Betis. Born in Spain, he represents the Mexico national team.
Alvaro Fidalgo.note: The key to Fidalgo is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. A separate part of his game is how Fidalgo moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Alvaro Fidalgo.noteZh: 理解Álvaro Fidalgo，要先看压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Armando Gonzalez.name: Armando Gonzalez
Armando Gonzalez.summary: Armando González can refer to: Armando González (rowing) (1931–2022), Spanish Olympic rowing coxswain Armando González (athlete) (born 1940), Uruguayan long-distance runner Armando González (Paraguayan footballer) (fl.
Armando Gonzalez.note: González stands out for the timing of his run across the nearest defender. He attacks the near-post lane before the marker can turn. González also arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Armando Gonzalez.noteZh: 最能体现Armando González特点的是抢到近门柱身前的跑动时机。这一点直接体现在他会在盯防者转身前冲向近门柱线路。除此之外，他也会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Brian Gutierrez.name: Brian Gutierrez
Brian Gutierrez.summary: Brian Gutiérrez (born 17 June 2003) is a professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder for Liga MX club Guadalajara. Born in the United States, he represents the Mexico national team.
Brian Gutierrez.note: What separates Gutiérrez is receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. Gutiérrez opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. In another phase of play, he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Brian Gutierrez.noteZh: 最能体现Brian Gutiérrez特点的是狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。这一点直接体现在他会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。除此之外，他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Carlos Acevedo.name: Carlos Acevedo
Carlos Acevedo.summary: Carlos Acevedo López (born 19 April 1996) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Liga MX club Santos Laguna, which he captains, and the Mexico national team.
Carlos Acevedo.note: For Acevedo, the foundation is turning a save into the first pass of an attack. Look first at how he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. Separately, look at how he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Carlos Acevedo.noteZh: 观察Carlos Acevedo时，可以先看把一次扑救变成进攻第一传。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。另一个比赛细节是他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Cesar Huerta.name: Cesar Huerta
Cesar Huerta.summary: César Saúl Huerta Valera (born 3 December 2000) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a winger for Belgian Pro League club Anderlecht and the Mexico national team.
Cesar Huerta.note: Watch Huerta for changing direction without losing control of the ball. The clearest example is how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Elsewhere, Huerta changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Cesar Huerta.noteZh: 理解César Huerta，要先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Cesar Montes.name: Cesar Montes
Cesar Montes.summary: César Jasib Montes Castro (born 24 February 1997) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Russian Premier League club Lokomotiv Moscow and the Mexico national team.
Cesar Montes.note: What separates Montes is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Montes keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Away from that action, he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Cesar Montes.noteZh: 理解César Montes，要先看危险出现前组织好队友。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Erik Lira.name: Erik Lira
Erik Lira.summary: Érik Antonio Lira Méndez (born 8 May 2000) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Liga MX club Cruz Azul, which he captains, and the Mexico national team.
Erik Lira.note: The key to Lira is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. In another phase, Lira holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Erik Lira.noteZh: 看Érik Lira的作用，关键是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Gilberto Mora.name: Gilberto Mora
Gilberto Mora.summary: Gilberto Mora is a Mexico attacking midfielder from Club Tijuana who adds teenage creativity, quick feet, and central chance creation.
Gilberto Mora.note: Watch Mora for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. The clearest example is how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Also watch how Mora changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Gilberto Mora.noteZh: 最能体现Gilberto Mora特点的是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。这一点直接体现在他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。除此之外，他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Guillermo Martinez.name: Guillermo Martinez
Guillermo Martinez.summary: Guillermo Martínez Ayala (born 15 March 1995), commonly known as "Memote", is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a forward for Liga MX club Pumas and the Mexico national team.
Guillermo Martinez.note: Martínez's signature is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. Watch how he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. Away from that moment, he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Guillermo Martinez.noteZh: Guillermo Martínez最鲜明的特点是让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。一个直接线索是他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。另一个独立细节是他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Guillermo Ochoa.name: Guillermo Ochoa
Guillermo Ochoa.summary: Francisco Guillermo Ochoa Magaña (Spanish pronunciation: [ɡiˈʝeɾmo oˈtʃo.a]; born 13 July 1985), commonly known as Memo Ochoa, is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Mexico national team, best known for his performances in...
Guillermo Ochoa.note: Ochoa stands out for staying ready through long quiet spells. He keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. A different detail is how Ochoa keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled.
Guillermo Ochoa.noteZh: Guillermo Ochoa的比赛建立在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注之上。首先看他如何在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。另一个方面是他会让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。

Israel Reyes.name: Israel Reyes
Israel Reyes.summary: Israel Reyes Romero (born 23 May 2000) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a centre-back, right-back and defensive midfielder for Liga MX club América and the Mexico national team.
Israel Reyes.note: For Reyes, the foundation is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. Look first at how he changes position while keeping his priorities simple. Beyond that, watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Israel Reyes.noteZh: 看Reyes的作用，关键是多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Jesus Gallardo.name: Jesus Gallardo
Jesus Gallardo.summary: Jesús Daniel Gallardo Vasconcelos (born 15 August 1994) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left-winger for Liga MX club Toluca and the Mexico national team.
Jesus Gallardo.note: Gallardo stands out for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. A different detail is how Gallardo looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Jesus Gallardo.noteZh: 第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位是理解Jesús Gallardo踢法的关键。先看他如何提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Johan Vasquez.name: Johan Vasquez
Johan Vasquez.summary: Johan Vásquez is a Mexico centre-back from Genoa who gives the national team left-footed defending, aerial power, and Serie A-tested duels.
Johan Vasquez.note: For Vásquez, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Beyond the first action, he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Johan Vasquez.noteZh: Johan Vásquez的优势在于先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。最直接的表现是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个值得观察的细节是他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Jorge Sanchez.name: Jorge Sanchez
Jorge Sanchez.summary: Jorge Sánchez is a Mexico right-back from PAOK who adds wide defending, overlap timing, and national-team experience.
Jorge Sanchez.note: Watch Sánchez for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Also notice how Sánchez gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Jorge Sanchez.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机是理解Jorge Sánchez踢法的关键。先看他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。到了另一个比赛环节，他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Mateo Chavez.name: Mateo Chavez
Mateo Chavez.summary: Mateo Chávez García (born 12 May 2004) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Eredivisie club AZ Alkmaar and the Mexico national team.
Mateo Chavez.note: The key to Chávez is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. The next thing to watch is whether he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Mateo Chavez.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机是理解Mateo Chávez踢法的关键。先看他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个问题是，Mateo Chávez是否会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Obed Vargas.name: Obed Vargas
Obed Vargas.summary: Obed Gómez Vargas (born August 5, 2005) is a professional soccer player who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Atlético Madrid. Born in the United States, he represents the Mexico national team.
Obed Vargas.note: Vargas's signature is carrying momentum through open midfield. Watch how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Away from that moment, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Obed Vargas.noteZh: 带球穿过开放中场的推进力是理解Obed Vargas踢法的关键。先看他如何把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Orbelin Pineda.name: Orbelin Pineda
Orbelin Pineda.summary: Orbelín Pineda Alvarado (born 24 March 1996) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Super League Greece club AEK Athens and the Mexico national team.
Orbelin Pineda.note: What separates Pineda is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Pineda draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Away from that action, he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Orbelin Pineda.noteZh: Orbelín Pineda的优势在于比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。最直接的表现是他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个值得观察的细节是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Raul Rangel.name: Raul Rangel
Raul Rangel.summary: Raúl Rangel is a Mexico goalkeeper from Guadalajara who gives the national team shot-stopping depth, reflex saves, and modern distribution.
Raul Rangel.note: For Rangel, the foundation is keeping his body shape compact for reflex saves at close range. Look first at how he keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled. Beyond that, watch how he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Raul Rangel.noteZh: 理解Raúl Rangel，要先看近距离反应扑救时保持紧凑身体姿态。他会让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Roberto Alvarado.name: Roberto Alvarado
Roberto Alvarado.summary: Roberto Carlos “Piojo” Alvarado Hernández (Spanish pronunciation: [ɾɾoβˈeɾto kˈaɾlos ˌalβaɾˈaðo eɾnˈandeθ]; born 7 September 1998) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a winger for Liga MX club Guadalajara and the Mexico national team.
Roberto Alvarado.note: The key to Alvarado is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. One more thing to notice is how Alvarado changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Roberto Alvarado.noteZh: Roberto Alvarado的优势在于比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。最直接的表现是他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个值得观察的细节是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Aubrey Modiba.name: Aubrey Modiba
Aubrey Modiba.summary: Aubrey Maphosa Modiba (born 22 July 1995) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a left-midfielder and left-back for Mamelodi Sundowns in the Premier Soccer League and South Africa national team.
Aubrey Modiba.note: Modiba stands out for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. A different detail is how Modiba varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Aubrey Modiba.noteZh: 观察Aubrey Modiba时，可以先看第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。另一个比赛细节是他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Bradley Cross.name: Bradley Cross
Bradley Cross.summary: Bradley Cross is a South Africa left-back from Kaizer Chiefs who adds wide defending, left-footed balance, and recovery speed to the national team.
Bradley Cross.note: The key to Cross is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. He gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. In another phase, Cross turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Bradley Cross.noteZh: 最能体现Bradley Cross特点的是封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者。这一点直接体现在他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。除此之外，他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Evidence Makgopa.name: Evidence Makgopa
Evidence Makgopa.summary: Sekotori Evidence Makgopa (born 5 June 2000) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a forward for South African Premiership side Orlando Pirates and the South Africa national team.
Evidence Makgopa.note: What separates Makgopa is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. Makgopa pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. A separate detail appears when he starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball.
Evidence Makgopa.noteZh: Evidence Makgopa的比赛建立在让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用之上。首先看他如何牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。另一个方面是他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。

Ime Okon.name: Ime Okon
Ime Okon.summary: Ime Daniel Okon (born 20 February 2004) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Hannover 96 and the South Africa national team.
Ime Okon.note: Okon stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Another aspect is how Okon moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Ime Okon.noteZh: 理解Ime Okon，要先看压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Iqraam Rayners.name: Iqraam Rayners
Iqraam Rayners.summary: Iqraam Rayners (born 19 December 1995) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a forward for South African Premier Division side Mamelodi Sundowns and the South Africa national team.
Iqraam Rayners.note: Watch Rayners for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Also watch how Rayners meets the pass without adding an extra touch.
Iqraam Rayners.noteZh: 理解Iqraam Rayners，要先看等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会迎球直接完成射门，不增加调整触球。

Jayden Adams.name: Jayden Adams
Jayden Adams.summary: Jayden Oswin Adams (born 5 May 2001) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for South African Premiership side Mamelodi Sundowns and the South Africa national team.
Jayden Adams.note: For Adams, the foundation is carrying momentum through open midfield. Look first at how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Also watch how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Jayden Adams.noteZh: Jayden Adams的优势在于带球穿过开放中场的推进力。最直接的表现是他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Kamogelo Sebelebele.name: Kamogelo Sebelebele
Kamogelo Sebelebele.summary: Mike Kamogelo Sebelebele (born 21 July 2002) is a South African soccer player who plays as a winger for South African Premiership side Orlando Pirates and the South Africa national team.
Kamogelo Sebelebele.note: Sebelebele's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Watch how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Separately, he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over.
Kamogelo Sebelebele.noteZh: 理解Kamogelo Sebelebele，要先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。

Khuliso Mudau.name: Khuliso Mudau
Khuliso Mudau.summary: Khuliso Johnson Mudau also known as Sailorman (born 26 April 1995) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a right back for Betway Premiership club Mamelodi Sundowns and the South Africa national team.
Khuliso Mudau.note: What separates Mudau is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Mudau waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. A separate detail appears when he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Khuliso Mudau.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机构成Khuliso Mudau踢法的核心。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，值得留意他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Khulumani Ndamane.name: Khulumani Ndamane
Khulumani Ndamane.summary: Khulumani Ndamane (born 5 February 2004) is a South African soccer player who plays as a central defender for South African Premiership side Mamelodi Sundowns and the South Africa national team.
Khulumani Ndamane.note: The key to Ndamane is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself. Elsewhere in the game, Ndamane takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Khulumani Ndamane.noteZh: 争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹是理解Khulumani Ndamane踢法的关键。先看他如何迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Mbekezeli Mbokazi.name: Mbekezeli Mbokazi
Mbekezeli Mbokazi.summary: Mbekezeli Mfanufikile Mbokazi also known as TLB (born 19 September 2005) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Major League Soccer side Chicago Fire and the South Africa national team.
Mbekezeli Mbokazi.note: Mbokazi's signature is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Watch how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes. He also keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Mbekezeli Mbokazi.noteZh: Mbekezeli Mbokazi的比赛建立在用传球的力度和角度移动防线之上。首先看他如何在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。另一个方面是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Nkosinathi Sibisi.name: Nkosinathi Sibisi
Nkosinathi Sibisi.summary: Nkosinathi Emmanuel Sibisi (born 22 September 1995) is a South African soccer player who plays as a defender for South African Premier Division side Orlando Pirates, whom he captains, and the South Africa national team.
Nkosinathi Sibisi.note: What separates Sibisi is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Sibisi holds the route into the box until support arrives. A separate detail appears when he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Nkosinathi Sibisi.noteZh: Nkosinathi Sibisi最鲜明的特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。一个直接线索是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个独立细节是他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Olwethu Makhanya.name: Olwethu Makhanya
Olwethu Makhanya.summary: Olwethu Mpilwenhle Makhanya (born 30 April 2004) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a defender for the Philadelphia Union of Major League Soccer and the South Africa national team.
Olwethu Makhanya.note: Watch Makhanya for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. The clearest example is how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. A separate question is whether Makhanya waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Olwethu Makhanya.noteZh: Olwethu Makhanya的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。换到另一个阶段，要看他是否会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Oswin Appollis.name: Oswin Appollis
Oswin Appollis.summary: Oswin Reagan Appollis (born 25 August 2001) is a South African soccer player who currently plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for South African Premiership club Orlando Pirates and the South Africa national team.
Oswin Appollis.note: Appollis stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Appollis also plays forward toward an available runner when the opening appears.
Oswin Appollis.noteZh: 观察Oswin Reagan Appollis时，可以先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个比赛细节是他会线路出现时向前送给可接应的跑动者。

Relebohile Mofokeng.name: Relebohile Mofokeng
Relebohile Mofokeng.summary: Relebohile Mofokeng (né Ratomo; born 23 October 2004) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Orlando Pirates and the South Africa national team.
Relebohile Mofokeng.note: For Mofokeng, the foundation is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Look first at how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Separately, look at how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Relebohile Mofokeng.noteZh: 观察Relebohile Mofokeng时，可以先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个比赛细节是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Ricardo Goss.name: Ricardo Goss
Ricardo Goss.summary: Stuart Ricardo Goss (born 2 April 1994) is a South African soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for South African Premier Division club SuperSport United on loan from Mamelodi Sundowns and the South Africa national team.
Ricardo Goss.note: The key to Goss is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. One more thing to notice is how Goss sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Ricardo Goss.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友是理解Ricardo Goss踢法的关键。先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。到了另一个比赛环节，他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Samukele Kabini.name: Samukele Kabini
Samukele Kabini.summary: Samukele Alucious Kabini (born 15 March 2004) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Eliteserien club Molde FK and the South Africa national team.
Samukele Kabini.note: The key to Kabini is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. In another phase, Kabini gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Samukele Kabini.noteZh: 最能体现Samukele Kabini特点的是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。除此之外，他也会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Sipho Chaine.name: Sipho Chaine
Sipho Chaine.summary: Sipho Justin Chaine (born 14 December 1996) is a South African soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Orlando Pirates in the South African Premier Division and the South Africa national team.
Sipho Chaine.note: Watch Chaine for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. The clearest example is how he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. Also notice how Chaine keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Sipho Chaine.noteZh: Sipho Chaine最鲜明的特点是提前站位后的快速反应。一个直接线索是他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。另一个独立细节是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Sphephelo Sithole.name: Sphephelo Sithole
Sphephelo Sithole.summary: Sphephelo S'Miso "Yaya" Sithole (born 3 March 1999) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Primeira Liga club CD Tondela and the South Africa national team.
Sphephelo Sithole.note: Sithole stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. In a separate phase, Sithole uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Sphephelo Sithole.noteZh: 观察Sphephelo Sithole时，可以先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Thabang Matuludi.name: Thabang Matuludi
Thabang Matuludi.summary: Tholo Thabang Matuludi (born 14 January 1999) is a South African soccer player who plays as a right back for Polokwane City in the Premier Soccer League and the South Africa national team.
Thabang Matuludi.note: What separates Matuludi is staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. Matuludi checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. Also note how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Thabang Matuludi.noteZh: Thabang Matuludi的比赛建立在球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动之上。首先看他如何在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。另一个方面是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Thalente Mbatha.name: Thalente Mbatha
Thalente Mbatha.summary: Thalente Wandile Mbatha (born 6 March 2000) is a South African soccer player who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier Soccer League side Orlando Pirates and the South Africa national team. Mbatha scored on his international debut in 2024 against Uganda.
Thalente Mbatha.note: For Mbatha, the foundation is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Look first at how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate point is how he moves the ball to the next available teammate without holding it.
Thalente Mbatha.noteZh: 理解Thalente Mbatha，要先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会不拖延持球，把球交给下一名可接应的队友。

Thapelo Maseko.name: Thapelo Maseko
Thapelo Maseko.summary: Thapelo Maseko (born 11 November 2003) is a South African professional soccer player who plays as a forward for Mamelodi Sundowns and the South Africa national team.
Thapelo Maseko.note: Maseko's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. Watch how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Separately, he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Thapelo Maseko.noteZh: 观察Thapelo Maseko时，可以先看看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个比赛细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Themba Zwane.name: Themba Zwane
Themba Zwane.summary: Themba Zwane (born 3 August 1989), also known as Mshishi, is a South African professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder for Premier Soccer League club Mamelodi Sundowns and the South Africa national team.
Themba Zwane.note: For Zwane, the foundation is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Look first at how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Also watch how he opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Themba Zwane.noteZh: Themba Zwane最鲜明的特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。一个直接线索是他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个独立细节是他会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Tshepang Moremi.name: Tshepang Moremi
Tshepang Moremi.summary: Tshepang Moremi (born 2 October 2000) is a South African soccer player who plays as a winger for Premier Soccer League club Orlando Pirates and the South Africa national team.
Tshepang Moremi.note: Moremi's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Another detail is how he plays forward toward an available runner when the opening appears.
Tshepang Moremi.noteZh: 观察Tshepang Moremi时，可以先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个比赛细节是他会线路出现时向前送给可接应的跑动者。

Jens Castrop.name: Jens Castrop
Jens Castrop.summary: Jens Castrop is a South Korea central midfielder from Borussia Mönchengladbach who adds Bundesliga intensity, duel pressure, and two-way running.
Jens Castrop.note: Castrop's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Watch how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. At another point in the move, he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Jens Castrop.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Jens Castrop踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Bae Jun-ho.name: Bae Jun-ho
Bae Jun-ho.summary: Bae Jun-ho is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Stoke City who adds half-turn receiving, tight-space passing, and final-third invention.
Bae Jun-ho.note: Watch Bae for receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. The clearest example is how he opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. In a different phase, Bae draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Bae Jun-ho.noteZh: 狭小空间接球前就想好下一步是理解Bae Jun-ho踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。到了另一个比赛环节，他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Cho Gue-sung.name: Cho Gue-sung
Cho Gue-sung.summary: Cho Gue-sung is a South Korea centre-forward from FC Midtjylland who gives the national team aerial presence, hold-up play, and penalty-box finishing.
Cho Gue-sung.note: Cho stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. Another aspect is how Cho protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Cho Gue-sung.noteZh: 看Cho Gue-sung的作用，关键是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Cho Wi-je.name: Cho Wi-je
Cho Wi-je.summary: Cho Wi-je is a South Korea centre-back from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors who adds size, man-marking, and aerial defending to the squad.
Cho Wi-je.note: The key to Cho is staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. A separate part of his game is how Cho moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Cho Wi-je.noteZh: 球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动构成Cho Wi-je踢法的核心。他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。除此之外，值得留意他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Eom Ji-sung.name: Eom Ji-sung
Eom Ji-sung.summary: Eom Ji-sung is a South Korea winger from Swansea City who adds one-on-one dribbling, inside carries, and bench attacking tempo.
Eom Ji-sung.note: Watch Eom for changing direction without losing control of the ball. The clearest example is how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Elsewhere, Eom uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Eom Ji-sung.noteZh: Eom Ji-sung的优势在于变向时仍把球控制在脚下。最直接的表现是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Hwang Hee-chan.name: Hwang Hee-chan
Hwang Hee-chan.summary: Hwang Hee-chan is a South Korea forward from Wolverhampton Wanderers who adds explosive pressing, channel running, and direct penalty-box threat.
Hwang Hee-chan.note: Hwang's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. Watch how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He also moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Hwang Hee-chan.noteZh: 最能体现Hwang Hee-chan特点的是看到空当后的爆发速度。这一点直接体现在他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。除此之外，他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Hwang In-beom.name: Hwang In-beom
Hwang In-beom.summary: Hwang In-beom is a South Korea midfielder from Feyenoord who gives the national team build-up passing, pressure resistance, and set-piece quality.
Hwang In-beom.note: What separates Hwang is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Hwang plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. At another point, he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Hwang In-beom.noteZh: Hwang In-beom的优势在于用传球的力度和角度移动防线。最直接的表现是他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。另一个值得观察的细节是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Jo Hyeon-woo.name: Jo Hyeon-woo
Jo Hyeon-woo.summary: Jo Hyeon-woo is a South Korea goalkeeper from Ulsan HD who adds reflex saves, tournament experience, and command of the box.
Jo Hyeon-woo.note: Jo stands out for keeping his body shape compact for reflex saves at close range. He keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled. Jo also leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Jo Hyeon-woo.noteZh: 理解Jo Hyeon-woo，要先看近距离反应扑救时保持紧凑身体姿态。他会让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Kim Jin-gyu.name: Kim Jin-gyu
Kim Jin-gyu.summary: Kim Jin-gyu is a South Korea central midfielder from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors who adds simple circulation, late support, and domestic rhythm.
Kim Jin-gyu.note: For Kim, the foundation is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Look first at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. A separate point is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Kim Jin-gyu.noteZh: 压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定是理解Kim Jin-gyu踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。到了另一个比赛环节，他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Kim Moon-hwan.name: Kim Moon-hwan
Kim Moon-hwan.summary: Kim Moon-hwan is a South Korea right-back from Daejeon Hana Citizen who adds overlap timing, wide defending, and tournament experience.
Kim Moon-hwan.note: The key to Kim is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Elsewhere in the game, Kim gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Kim Moon-hwan.noteZh: 最能体现Kim Moon-hwan特点的是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。这一点直接体现在他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，他也会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Kim Seung-gyu.name: Kim Seung-gyu
Kim Seung-gyu.summary: Kim Seung-gyu is a South Korea goalkeeper from FC Tokyo who brings experience, distribution, and shot-stopping command.
Kim Seung-gyu.note: Watch Kim for turning a save into the first pass of an attack. The clearest example is how he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. Elsewhere, Kim keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Kim Seung-gyu.noteZh: 看Kim Seung-gyu的作用，关键是把一次扑救变成进攻第一传。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Kim Tae-hyeon.name: Kim Tae-hyeon
Kim Tae-hyeon.summary: Kim Tae-hyeon is a South Korea defender from Kashima Antlers who adds left-footed centre-back cover, recovery defending, and aerial strength.
Kim Tae-hyeon.note: Kim stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. Kim also meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Kim Tae-hyeon.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Kim Tae-hyeon踢法的关键。先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Lee Dong-gyeong.name: Lee Dong-gyeong
Lee Dong-gyeong.summary: Lee Dong-gyeong is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Ulsan HD who adds left-footed passing, shooting range, and between-lines creativity.
Lee Dong-gyeong.note: For Lee, the foundation is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Look first at how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Beyond that, watch how he plays the available pass with his left foot.
Lee Dong-gyeong.noteZh: Lee Dong-gyeong的比赛建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球之上。首先看他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个方面是他会用左脚送出眼前可行的传球。

Lee Gi-hyuk.name: Lee Gi-hyuk
Lee Gi-hyuk.summary: Lee Gi-hyuk is a South Korea defender from Gangwon FC who adds left-footed centre-back play, composure, and flexible build-up options.
Lee Gi-hyuk.note: Lee's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Away from that moment, he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Lee Gi-hyuk.noteZh: 最能体现Lee Gi-hyuk特点的是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。这一点直接体现在他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Lee Han-beom.name: Lee Han-beom
Lee Han-beom.summary: Lee Han-beom is a South Korea centre-back from FC Midtjylland who adds European experience, aerial defending, and recovery power.

Lee Han-beom.noteZh: Lee Han-beom的比赛建立在第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位之上。首先看他如何提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Lee Jae-sung.name: Lee Jae-sung
Lee Jae-sung.summary: Lee Jae-sung is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Mainz 05 who adds pressing intelligence, link play, and late box arrivals.
Lee Jae-sung.note: Watch Lee for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Also notice how Lee angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Lee Jae-sung.noteZh: Lee Jae-sung的优势在于等防守者注意力转移后再启动。最直接的表现是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Lee Tae-seok.name: Lee Tae-seok
Lee Tae-seok.summary: Lee Tae-seok is a South Korea left-back from Austria Wien who adds width, crossing range, and progressive carries down the flank.
Lee Tae-seok.note: Lee stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Also look at how Lee looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Lee Tae-seok.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下构成Lee Tae-seok踢法的核心。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。除此之外，值得留意他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Oh Hyeon-gyu.name: Oh Hyeon-gyu
Oh Hyeon-gyu.summary: Oh Hyeon-gyu is a South Korea centre-forward from Beşiktaş who adds strength, penalty-box movement, and direct finishing.

Oh Hyeon-gyu.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动是理解Oh Hyeon-gyu踢法的关键。先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。到了另一个比赛环节，他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Paik Seung-ho.name: Paik Seung-ho
Paik Seung-ho.summary: Paik Seung-ho is a South Korea central midfielder from Birmingham City who adds deep passing, tempo control, and ball-winning balance.

Park Jin-seob.name: Park Jin-seob
Park Jin-seob.summary: Park Jin-seob is a South Korea defensive midfielder from Zhejiang FC who adds screening, centre-back cover, and aerial bite.
Park Jin-seob.note: The key to Park is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. There is another side to his game: he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Park Jin-seob.noteZh: Park Jin-seob最鲜明的特点是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。一个直接线索是他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。另一个独立细节是他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Seol Young-woo.name: Seol Young-woo
Seol Young-woo.summary: Seol Young-woo is a South Korea right-back from Red Star Belgrade who adds two-sided full-back cover, recovery speed, and attacking support.
Seol Young-woo.note: What separates Seol is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. Seol changes position while keeping his priorities simple. At another point, he turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Seol Young-woo.noteZh: 理解Seol Young-woo，要先看多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Song Bum-keun.name: Song Bum-keun
Song Bum-keun.summary: Song Bum-keun is a South Korea goalkeeper from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors who adds shot-stopping depth, size, and domestic rhythm.
Song Bum-keun.note: Watch Song in two moments. First, check whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. Then watch whether he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Song Bum-keun.noteZh: 观察Song Bum-keun时，可以看两个时刻。先看他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。再看他是否会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Yang Hyun-jun.name: Yang Hyun-jun
Yang Hyun-jun.summary: Yang Hyun-jun is a South Korea winger from Celtic who adds direct dribbling, right-side speed, and one-on-one pressure.

Alan Franco.name: Alan Franco
Alan Franco.summary: Alan Steven Franco Palma (born 21 August 1998) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Atlético Mineiro and the Ecuador national team.
Alan Franco.note: For Franco, the foundation is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Look first at how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Beyond the first action, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Alan Franco.noteZh: Alan Franco的优势在于选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。最直接的表现是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Alan Minda.name: Alan Minda

Alan Minda.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Alan Minda踢法的关键。先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。到了另一个比赛环节，他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Angelo Preciado.name: Angelo Preciado
Angelo Preciado.summary: Ángelo Smit Preciado Quiñónez (born 18 February 1998) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a right-back or winger for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Atlético Mineiro and the Ecuador national team.
Angelo Preciado.note: What separates Preciado is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Preciado waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. A separate detail appears when he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Angelo Preciado.noteZh: 理解Ángelo Preciado，要先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Anthony Valencia.name: Anthony Valencia

Anthony Valencia.noteZh: Anthony Valencia的比赛建立在带球穿过开放中场的推进力之上。首先看他如何把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。另一个方面是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Denil Castillo.name: Denil Castillo

Felix Torres.name: Felix Torres
Felix Torres.summary: Félix Eduardo Torres Caicedo (born 11 January 1997) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Campeonato Brasileiro Serie A club Internacional on loan from Corinthians and the Ecuador national team.

Gonzalo Plata.name: Gonzalo Plata

Gonzalo Valle.name: Gonzalo Valle
Gonzalo Valle.summary: Gonzalo Roberto Valle Bustamante (born 28 February 1996) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ecuadorian Serie A side L.D.U. Quito and the Ecuador national team.

Hernan Galindez.name: Hernan Galindez
