Leroy Sane.noteZh: 防线重组前制造干净射门是理解Leroy Sané踢法的关键。先看他如何把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。到了另一个比赛环节，他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Malick Thiaw.name: Malick Thiaw
Malick Thiaw.summary: Malick Laye Thiaw (German pronunciation: [ˈmalɪk ˈtʃaʊ] CHOW; born 8 August 2001) is a German professional footballer who plays as a defender for Premier League club Newcastle United and the Germany national team.
Malick Thiaw.note: The key to Thiaw is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. A separate part of his game is how Thiaw moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Malick Thiaw.noteZh: Malick Thiaw的优势在于防线暴露后的回追速度。最直接的表现是他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。另一个值得观察的细节是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Manuel Neuer.name: Manuel Neuer
Manuel Neuer.summary: Manuel Peter Neuer (German pronunciation: [ˈmaːnu̯eːl ˈnɔʏ.ɐ, -ɛl -]; born 27 March 1986) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club Bayern Munich, which he captains, and the Germany national team.
Manuel Neuer.note: What separates Neuer is starting high enough to protect the space behind his defense. Neuer leaves his line early when a through ball escapes the back line. Away from that action, he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Manuel Neuer.noteZh: Manuel Neuer的比赛建立在用靠前站位保护后防身后空间之上。首先看他如何在直塞球越过后防时及时出击。另一个方面是他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Maximilian Beier.name: Maximilian Beier
Maximilian Beier.summary: Maximilian Beier (German pronunciation: [maksɪˈmiːli̯an ˈbaɪ̯ɐ]; born 17 October 2002) is a German professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for Bundesliga club Borussia Dortmund and the Germany national team.
Maximilian Beier.note: Beier's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. Watch how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Separately, he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Maximilian Beier.noteZh: 看到空当后的爆发速度是理解Maximilian Beier踢法的关键。先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。到了另一个比赛环节，他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Nadiem Amiri.name: Nadiem Amiri
Nadiem Amiri.summary: Nadiem Amiri (Persian Dari: ندیم امیری; born 27 October 1996) is a German professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club Mainz 05 and the Germany national team.
Nadiem Amiri.note: Watch Amiri for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. The clearest example is how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Also notice how Amiri varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Nadiem Amiri.noteZh: 观察Nadiem Amiri时，可以先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个比赛细节是他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Nick Woltemade.name: Nick Woltemade
Nick Woltemade.summary: Nick Woltemade (German pronunciation: [nɪk ˈvɔltəˌmaːdə]; born 14 February 2002) is a German professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for Premier League club Newcastle United and the Germany national team.
Nick Woltemade.note: For Woltemade, the foundation is making the next teammate's action easier. Look first at how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. A separate point is how he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Nick Woltemade.noteZh: 最能体现Nick Woltemade特点的是让队友下一步处理更轻松。这一点直接体现在他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。除此之外，他也会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Oliver Baumann.name: Oliver Baumann
Oliver Baumann.summary: Oliver Baumann (German pronunciation: [ˈɔlivɐ ˈbaʊman]; born 2 June 1990) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim, where he is also captain, and the Germany national team.
Oliver Baumann.note: Baumann stands out for protecting the centre before the shooter reveals the finish. He sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot. A different detail is how Baumann keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Oliver Baumann.noteZh: 最能体现Oliver Baumann特点的是射手暴露射门方向前先守住球门中央。这一点直接体现在他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。除此之外，他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Waldemar Anton.name: Waldemar Anton
Waldemar Anton.summary: Waldemar Anton (German pronunciation: [ˈvaldemaːʁ ˈantɔn]; born 20 July 1996) is a German professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Borussia Dortmund and the Germany national team.
Waldemar Anton.note: For Anton, the foundation is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. Look first at how he changes position while keeping his priorities simple. Beyond that, watch how he protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Waldemar Anton.noteZh: 观察Waldemar Anton时，可以先看多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。另一个比赛细节是他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Pascal Groß.name: Pascal Groß
Pascal Groß.summary: Pascal Groß is a Germany central midfielder from Brighton & Hove Albion who adds passing range, set-piece quality, and veteran control.
Pascal Groß.note: Watch Groß for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. The clearest example is how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. In a different phase, Groß varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Pascal Groß.noteZh: Pascal Groß的比赛建立在用传球的力度和角度移动防线之上。首先看他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。另一个方面是他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Arjany Martha.name: Arjany Martha
Arjany Martha.summary: The Curaçao national football team (Dutch: Curaçaos voetbalelftal; Papiamento: selekshon di futbòl Kòrsou) represents Curaçao in men's international football. The team is governed by the Federashon Futbòl Kòrsou.
Arjany Martha.note: Watch Martha for changing direction without losing control of the ball. The clearest example is how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. A separate clue is how Martha changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Arjany Martha.noteZh: 观察Ar'jany Martha时，可以先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个比赛细节是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Armando Obispo.name: Armando Obispo
Armando Obispo.summary: Armando Obispo (born 5 March 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for PSV Eindhoven. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.
Armando Obispo.note: Obispo stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. A different detail is how Obispo plays the available pass with his left foot.
Armando Obispo.noteZh: Armando Obispo的比赛建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定之上。首先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。另一个方面是他会用左脚送出眼前可行的传球。

Brandley Kuwas.name: Brandley Kuwas
Brandley Kuwas.summary: Brandley Mack-Olien Kuwas (born 19 September 1992) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Eerste Divisie club Volendam. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.
Brandley Kuwas.note: What separates Kuwas is delivering the ball without needing much space. Kuwas looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. In another phase of play, he varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Brandley Kuwas.noteZh: 很小空间里也能送出传中的能力是理解Brandley Kuwas踢法的关键。先看他如何在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。到了另一个比赛环节，他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Deveron Fonville.name: Deveron Fonville
Deveron Fonville.summary: Deveron Fonville (born 16 May 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Eredivisie club NEC Nijmegen. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.
Deveron Fonville.note: Fonville's signature is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. Watch how he turns early and protects the route toward goal. Away from that moment, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Deveron Fonville.noteZh: 第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位是理解Deveron Fonville踢法的关键。先看他如何提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Eloy Room.name: Eloy Room
Eloy Room.summary: Eloy Victor Room (born 6 February 1989) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for USL Championship club Miami FC. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.
Eloy Room.note: Watch Room for staying ready through long quiet spells. The clearest example is how he keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. In a different phase, Room leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Eloy Room.noteZh: 长时间无事可做后依然保持专注构成Eloy Room踢法的核心。他会在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。除此之外，值得留意他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Gervane Kastaneer.name: Gervane Kastaneer
Gervane Kastaneer.summary: Gervane Zjandric Adonnis Kastaneer (born 9 June 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Malaysia Super League club Terengganu. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.
Gervane Kastaneer.note: The key to Kastaneer is using strength without slowing the next action. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. Elsewhere in the game, Kastaneer changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Gervane Kastaneer.noteZh: 理解Gervane Kastaneer，要先看对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Godfried Roemeratoe.name: Godfried Roemeratoe
Godfried Roemeratoe.summary: Godfried Roemeratoe (born 19 August 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or right-back for Eerste Divisie club RKC Waalwijk. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.
Godfried Roemeratoe.note: Roemeratoe stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Also look at how Roemeratoe holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Godfried Roemeratoe.noteZh: 看Godfried Roemeratoe的作用，关键是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Jearl Margaritha.name: Jearl Margaritha

Jearl Margaritha.note: For Margaritha, the foundation is explosive speed once open grass appears. Look first at how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Beyond that, watch how he uses a clean first touch to open a shooting lane from distance.
Jearl Margaritha.noteZh: Jearl Margaritha的比赛建立在看到空当后的爆发速度之上。首先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个方面是他会用干净的第一脚触球打开远射线路。

Jeremy Antonisse.name: Jeremy Antonisse

Joshua Brenet.name: Joshua Brenet

Joshua Brenet.note: What separates Brenet is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Brenet waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. In another phase of play, he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Joshua Brenet.noteZh: Joshua Brenet的优势在于从后场加入进攻的启动时机。最直接的表现是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个值得观察的细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Juergen Locadia.name: Juergen Locadia

Juergen Locadia.noteZh: 观察Jürgen Locadia时，可以先看对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。另一个比赛细节是他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Jurien Gaari.name: Jurien Gaari

Kenji Gorre.name: Kenji Gorre

Kevin Felida.name: Kevin Felida
Kevin Felida.summary: Kevin Felida (born 11 November 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Eerste Divisie club Den Bosch. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.
Kevin Felida.note: Watch Felida for reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. The clearest example is how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. Elsewhere, Felida holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Kevin Felida.noteZh: Kevin Felida最鲜明的特点是对抗后球权松动时的第一反应。一个直接线索是他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。另一个独立细节是他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Riechedly Bazoer.name: Riechedly Bazoer
Riechedly Bazoer.summary: Riechedly Guillermo Bazoer (born 12 October 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or defensive midfielder for Turkish club Konyaspor. Born in the Netherlands, he represents the Curaçao national team.
Riechedly Bazoer.note: For Bazoer, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Beyond the first action, he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Riechedly Bazoer.noteZh: 观察Riechedly Bazoer时，可以先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个比赛细节是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Sherel Floranus.name: Sherel Floranus
Sherel Floranus.summary: Sherel Floranus (born 23 August 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.

Shurandy Sambo.name: Shurandy Sambo

Sontje Hansen.name: Sontje Hansen
Sontje Hansen.summary: Misjonne Juniffer Naigelino "Sontje" Hansen (born 18 May 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Middlesbrough. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.
Sontje Hansen.note: Hansen's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Watch how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He also changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Sontje Hansen.noteZh: Sontje Hansen最鲜明的特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。一个直接线索是他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个独立细节是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Trevor Doornbusch.name: Trevor Doornbusch
Trevor Doornbusch.summary: Trevor Irving Doornbusch (born 6 July 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eerste Divisie club VVV-Venlo. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.
Trevor Doornbusch.note: What separates Doornbusch is command of the crowded space around goal. Doornbusch leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders. Away from that action, he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.

Tyrese Noslin.name: Tyrese Noslin
Tyrese Noslin.summary: Tyrese Noslin (born 11 September 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right midfielder for Eredivisie club Telstar. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.
Tyrese Noslin.note: The key to Noslin is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Elsewhere in the game, Noslin draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Tyrese Noslin.noteZh: 看Tyrese Noslin的作用，关键是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Tyrick Bodak.name: Tyrick Bodak
Tyrick Bodak.summary: Tyrick Bodak (born 15 May 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club Telstar. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.
Tyrick Bodak.note: What separates Bodak is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. Bodak sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. In another phase, watch whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Tyrick Bodak.noteZh: Tyrick Bodak的优势在于提前站位后的快速反应。最直接的表现是他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。想看得更完整，还要观察他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Roshon van Eijma.name: Roshon van Eijma
Roshon van Eijma.summary: Róshón Felix Romar Jordan van Eijma (born 9 June 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eerste Divisie club RKC Waalwijk. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.
Roshon van Eijma.note: For van Eijma, the foundation is staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. Look first at how he checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. Beyond the first action, he steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself.
Roshon van Eijma.noteZh: 看Roshon van Eijma的作用，关键是球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动。他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Alban Lafont.name: Alban Lafont
Alban Lafont.summary: Alban-Marc Lafont (born 23 January 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as goalkeeper for Ligue 2 club Nantes. Born in Burkina Faso and raised in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Alban Lafont.note: The key to Lafont is command of the crowded space around goal. He leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders. There is another side to his game: he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Alban Lafont.noteZh: Alban Lafont最鲜明的特点是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。一个直接线索是他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。另一个独立细节是他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Ange-Yoan Bonny.name: Ange-Yoan Bonny
Ange-Yoan Bonny.summary: Ange-Yoan Bonny is a Côte d'Ivoire centre-forward at Inter Milan who gives the national team hold-up play, box presence, and power running.
Ange-Yoan Bonny.note: Bonny's signature is making the next teammate's action easier. Watch how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. Another detail is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Ange-Yoan Bonny.noteZh: 最能体现Ange-Yoan Bonny特点的是让队友下一步处理更轻松。这一点直接体现在他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。除此之外，他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Bazoumana Toure.name: Bazoumana Toure
Bazoumana Toure.summary: Bazoumana Touré (born 2 March 2006) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a winger for German Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim and the Ivory Coast national team.
Bazoumana Toure.note: The key to Touré is carrying momentum through open midfield. He pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. One more thing to notice is how Touré changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Bazoumana Toure.noteZh: 看Bazoumana Touré的作用，关键是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Christ Inao Oulai.name: Christ Inao Oulai
Christ Inao Oulai.summary: Christ Ravynel Inao Oulaï (born 6 April 2006) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Trabzonspor and the Ivory Coast national team.
Christ Inao Oulai.note: What separates Oulaï is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Oulaï takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Away from that action, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Christ Inao Oulai.noteZh: 理解Christ Inao Oulaï，要先看用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Christopher Operi.name: Christopher Operi
Christopher Operi.summary: Christopher Téa Opéri (born 29 April 1997) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Süper Lig club İstanbul Başakşehir and the Ivory Coast national team.
Christopher Operi.note: Watch Opéri for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Elsewhere, Opéri turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Christopher Operi.noteZh: Christopher Opéri最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Elye Wahi.name: Elye Wahi
Elye Wahi.summary: Sepe Elye Delmas Wahi (born 2 January 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Nice, on loan from Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Elye Wahi.note: Wahi's signature is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. Watch how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. Separately, he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Elye Wahi.noteZh: 观察Elye Wahi时，可以先看防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。另一个比赛细节是他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Emmanuel Agbadou.name: Emmanuel Agbadou
Emmanuel Agbadou.summary: Badobre Emmanuel Elysee Djedje Agbadou (born 17 June 1997) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club Beşiktaş and the Ivory Coast national team.
Emmanuel Agbadou.note: Agbadou stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Another aspect is how Agbadou waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Emmanuel Agbadou.noteZh: Emmanuel Agbadou最鲜明的特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。一个直接线索是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。另一个独立细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Evan Ndicka.name: Evan Ndicka
Evan Ndicka.summary: Obite Evan Ndicka (born 20 August 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Roma. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Evan Ndicka.note: For Ndicka, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Beyond that, watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Evan Ndicka.noteZh: 理解Evan Ndicka，要先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Ghislain Konan.name: Ghislain Konan
Ghislain Konan.summary: Ghislain N'Clomande Konan (born 27 December 1995) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Primeira Liga club Gil Vicente and the Ivory Coast national team.
Ghislain Konan.note: The key to Konan is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. He gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. A separate part of his game is how Konan waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Ghislain Konan.noteZh: 封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者构成Ghislain Konan踢法的核心。他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。除此之外，值得留意他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Guela Doue.name: Guela Doue
Guela Doue.summary: Guéla Maho Lewis Doué (born 17 October 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Guela Doue.note: Doué stands out for closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. He gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. Doué also waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Guela Doue.noteZh: 观察Guéla Doué时，可以先看封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者。他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。另一个比赛细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Ibrahim Sangare.name: Ibrahim Sangare
Ibrahim Sangare.summary: Ibrahim Sangaré (born 2 December 1997) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Nottingham Forest and the Ivory Coast national team.
Ibrahim Sangare.note: For Sangaré, the foundation is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Look first at how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Beyond that, watch how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Ibrahim Sangare.noteZh: 理解Ibrahim Sangaré，要先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Jean Michael Seri.name: Jean Michael Seri
Jean Michael Seri.summary: Jean Michaël Seri (born 19 July 1991) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Slovenian PrvaLiga club Maribor and the Ivory Coast national team.
Jean Michael Seri.note: Seri's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. At another point in the move, he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Jean Michael Seri.noteZh: 理解Jean Michaël Seri，要先看压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Mohamed Kone.name: Mohamed Kone
Mohamed Kone.summary: Mohamed Koné (born 7 March 2002) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Belgian club Charleroi and the Ivory Coast national team.
Mohamed Kone.note: What separates Koné is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. Koné sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. At another point, he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Mohamed Kone.noteZh: 提前站位后的快速反应构成Mohamed Koné踢法的核心。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。除此之外，值得留意他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Nicolas Pepe.name: Nicolas Pepe
Nicolas Pepe.summary: Nicolas Pépé (born 29 May 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger or forward for La Liga club Villarreal. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Nicolas Pepe.note: Watch Pépé for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. The clearest example is how he shifts onto his left foot and shoots with little backlift. In a different phase, Pépé moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Nicolas Pepe.noteZh: 最能体现Nicolas Pépé特点的是防线重组前制造干净射门。这一点直接体现在他会把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。除此之外，他也会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Odilon Kossounou.name: Odilon Kossounou
Odilon Kossounou.summary: Kouakou Odilon Dorgeless Kossounou ([ɔdilɔ̃ kɔsunu]; born 4 January 2001), better known as Odilon Kossounou, is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Atalanta and the Ivory Coast national team.
Odilon Kossounou.note: The key to Kossounou is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. There is another side to his game: he changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Odilon Kossounou.noteZh: Odilon Kossounou最鲜明的特点是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。一个直接线索是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。另一个独立细节是他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Oumar Diakite.name: Oumar Diakite
Oumar Diakite.summary: Oumar Diakité (born 20 December 2003) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Belgian Pro League club Cercle Brugge, on loan from Ligue 2 club Reims, and the Ivory Coast national team.
Oumar Diakite.note: Diakité's signature is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Watch how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Separately, he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Oumar Diakite.noteZh: 理解Oumar Diakité，要先看等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Ousmane Diomande.name: Ousmane Diomande
Ousmane Diomande.summary: Ousmane Diomande (born 4 December 2003) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Primeira Liga club Sporting CP and the Ivory Coast national team.
Ousmane Diomande.note: Watch Diomande for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. The clearest example is how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes. In a different phase, Diomande waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ousmane Diomande.noteZh: Ousmane Diomande的优势在于用传球的力度和角度移动防线。最直接的表现是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。另一个值得观察的细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Parfait Guiagon.name: Parfait Guiagon
Parfait Guiagon.summary: Parfait Guiagon is a Côte d'Ivoire left winger at Charleroi who gives the national team tight-space dribbling, left-side creativity, and quick combinations.
Parfait Guiagon.note: Guiagon stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. A different detail is how Guiagon uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Parfait Guiagon.noteZh: 看Parfait Guiagon的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Seko Fofana.name: Seko Fofana
Seko Fofana.summary: Seko Mohamed Fofana (born 7 May 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Primeira Liga club Porto, on loan from Ligue 1 club Rennes. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Seko Fofana.note: For Fofana, the foundation is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Look first at how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Beyond that, watch how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over.
Seko Fofana.noteZh: 最能体现Seko Fofana特点的是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。这一点直接体现在他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。除此之外，他也会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。

Wilfried Singo.name: Wilfried Singo
Wilfried Singo.summary: Wilfried Stephane Singo (born 25 December 2000) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Süper Lig club Galatasaray and the Ivory Coast national team.
Wilfried Singo.note: What separates Singo is using strength without slowing the next action. Singo absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. At another point, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Wilfried Singo.noteZh: Wilfried Singo的比赛建立在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步之上。首先看他如何承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Yahia Fofana.name: Yahia Fofana
Yahia Fofana.summary: Yahia Fofana (born 21 August 2000) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Süper Lig club Çaykur Rizespor. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.
Yahia Fofana.note: Watch Fofana for command of the crowded space around goal. The clearest example is how he attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. In a different phase, Fofana chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Yahia Fofana.noteZh: 看Yahia Fofana的作用，关键是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Yan Diomande.name: Yan Diomande
Yan Diomande.summary: Yan Diomande (born 14 November 2006) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Ivory Coast national team.
Yan Diomande.note: Diomande's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Away from that moment, he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Yan Diomande.noteZh: Yan Diomande的优势在于变向时仍把球控制在脚下。最直接的表现是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个值得观察的细节是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Ao Tanaka.name: Ao Tanaka
Ao Tanaka.summary: Ao Tanaka (田中 碧, Tanaka Ao; born 10 September 1998) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Leeds United and the Japan national team.
Ao Tanaka.note: The key to Tanaka is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He takes the first available forward lane before it closes. One more thing to notice is how Tanaka uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Ao Tanaka.noteZh: Ao Tanaka的优势在于用传球的力度和角度移动防线。最直接的表现是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Ayumu Seko.name: Ayumu Seko
Ayumu Seko.summary: Ayumu Seko (瀬古 歩夢, Seko Ayumu; born 7 June 2000) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays for Ligue 1 club Le Havre and the Japan national team.
Ayumu Seko.note: For Seko, the foundation is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Look first at how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Beyond that, watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Ayumu Seko.noteZh: Ayumu Seko的优势在于用传球的力度和角度移动防线。最直接的表现是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Daizen Maeda.name: Daizen Maeda
Daizen Maeda.summary: Daizen Maeda (前田 大然, Maeda Daizen; born 20 October 1997) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish Premiership side Celtic and the Japan national team.
Daizen Maeda.note: Maeda stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Maeda also moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Daizen Maeda.noteZh: Daizen Maeda的比赛建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑之上。首先看他如何在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个方面是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Hiroki Ito.name: Hiroki Ito
Hiroki Ito.summary: Hiroki Ito is a Japan left-footed centre-back at Bayern Munich who gives the national team passing balance, recovery cover, and aerial defending.
Hiroki Ito.note: Watch Ito for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. The clearest example is how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. A separate clue is how Ito turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Hiroki Ito.noteZh: 最能体现Hiroki Ito特点的是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。这一点直接体现在他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。除此之外，他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Junnosuke Suzuki.name: Junnosuke Suzuki
Junnosuke Suzuki.summary: Junnosuke Suzuki (鈴木 淳之介, Suzuki Junnosuke; born 12 July 2003) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Copenhagen and the Japan national team.
Junnosuke Suzuki.note: Suzuki's signature is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. Watch how he protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. Another detail is how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Junnosuke Suzuki.noteZh: 观察Junnosuke Suzuki时，可以先看对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Kaishu Sano.name: Kaishu Sano
Kaishu Sano.summary: Kaishu Sano (佐野 海舟, Sano Kaishū; born 30 December 2000) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Bundesliga club Mainz 05 and the Japan national team.
Kaishu Sano.note: What separates Sano is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Sano waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. In another phase of play, he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Kaishu Sano.noteZh: 理解Kaishū Sano，要先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Keisuke Goto.name: Keisuke Goto
Keisuke Goto.summary: Keisuke Gotō (後藤 啓介, Gotō Keisuke; born 3 June 2005) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a forward for German Bundesliga club SC Freiburg and the Japan national team.
Keisuke Goto.note: The key to Gotō is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. One more thing to notice is how Gotō moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Keisuke Goto.noteZh: 看Keisuke Gotō的作用，关键是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Keisuke Osako.name: Keisuke Osako
Keisuke Osako.summary: Keisuke Ōsako (大迫 敬介, Ōsako Keisuke; born 28 July 1999) is a Japanese footballer who currently plays as a goalkeeper for J1 League club Sanfrecce Hiroshima and the Japan national team.
Keisuke Osako.note: Ōsako's signature is protecting the centre before the shooter reveals the finish. Watch how he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot. For a wider read, also watch whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Keisuke Osako.noteZh: 看Keisuke Ōsako的作用，关键是射手暴露射门方向前先守住球门中央。他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。想再多看一层，可以留意他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Kento Shiogai.name: Kento Shiogai
Kento Shiogai.summary: Kento Shiogai (塩貝 健人, Shiogai Kento; born 26 March 2005) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a forward for German 2. Bundesliga club VfL Wolfsburg and the Japan national team.
Kento Shiogai.note: Shiogai stands out for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. In a separate phase, Shiogai angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Kento Shiogai.noteZh: 防守者仍盯着球时提前启动是理解Kento Shiogai踢法的关键。先看他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Koki Ogawa.name: Koki Ogawa
Koki Ogawa.summary: Koki Ogawa is a Japan centre-forward at NEC Nijmegen who gives the national team penalty-box finishing, aerial presence, and striker depth.
Koki Ogawa.note: What separates Ogawa is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Ogawa arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. A separate detail appears when he starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball.
Koki Ogawa.noteZh: 防线重组前制造干净射门构成Koki Ogawa踢法的核心。他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。除此之外，值得留意他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。

Kou Itakura.name: Kou Itakura
Kou Itakura.summary: Ko Itakura (板倉 滉, Itakura Kō; born 27 January 1997) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or defensive midfielder for Eredivisie club Ajax and captains the Japan national team.
Kou Itakura.note: Watch Itakura for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. The clearest example is how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Also notice how Itakura holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Kou Itakura.noteZh: Ko Itakura最鲜明的特点是危险出现前组织好队友。一个直接线索是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。另一个独立细节是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Shogo Taniguchi.name: Shogo Taniguchi
Shogo Taniguchi.summary: Shōgo Taniguchi (谷口 彰悟, Taniguchi Shōgo; born 15 July 1991) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Belgian Pro League club Sint-Truiden and the Japan national team.
Shogo Taniguchi.note: For Taniguchi, the foundation is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Look first at how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Also watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Shogo Taniguchi.noteZh: Shōgo Taniguchi的比赛建立在用传球的力度和角度移动防线之上。首先看他如何在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。另一个方面是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Shuto Machino.name: Shuto Machino
Shuto Machino.summary: Shūto Machino (町野 修斗, Machino Shūto; born 30 September 1999) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bundesliga club Borussia Mönchengladbach and the Japan national team.
Shuto Machino.note: Machino's signature is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Watch how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Separately, he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Shuto Machino.noteZh: Shūto Machino最鲜明的特点是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。一个直接线索是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个独立细节是他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Takehiro Tomiyasu.name: Takehiro Tomiyasu
Takehiro Tomiyasu.summary: Takehiro Tomiyasu (冨安 健洋, Tomiyasu Takehiro; born 5 November 1998) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a defender for Eredivisie club Ajax and the Japan national team. Mainly a full back, he can also be deployed as a centre-back.
Takehiro Tomiyasu.note: Tomiyasu stands out for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. Also look at how Tomiyasu turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Takehiro Tomiyasu.noteZh: Takehiro Tomiyasu最鲜明的特点是多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。一个直接线索是他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。另一个独立细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Tomoki Hayakawa.name: Tomoki Hayakawa
Tomoki Hayakawa.summary: Tomoki Hayakawa (早川 友基, Hayakawa Tomoki; born 3 March 1999) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for J1 League club Kashima Antlers and the Japan national team.
Tomoki Hayakawa.note: For Hayakawa, the foundation is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. Look first at how he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. Beyond the first action, he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Tomoki Hayakawa.noteZh: 看Tomoki Hayakawa的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Tsuyoshi Watanabe.name: Tsuyoshi Watanabe
Tsuyoshi Watanabe.summary: Tsuyoshi Watanabe (渡辺 剛, Watanabe Tsuyoshi; born 5 February 1997) is a Japanese football player who plays as a defender for Eredivisie club Feyenoord and the Japan national team.
Tsuyoshi Watanabe.note: The key to Watanabe is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate part of his game is how Watanabe holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Tsuyoshi Watanabe.noteZh: 观察Tsuyoshi Watanabe时，可以先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Yuito Suzuki.name: Yuito Suzuki
Yuito Suzuki.summary: Yuito Suzuki (鈴木 唯人, Suzuki Yuito; born 25 October 2001) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or a winger for German Bundesliga club SC Freiburg and the Japan national team.
Yuito Suzuki.note: What separates Suzuki is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Suzuki arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. At another point, he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Yuito Suzuki.noteZh: 理解Yuito Suzuki，要先看等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Yukinari Sugawara.name: Yukinari Sugawara
Yukinari Sugawara.summary: Yukinari Sugawara (菅原 由勢, Sugawara Yukinari; born 28 June 2000) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Southampton and the Japan national team. Sugawara began his senior career at Nagoya Grampus.
Yukinari Sugawara.note: Watch Sugawara for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. A separate clue is how Sugawara looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Yukinari Sugawara.noteZh: 最能体现Yukinari Sugawara特点的是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。这一点直接体现在他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，他也会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Yuto Nagatomo.name: Yuto Nagatomo
Yuto Nagatomo.summary: Yūto Nagatomo (長友 佑都, Nagatomo Yūto; born 12 September 1986) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a full back for J1 League club FC Tokyo and the Japan national team.
Yuto Nagatomo.note: Nagatomo's signature is staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. Watch how he checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. He also keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Yuto Nagatomo.noteZh: Yūto Nagatomo的优势在于球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动。最直接的表现是他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。另一个值得观察的细节是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Zion Suzuki.name: Zion Suzuki
Zion Suzuki.summary: Zion Suzuki (鈴木 彩艶, Suzuki Zaion; born 21 August 2002) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club Parma. Born in the United States, he represents the Japan national team.
Zion Suzuki.note: Watch Suzuki for keeping his body shape compact for reflex saves at close range. The clearest example is how he keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled. In a different phase, Suzuki chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Zion Suzuki.noteZh: 观察Zion Suzuki时，可以先看近距离反应扑救时保持紧凑身体姿态。他会让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。另一个比赛细节是他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Alexander Bernhardsson.name: Alexander Bernhardsson
Alexander Bernhardsson.summary: Alexander Olof Bernhardsson (born 8 September 1998) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a forward for 2. Bundesliga club Holstein Kiel and the Sweden national team.
Alexander Bernhardsson.note: Bernhardsson's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. Watch how he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. At another point in the move, he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Alexander Bernhardsson.noteZh: Alexander Bernhardsson的比赛建立在有目的地进行无球移动之上。首先看他如何提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。另一个方面是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Benjamin Nygren.name: Benjamin Nygren
Benjamin Nygren.summary: Erik Benjamin Nygren (born 8 July 2001) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Celtic and the Sweden national team.
Benjamin Nygren.note: The key to Nygren is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Elsewhere in the game, Nygren draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Benjamin Nygren.noteZh: 理解Benjamin Nygren，要先看等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Besfort Zeneli.name: Besfort Zeneli
Besfort Zeneli.summary: Besfort Zeneli (born 21 November 2002) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Belgian Pro League club Union Saint-Gilloise and the Sweden national team.
Besfort Zeneli.note: Watch Zeneli for carrying momentum through open midfield. The clearest example is how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. A separate clue is how Zeneli uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Besfort Zeneli.noteZh: 看Besfort Zeneli的作用，关键是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Carl Starfelt.name: Carl Starfelt
Carl Starfelt.summary: Carl Anders Theodor Starfelt (born 1 June 1995) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Celta de Vigo and the Sweden national team.
Carl Starfelt.note: For Starfelt, the foundation is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Look first at how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate point is how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Carl Starfelt.noteZh: Carl Starfelt最鲜明的特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。一个直接线索是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个独立细节是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Daniel Svensson.name: Daniel Svensson
Daniel Svensson.summary: Daniel Jonathan Svensson (born 12 February 2002) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder or left-back for Bundesliga club Borussia Dortmund and the Sweden national team.
Daniel Svensson.note: What separates Svensson is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. Svensson changes position while keeping his priorities simple. Also note how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Daniel Svensson.noteZh: Daniel Svensson最鲜明的特点是多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。一个直接线索是他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。另一个独立细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Elliot Stroud.name: Elliot Stroud
Elliot Stroud.summary: Elliot Karl Stroud (born 22 June 2002) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Allsvenskan club Mjällby AIF and the Sweden national team.
Elliot Stroud.note: Stroud stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. A different detail is how Stroud looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Elliot Stroud.noteZh: Elliot Stroud最鲜明的特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。一个直接线索是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个独立细节是他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Eric Smith.name: Eric Smith
Eric Smith.summary: Eric Smith is a Sweden centre-back at St. Pauli who gives the national team defensive midfield cover, back-line calm, and long passing.
Eric Smith.note: Smith's signature is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Watch how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Another detail is how he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Eric Smith.noteZh: 用传球的力度和角度移动防线是理解Eric Smith踢法的关键。先看他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。到了另一个比赛环节，他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Gabriel Gudmundsson.name: Gabriel Gudmundsson
Gabriel Gudmundsson.summary: Gabriel Johan Gudmundsson (born 29 April 1999) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Premier League club Leeds United and the Sweden national team.
Gabriel Gudmundsson.note: For Gudmundsson, the foundation is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Look first at how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Beyond the first action, he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Gabriel Gudmundsson.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机是理解Gabriel Gudmundsson踢法的关键。先看他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。到了另一个比赛环节，他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Gustaf Lagerbielke.name: Gustaf Lagerbielke
Gustaf Lagerbielke.summary: Gustaf Lagerbielke is a Sweden centre-back at Braga who gives the national team aerial defending, duel strength, and back-line depth.
Gustaf Lagerbielke.note: Lagerbielke stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. A different question is whether he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Gustaf Lagerbielke.noteZh: 理解Gustaf Lagerbielke，要先看争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。下一个值得观察的问题是，他是否会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Gustaf Nilsson.name: Gustaf Nilsson
Gustaf Nilsson.summary: Gustaf Nilsson is a Sweden centre-forward at Club Brugge who gives the national team hold-up play, aerial presence, and penalty-box depth.
Gustaf Nilsson.note: The key to Nilsson is making the next teammate's action easier. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. A separate part of his game is how Nilsson arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Gustaf Nilsson.noteZh: 最能体现Gustaf Nilsson特点的是让队友下一步处理更轻松。这一点直接体现在他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。除此之外，他也会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Herman Johansson.name: Herman Johansson
Herman Johansson.summary: Herman Nils Johansson (born 16 October 1997) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a defender for MLS club FC Dallas and the Sweden national team.
Herman Johansson.note: Watch Johansson for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. In a different phase, Johansson gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Herman Johansson.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机是理解Herman Johansson踢法的关键。先看他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。到了另一个比赛环节，他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Hjalmar Ekdal.name: Hjalmar Ekdal
Hjalmar Ekdal.summary: Hjalmar Ekdal (Swedish: [ˈjǎlmar ˈêːkdɑːl]; born 21 October 1998) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Burnley and the Sweden national team. He is the younger brother of former footballer Albin Ekdal.
Hjalmar Ekdal.note: What separates Ekdal is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. Ekdal protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. A separate detail appears when he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Hjalmar Ekdal.noteZh: Hjalmar Ekdal最鲜明的特点是对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。一个直接线索是他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。另一个独立细节是他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Isak Hien.name: Isak Hien
Isak Hien.summary: Isak Malcolm Kwaku Hien (born 13 January 1999) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Atalanta and the Sweden national team.
Isak Hien.note: Hien's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. He also waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Isak Hien.noteZh: 观察Isak Hien时，可以先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个比赛细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Jacob Widell Zetterstrom.name: Jacob Widell Zetterstrom
Jacob Widell Zetterstrom.summary: Jacob Mikael Widell Zetterström (born 11 July 1998) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Derby County and the Sweden national team.
Jacob Widell Zetterstrom.note: Zetterström stands out for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. In a separate phase, Zetterström sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Jacob Widell Zetterstrom.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友构成Jacob Widell Zetterström踢法的核心。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。除此之外，值得留意他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Jesper Karlstrom.name: Jesper Karlstrom
Jesper Karlstrom.summary: Jesper Kewe Karlström (born 21 June 1995) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Udinese, which he captains, and the Sweden national team.
Jesper Karlstrom.note: The key to Karlström is reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. Elsewhere in the game, Karlström holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Jesper Karlstrom.noteZh: 看Jesper Karlström的作用，关键是对抗后球权松动时的第一反应。他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ken Sema.name: Ken Sema
Ken Sema.summary: Ken Nlata Sema (/ˈsɛmə/; born 30 September 1993) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a left midfielder for Cypriot First Division club Pafos and the Sweden national team.
Ken Sema.note: For Sema, the foundation is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. Look first at how he slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear. A separate point is how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Ken Sema.noteZh: 最能体现Ken Sema特点的是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。这一点直接体现在他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。除此之外，他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Kristoffer Nordfeldt.name: Kristoffer Nordfeldt
Kristoffer Nordfeldt.summary: Bo Kristoffer Nordfeldt (born 23 June 1989) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Allsvenskan club AIK and the Sweden national team.
Kristoffer Nordfeldt.note: Watch Nordfeldt for staying ready through long quiet spells. The clearest example is how he keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. Also watch how Nordfeldt sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Kristoffer Nordfeldt.noteZh: 长时间无事可做后依然保持专注构成Kristoffer Nordfeldt踢法的核心。他会在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。除此之外，值得留意他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Lucas Bergvall.name: Lucas Bergvall
Lucas Bergvall.summary: Lucas Erik Holger Bergvall (Swedish: [ˈlu:kɑs bæ̌ɾj:vɑl]; born 2 February 2006) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Sweden national team.
Lucas Bergvall.note: What separates Bergvall is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Bergvall uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. At another point, he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it.
Lucas Bergvall.noteZh: 看Lucas Bergvall的作用，关键是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。

Taha Ali.name: Taha Ali
Taha Ali.summary: Taha Abdi Ali (born 1 July 1998) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Allsvenskan club Malmö FF and the Sweden national team.
Taha Ali.note: Ali's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. For a wider read, also watch whether he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Taha Ali.noteZh: Taha Ali的比赛建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下之上。首先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。换到另一个阶段，要看他是否会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Victor Lindelof.name: Victor Lindelof
Victor Lindelof.summary: Victor Jörgen Nilsson Lindelöf (Swedish: [ˈvɪk.tɔr ˈlɪn.dɛˌløːv]; born 17 July 1994) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Aston Villa and captains the Sweden national team.
Victor Lindelof.note: For Lindelöf, the foundation is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Look first at how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Also watch how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Victor Lindelof.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友是理解Victor Lindelöf踢法的关键。先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。到了另一个比赛环节，他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Viktor Johansson.name: Viktor Johansson
Viktor Johansson.summary: Tobias Viktor Johansson (born 14 September 1998) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Stoke City and the Sweden national team.
Viktor Johansson.note: The key to Johansson is turning a save into the first pass of an attack. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. There is another side to his game: he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Viktor Johansson.noteZh: 理解Viktor Johansson，要先看把一次扑救变成进攻第一传。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Adam Arous.name: Adam Arous
Adam Arous.summary: Adem Arous (Arabic: آدم عروس; born 17 July 2004) is a Tunisian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club Kasımpaşa. Born in Saudi Arabia, he plays for the Tunisia national team.
Adam Arous.note: Arous stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A different detail is how Arous turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Adam Arous.noteZh: 最能体现Adem Arous特点的是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。这一点直接体现在他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ali Abdi.name: Ali Abdi
Ali Abdi.summary: Ali Abdi is a Tunisia left-back at Nice who gives the national team overlap timing, crossing quality, and wide defending.
Ali Abdi.note: Abdi's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. At another point in the move, he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Ali Abdi.noteZh: Ali Abdi最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Amine Ben Hmida.name: Amine Ben Hmida
Amine Ben Hmida.summary: Mohamed Amine Ben Hamida is a Tunisia left-back at Espérance de Tunis who gives the national team defensive width, left-footed balance, and tournament experience.
Amine Ben Hmida.note: The key to Ben Hamida is reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. The next thing to watch is whether he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Amine Ben Hmida.noteZh: Mohamed Amine Ben Hamida的比赛建立在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段之上。首先看他如何提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。换到另一个阶段，要看他是否会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Anis Slimane.name: Anis Slimane
Anis Slimane.summary: Anis Ben Slimane is a Tunisia attacking midfielder at Norwich City who gives the national team carrying power, between-lines receiving, and midfield height.
Anis Slimane.note: Ben Slimane stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Also look at how Ben Slimane waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Anis Slimane.noteZh: Anis Ben Slimane的比赛建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下之上。首先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个方面是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Aymen Dahmen.name: Aymen Dahmen
Aymen Dahmen.summary: Aymen Dahmen (Arabic: أَيْمَن دَحمَان; born 28 January 1997) is a Tunisian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for CS Sfaxien and the Tunisia national team.
Aymen Dahmen.note: What separates Dahmen is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Dahmen keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. At another point, he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Aymen Dahmen.noteZh: Aymen Dahmen最鲜明的特点是危险出现前组织好队友。一个直接线索是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。另一个独立细节是他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Dylan Bronn.name: Dylan Bronn
Dylan Bronn.summary: Dylan Daniel Mahmoud Bronn (Arabic: دِيلاَن دَانِيَال مَحْمُود بْرون; born 19 June 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Swiss Super League club Servette. Born in France, he plays for the Tunisia national team.
Dylan Bronn.note: Watch Bronn for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. The clearest example is how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Also notice how Bronn slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Dylan Bronn.noteZh: 理解Dylan Bronn，要先看危险出现前组织好队友。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Elias Achouri.name: Elias Achouri
Elias Achouri.summary: Mohamed Elias Achouri (Arabic: مُحَمَّد إِلْيَاس عَاشُورِيّ; born 10 February 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Danish Superliga club Copenhagen.
Elias Achouri.note: For Achouri, the foundation is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Look first at how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Beyond that, watch how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Elias Achouri.noteZh: 理解Elias Achouri，要先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Firas Chaouat.name: Firas Chaouat
Firas Chaouat.summary: Firas Chaouat (Arabic: فراس شواط, born 8 May 1996) is a Tunisian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Club Africain and the Tunisia national team.
Firas Chaouat.note: Chaouat's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Watch how he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. He also protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Firas Chaouat.noteZh: Firas Chaouat的优势在于防线重组前制造干净射门。最直接的表现是他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。另一个值得观察的细节是他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Hazem Mastouri.name: Hazem Mastouri
Hazem Mastouri.summary: Hazem Mastouri (Arabic: حازم المستوري; born 18 June 1997) is a Tunisian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Russian club Dynamo Makhachkala and the Tunisia national team.
Hazem Mastouri.note: Watch Mastouri for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. The clearest example is how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. A separate clue is how Mastouri arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Hazem Mastouri.noteZh: 看Hazem Mastouri的作用，关键是防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Ismael Gharbi.name: Ismael Gharbi
Ismael Gharbi.summary: Ismaël Seifallah Gharbi (Tunisian Arabic: إسماعيل سيفالله غربي; born 10 April 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bundesliga club FC Augsburg, on loan from Primeira Liga club Braga.
Ismael Gharbi.note: What separates Gharbi is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Gharbi draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Also note how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Ismael Gharbi.noteZh: Ismaël Gharbi的优势在于比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。最直接的表现是他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个值得观察的细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Khalil Ayari.name: Khalil Ayari
Khalil Ayari.summary: Khalil Ayari (Arabic: خليل العياري; born 2 February 2005) is a Tunisian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain, on loan from Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1 club Stade Tunisien, and the Tunisia national team.
Khalil Ayari.club: Paris Saint-Germain (on loan from Stade Tunisien)
Khalil Ayari.note: Ayari's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. Watch how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. For a wider read, also watch whether he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Khalil Ayari.noteZh: 看Khalil Ayari的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。想再多看一层，可以留意他是否会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.name: Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud
Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.summary: Mohamed Belhadj Mahmoud (Arabic: مُحَمَّد بَلْحَاجّ مَحْمُود; born 24 April 2000) is a Tunisian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Swiss Super League club Lugano and the Tunisia national team.
Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.note: Mahmoud stands out for reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. A different detail is how Mahmoud uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.noteZh: 对抗后球权松动时的第一反应是理解Mohamed Belhadj Mahmoud踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Montassar Talbi.name: Montassar Talbi
Montassar Talbi.summary: Montassar Omar Talbi (Arabic: مُنْتَصِر عُمَر الطَّالِبِيّ; born 26 May 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lorient. Born in France, he plays for the Tunisia national team.
Montassar Talbi.note: The key to Talbi is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. One more thing to notice is how Talbi moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Montassar Talbi.noteZh: Montassar Talbi的比赛建立在危险出现前组织好队友之上。首先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Mortadha Ben Ouanes.name: Mortadha Ben Ouanes
Mortadha Ben Ouanes.summary: Ahmed Mortadha Ouanes (Arabic: مرتضى بن وناس; born 2 July 1994) is a Tunisian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Süper Lig club Kasımpaşa and the Tunisia national team.
Mortadha Ben Ouanes.note: For Ben Ouanes, the foundation is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Look first at how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Also watch how he looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Mortadha Ben Ouanes.noteZh: Mortadha Ben Ouanes的优势在于从后场加入进攻的启动时机。最直接的表现是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Mouhib Chamakh.name: Mouhib Chamakh
Mouhib Chamakh.summary: Abdelmouhib Chamakh is a Tunisia goalkeeper at Club Africain who gives the national team shot-stopping depth, height, and domestic title-winning rhythm.
Mouhib Chamakh.note: Watch Chamakh in two moments. First, check whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. Then watch whether he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Mouhib Chamakh.noteZh: 观察Abdelmouhib Chamakh时，可以看两个时刻。先看他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。再看他是否会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Moutaz Neffati.name: Moutaz Neffati
Moutaz Neffati.summary: Moutaz Neffati (Arabic: معتز نفّاتي; born 4 September 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for the Superettan club IFK Norrköping. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Tunisia national team.
Moutaz Neffati.note: The key to Neffati is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. In another phase, Neffati turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Moutaz Neffati.noteZh: 看Moutaz Neffati的作用，关键是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Raed Chikhaoui.name: Raed Chikhaoui
Raed Chikhaoui.summary: Raed Chikhaoui is a Tunisia centre-back at US Monastir who gives the national team size, aerial defending, and fresh back-line depth.
Raed Chikhaoui.note: For Chikhaoui, the foundation is dealing with aerial balls in his defensive area. Look first at how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle. For a wider picture, notice whether he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Raed Chikhaoui.noteZh: Raed Chikhaoui的优势在于处理防守区域内的高空球。最直接的表现是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。想看得更完整，还要观察他是否会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Rani Khedira.name: Rani Khedira
Rani Khedira.summary: Rani Khedira (Arabic: راني خضيرة; born 27 January 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Bundesliga club Union Berlin. Born in Germany, he plays for the Tunisia national team.
Rani Khedira.note: Watch Khedira for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. The clearest example is how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate clue is how Khedira uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Rani Khedira.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢是理解Rani Khedira踢法的关键。先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Rayan Elloumi.name: Rayan Elloumi
Rayan Elloumi.summary: Rayan Elloumi (Arabic: ريان اللومي; born 17 September 2007) is a footballer who plays for Vancouver Whitecaps FC in Major League Soccer. Born in Canada, he represents the Tunisia national team.
Rayan Elloumi.note: What separates Elloumi is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Elloumi arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. A separate detail appears when he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Rayan Elloumi.noteZh: Rayan Elloumi的比赛建立在等防守者注意力转移后再启动之上。首先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个方面是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Sabri Ben Hessen.name: Sabri Ben Hessen
Sabri Ben Hessen.summary: Sabri Ben Hessen (Arabic: صبري بن حسن; born 13 June 1996) is a Tunisian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1 club ES Sahel, and the Tunisia national team.
Sabri Ben Hessen.note: Ben Hessen stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. A different question is whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Sabri Ben Hessen.noteZh: 理解Sabri Ben Hessen，要先看提前站位后的快速反应。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。下一个值得观察的问题是，他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Sebastian Tounekti.name: Sebastian Tounekti
Sebastian Tounekti.summary: Sebastian Tounekti (born 13 July 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Scottish Premiership club Celtic. Born in Norway, he plays for the Tunisia national team.
Sebastian Tounekti.note: Tounekti's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. At another point in the move, he looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Sebastian Tounekti.noteZh: 最能体现Sebastian Tounekti特点的是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。这一点直接体现在他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。除此之外，他也会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Yan Valery.name: Yan Valery
Yan Valery.summary: Yan Valery (Arabic: يان فاليري; born 22 February 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. Born in France, he plays for the Tunisia national team.
Yan Valery.note: The key to Valery is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. Elsewhere in the game, Valery takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Yan Valery.noteZh: 最能体现Yan Valery特点的是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。除此之外，他也会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Bart Verbruggen.name: Bart Verbruggen
Bart Verbruggen.summary: Bart Verbruggen (born 18 August 2002) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion and the Netherlands national team.
Bart Verbruggen.note: Verbruggen stands out for turning a save into the first pass of an attack. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. Verbruggen also sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Bart Verbruggen.noteZh: 把一次扑救变成进攻第一传是理解Bart Verbruggen踢法的关键。先看他如何在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Denzel Dumfries.name: Denzel Dumfries
Denzel Dumfries.summary: Denzel Justus Morris Dumfries (born 18 April 1996) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right wing-back for Serie A club Inter Milan and the Netherlands national team.
Denzel Dumfries.note: For Dumfries, the foundation is arriving at the far side after defenders have narrowed toward the ball. Look first at how he holds the far-post lane, then attacks it as the cross leaves the passer. Also watch how he absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Denzel Dumfries.noteZh: 理解Denzel Dumfries，要先看等防守者向球侧收缩后再到达后点。他会先留在后点线路，等传中离脚后再启动攻击落点。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Donyell Malen.name: Donyell Malen
Donyell Malen.summary: Donyell Malen (born 19 January 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger or striker for Serie A club Roma and the Netherlands national team.
Donyell Malen.note: The key to Malen is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. Elsewhere in the game, Malen shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Donyell Malen.noteZh: 有目的地进行无球移动构成Donyell Malen踢法的核心。他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。除此之外，值得留意他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Guus Til.name: Guus Til
Guus Til.summary: Guus Berend Til (born 22 December 1997) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Eredivisie club PSV and the Netherlands national team.
Guus Til.note: What separates Til is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Til arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. In another phase of play, he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Guus Til.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动是理解Guus Til踢法的关键。先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Jan Paul van Hecke.name: Jan Paul van Hecke
Jan Paul van Hecke.summary: Jan Paul van Hecke (born 8 June 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Netherlands national team.
Jan Paul van Hecke.note: van Hecke stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. A different detail is how van Hecke plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Jan Paul van Hecke.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Jan Paul van Hecke踢法的关键。先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Jorrel Hato.name: Jorrel Hato
Jorrel Hato.summary: Jorrel Evan Hato (born 7 March 2006) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Chelsea and the Netherlands national team.
Jorrel Hato.note: Hato's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. He also plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Jorrel Hato.noteZh: 看Jorrel Hato的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Justin Kluivert.name: Justin Kluivert
Justin Kluivert.summary: Justin Dean Kluivert (born 5 May 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Premier League club Bournemouth and the Netherlands national team.
Justin Kluivert.note: Watch Kluivert for carrying momentum through open midfield. The clearest example is how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Also watch how Kluivert arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Justin Kluivert.noteZh: 看Justin Kluivert的作用，关键是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Lutsharel Geertruida.name: Lutsharel Geertruida
Lutsharel Geertruida.summary: Lutsharel Emiliano Geertruida (Dutch pronunciation: [xeːrtrœyda]; born 18 July 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays for Premier League club Sunderland, on loan from Bundesliga club RB Leipzig, and the Netherlands national team.
Lutsharel Geertruida.note: Watch Geertruida for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. The clearest example is how he changes position while keeping his priorities simple. Also notice how Geertruida protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Lutsharel Geertruida.noteZh: 观察Lutsharel Geertruida时，可以先看多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。另一个比赛细节是他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Mark Flekken.name: Mark Flekken
Mark Flekken.summary: Mark Maria Hubertus Flekken (born 13 June 1993) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the Netherlands national team.
Mark Flekken.note: Flekken stands out for turning a save into the first pass of an attack. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. Another aspect is how Flekken leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Mark Flekken.noteZh: 把一次扑救变成进攻第一传构成Mark Flekken踢法的核心。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。除此之外，值得留意他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Marten de Roon.name: Marten de Roon
Marten de Roon.summary: Marten Elco de Roon (born 29 March 1991) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie A club Atalanta and the Netherlands national team.
Marten de Roon.note: de Roon's signature is reading the next phase before the space fully opens. Watch how he adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. Separately, he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Marten de Roon.noteZh: 最能体现Marten de Roon特点的是空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段。这一点直接体现在他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。除此之外，他也会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Mats Wieffer.name: Mats Wieffer
Mats Wieffer.summary: Mats Henrik Berne Wieffer (born 16 November 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right-back or defensive midfielder for Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion and the Netherlands national team.
Mats Wieffer.note: For Wieffer, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Beyond the first action, he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Mats Wieffer.noteZh: 观察Mats Wieffer时，可以先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个比赛细节是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Memphis Depay.name: Memphis Depay
Memphis Depay.summary: Memphis Depay (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmɛɱfɪz dəˈpɑi]; born 13 February 1994), commonly known simply as Memphis, is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for Corinthians in the Campeonato Brasileiro Série A and the Netherlands national team.
Memphis Depay.note: What separates Depay is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Depay draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Away from that action, he starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball.
Memphis Depay.noteZh: 观察Memphis Depay时，可以先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个比赛细节是他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。

Micky van de Ven.name: Micky van de Ven
Micky van de Ven.summary: Micky van de Ven (Dutch: [ˈmɪki vɑn də ˈvɛn]; born 19 April 2001) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays either as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Netherlands national team.
Micky van de Ven.note: The key to van de Ven is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. The next thing to watch is whether he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Micky van de Ven.noteZh: 最能体现Micky van de Ven特点的是防线暴露后的回追速度。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。接着可以问，他是否会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Nathan Ake.name: Nathan Ake
Nathan Ake.summary: Nathan Benjamin Aké (Dutch: ['naːtɑn 'aːkeː]; born 18 February 1995) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Manchester City and the Netherlands national team.
Nathan Ake.note: What separates Aké is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Aké holds the route into the box until support arrives. In another phase of play, he checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Nathan Ake.noteZh: Nathan Aké的优势在于先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。最直接的表现是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Noa Lang.name: Noa Lang
Noa Lang.summary: Noa Noëll Lang (born 17 June 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left winger or left midfielder for Süper Lig club Galatasaray, on loan from Serie A club Napoli, and the Netherlands national team.
Noa Lang.note: Watch Lang for changing direction without losing control of the ball. The clearest example is how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Elsewhere, Lang draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Noa Lang.noteZh: 理解Noa Lang，要先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Quinten Timber.name: Quinten Timber
Quinten Timber.summary: Quinten Ryan Crispito Timber (Dutch: [ˈkʋɪntə(n) ˈtɪmbər]; born 17 June 2001) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as midfielder for Ligue 1 club Marseille and the Netherlands national team.
Quinten Timber.note: Timber's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Watch how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Away from that moment, he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Quinten Timber.noteZh: 理解Quinten Timber，要先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Robin Roefs.name: Robin Roefs
Robin Roefs.summary: Robin Gerardus Petrus Roefs (born 17 January 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Sunderland and the Netherlands national team.
Robin Roefs.note: For Roefs, the foundation is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. Look first at how he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. Also watch how he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Robin Roefs.noteZh: Robin Roefs的优势在于提前站位后的快速反应。最直接的表现是他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。另一个值得观察的细节是他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Ryan Gravenberch.name: Ryan Gravenberch
Ryan Gravenberch.summary: Ryan Jiro Gravenberch (Dutch pronunciation: [Ryɑn ɣrɑvɛnbɛrx]; born 16 May 2002) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Liverpool and the Netherlands national team.
Ryan Gravenberch.note: Gravenberch stands out for carrying momentum through open midfield. He pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Another aspect is how Gravenberch waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ryan Gravenberch.noteZh: 最能体现Ryan Gravenberch特点的是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。这一点直接体现在他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。除此之外，他也会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Teun Koopmeiners.name: Teun Koopmeiners
