Antoine Mendy.summary: Antoine Alpha Mendy (born 27 May 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back and centre-back for Ligue 1 club Nice. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Antoine Mendy.note: Mendy stands out for closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. He gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. Also look at how Mendy protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Antoine Mendy.noteZh: 观察Antoine Mendy时，可以先看封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者。他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。另一个比赛细节是他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Assane Diao.name: Assane Diao
Assane Diao.summary: Assane Diao (born 7 September 2005) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a winger for Serie A club Como and the Senegal national team.
Assane Diao.note: The key to Diao is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. In another phase, Diao draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Assane Diao.noteZh: 看到空当后的爆发速度是理解Assane Diao踢法的关键。先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。到了另一个比赛环节，他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Bamba Dieng.name: Bamba Dieng
Bamba Dieng.summary: Cheikh Ahmadou Bamba Mbacke Dieng (born 23 March 2000) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Lorient and the Senegal national team.
Bamba Dieng.note: What separates Dieng is explosive speed once open grass appears. Dieng changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Also note how he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Bamba Dieng.noteZh: Bamba Dieng的优势在于看到空当后的爆发速度。最直接的表现是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个值得观察的细节是他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Cherif Ndiaye.name: Cherif Ndiaye
Cherif Ndiaye.summary: Pape Cherif Ndiaye (born 23 January 1996) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Süper Lig club Samsunspor and the Senegal national team.
Cherif Ndiaye.note: Ndiaye's signature is making the next teammate's action easier. Watch how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He also arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Cherif Ndiaye.noteZh: Chérif Ndiaye最鲜明的特点是让队友下一步处理更轻松。一个直接线索是他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。另一个独立细节是他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Edouard Mendy.name: Edouard Mendy
Edouard Mendy.summary: Édouard Osoque Mendy (born 1 March 1992) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for and captains Saudi Pro League club Al-Ahli. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Edouard Mendy.note: For Mendy, the foundation is command of the crowded space around goal. Look first at how he attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. Separately, look at how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Edouard Mendy.noteZh: 观察Édouard Mendy时，可以先看掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。另一个比赛细节是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Habib Diarra.name: Habib Diarra
Habib Diarra.summary: Mouhamadou Habib Mbacke Diarra (born 3 January 2004) is a French-Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Sunderland and the Senegal national team.
Habib Diarra.note: Watch Diarra for carrying momentum through open midfield. The clearest example is how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. A separate clue is how Diarra moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Habib Diarra.noteZh: 带球穿过开放中场的推进力构成Habib Diarra踢法的核心。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。除此之外，值得留意他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Iliman Ndiaye.name: Iliman Ndiaye
Iliman Ndiaye.summary: Iliman Cheikh Baroy Ndiaye (born 6 March 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a wide midfielder for Premier League club Everton. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Iliman Ndiaye.note: Ndiaye stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Also look at how Ndiaye moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Iliman Ndiaye.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下构成Iliman Ndiaye踢法的核心。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。除此之外，值得留意他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Ismail Jakobs.name: Ismail Jakobs
Ismail Jakobs.summary: Ismail Joshua Jakobs (born 17 August 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Süper Lig club Galatasaray. Born in Germany, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Ismail Jakobs.note: Jakobs's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. At another point in the move, he turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Ismail Jakobs.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机构成Ismaïl Jakobs踢法的核心。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，值得留意他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Krepin Diatta.name: Krepin Diatta
Krepin Diatta.summary: Krépin Diatta (born 25 February 1999) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Monaco and the Senegal national team.
Krepin Diatta.note: Watch Diatta for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. The clearest example is how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. In a different phase, Diatta draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Krepin Diatta.noteZh: 理解Krépin Diatta，要先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Lamine Camara.name: Lamine Camara
Lamine Camara.summary: Lamine Camara (born 1 January 2004) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Monaco and the Senegal national team.
Lamine Camara.note: For Camara, the foundation is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Look first at how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Beyond that, watch how he serves corners and free kicks into the attacking area.
Lamine Camara.noteZh: 用传球的力度和角度移动防线是理解Lamine Camara踢法的关键。先看他如何在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。到了另一个比赛环节，他会把角球和任意球送入进攻区域。

Mamadou Sarr.name: Mamadou Sarr
Mamadou Sarr.summary: Mamadou Sarr (born 29 August 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Chelsea. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Mamadou Sarr.note: What separates Sarr is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. Sarr turns early and protects the route toward goal. A separate detail appears when he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Mamadou Sarr.noteZh: Mamadou Sarr最鲜明的特点是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。一个直接线索是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。另一个独立细节是他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Mory Diaw.name: Mory Diaw
Mory Diaw.summary: Mory Diaw (born 22 June 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Le Havre. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Mory Diaw.note: The key to Diaw is staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. The next thing to watch is whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Mory Diaw.noteZh: 看Mory Diaw的作用，关键是射门方向明确前保持身体平衡。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。想再多看一层，可以留意他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Moussa Niakhate.name: Moussa Niakhate
Moussa Niakhate.summary: Moussa Niakhaté (born 8 March 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lyon. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Moussa Niakhate.note: Niakhaté stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Another aspect is how Niakhaté turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Moussa Niakhate.noteZh: 用传球的力度和角度移动防线构成Moussa Niakhaté踢法的核心。他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。除此之外，值得留意他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Pape Gueye.name: Pape Gueye
Pape Gueye.summary: Pape Alassane Gueye (born 24 January 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Villarreal. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Pape Gueye.note: Watch Gueye for getting into positions where the next pass can become a shot. The clearest example is how he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot. Also notice how Gueye plays forward toward an available runner when the opening appears.
Pape Gueye.noteZh: Pape Gueye的优势在于进入下一脚传球可以转化为射门的位置。最直接的表现是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。另一个值得观察的细节是他会线路出现时向前送给可接应的跑动者。

Pathe Ciss.name: Pathe Ciss
Pathe Ciss.summary: Pathé Ismaël Ciss (born 16 March 1994) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a central or defensive midfielder for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano and the Senegal national team.
Pathe Ciss.note: What separates Ciss is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Ciss waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Away from that action, he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over.
Pathe Ciss.noteZh: Pathé Ciss最鲜明的特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。一个直接线索是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个独立细节是他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。

Yehvann Diouf.name: Yehvann Diouf
Yehvann Diouf.summary: Yehvann Djibril Victor Diouf (born 16 November 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Nice. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.
Yehvann Diouf.note: Diouf's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. Watch how he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. Another detail is how he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Yehvann Diouf.noteZh: 最能体现Yehvann Diouf特点的是提前站位后的快速反应。这一点直接体现在他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。除此之外，他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.name: Bara Sapoko Ndiaye
Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.summary: Bara Sapoko Ndiaye is a Senegal central midfielder from Bayern Munich who gives the national team youthful ball carrying, midfield mobility, and long-term upside.
Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.note: The key to Ndiaye is carrying momentum through open midfield. He pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. The next thing to watch is whether he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.noteZh: Bara Sapoko Ndiaye的比赛建立在带球穿过开放中场的推进力之上。首先看他如何把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。换到另一个阶段，要看他是否会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

El Hadji Malick Diouf.name: El Hadji Malick Diouf
El Hadji Malick Diouf.summary: El Hadji Malick Diouf (born 29 December 2004) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL Championship club West Ham United and the Senegal national team.
El Hadji Malick Diouf.note: For Diouf, the foundation is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. Look first at how he turns early and closes the runner before the box. For a wider picture, notice whether he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
El Hadji Malick Diouf.noteZh: El Hadji Malick Diouf的比赛建立在防线暴露后的回追速度之上。首先看他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。换到另一个阶段，要看他是否会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Idrissa Gueye.name: Idrissa Gueye
Idrissa Gueye.summary: Idrissa Gana Gueye (born 26 September 1989) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Everton and the Senegal national team.
Idrissa Gueye.note: The key to Gueye is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Elsewhere in the game, Gueye adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Idrissa Gueye.noteZh: Idrissa Gueye的优势在于选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。最直接的表现是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个值得观察的细节是他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Pape Matar Sarr.name: Pape Matar Sarr
Pape Matar Sarr.summary: Pape Matar Sarr (French pronunciation: [pap matɑʁ sɑʁ]; born 14 September 2002) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Senegal national team.
Pape Matar Sarr.note: Sarr stands out for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Sarr also uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Pape Matar Sarr.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动是理解Pape Matar Sarr踢法的关键。先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Ahmed Basil.name: Ahmed Basil
Ahmed Basil.summary: Ahmed Basil Fadhil Al Fadhli (Arabic: أَحْمَد بَاسِل فَاضِل الْفَضْلِيّ; born 19 August 1996) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Iraq Stars League club Al-Shorta and the Iraq national team.
Ahmed Basil.note: Fadhil stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. Another aspect is how Fadhil leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Ahmed Basil.noteZh: 看Ahmed Basil Fadhil的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Ahmed Qasem.name: Ahmed Qasem
Ahmed Qasem.summary: Ahmed Ihab Ahmed, known as Ahmed Qasem (Arabic: أحمد قاسم, romanized: ʾAḥmad Qāsim pronounced [ˈ(ʔ)aħmad ˈqaː.sɪm]; born 12 July 2003), is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC.
Ahmed Qasem.note: For Qasem, the foundation is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Look first at how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Also watch how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Ahmed Qasem.noteZh: Ahmed Qasem的比赛建立在等防守者注意力转移后再启动之上。首先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个方面是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Aimar Sher.name: Aimar Sher
Aimar Sher.summary: Aimar Hazar Anwar Sher (born 20 December 2002) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Sarpsborg 08 and the Iraq national team.
Aimar Sher.note: The key to Sher is carrying momentum through open midfield. He pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. In another phase, Sher angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Aimar Sher.noteZh: 观察Aimar Sher时，可以先看带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。另一个比赛细节是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Akam Hashim.name: Akam Hashim
Akam Hashim.summary: Akam Hashim Rahman (Arabic: اكام هاشم رحمن; Kurdish: ئاکام هاشم ڕەحمان; born 16 August 1998) is a Kurdish Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or midfielder for Al-Zawraa and the Iraq national team.
Akam Hashim.note: The key to Hashem is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate part of his game is how Hashem holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Akam Hashim.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Akam Hashem踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ali Yousif.name: Ali Yousif
Ali Yousif.summary: Ali Yousif Hashim Najatee (Arabic: علي يوسف هاشم; born 19 January 1996) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a forward for Al-Talaba and the Iraq national team.
Ali Yousif.note: Yousif stands out for giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. In a separate phase, Yousif arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Ali Yousif.noteZh: 最能体现Ali Yousif特点的是让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。这一点直接体现在他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。除此之外，他也会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Fahad Talib.name: Fahad Talib
Fahad Talib.summary: Fahad Talib Raheem (Arabic: فَهْد طَالِب رَحِيم; born 21 October 1994) is an Iraqi professional footballer who played as a goalkeeper for Iraq Stars League club Al Talaba and the Iraq national team.
Fahad Talib.note: What separates Talib is staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. Talib keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. A separate detail appears when he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Fahad Talib.noteZh: 射门方向明确前保持身体平衡构成Fahad Talib踢法的核心。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。除此之外，值得留意他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Frans Putros.name: Frans Putros
Frans Putros.summary: Frans Dhia Jirjis Haddad (born 14 July 1993), commonly known as Frans Putros (Arabic: فرانس بطرس; Syriac: ܦܪܢܣ ܦܘܛܪܘܣ), is a professional footballer who plays as a Centre-back, Full-back or Defensive midfielder for Super League club Persib Bandung.
Frans Putros.note: Putros's signature is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. Watch how he changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He also protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Frans Putros.noteZh: Frans Putros的比赛建立在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构之上。首先看他如何改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。另一个方面是他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Hussein Ali.name: Hussein Ali
Hussein Ali.summary: Hussein Ali Jasim Al Saedi (Arabic: حسين علي جاسم الساعدي; born 29 November 1996) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays for Iraq Stars League club Al-Shorta and the Iraq national team.
Hussein Ali.note: Watch Ali for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. The clearest example is how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. A separate question is whether Ali pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it.
Hussein Ali.noteZh: Hussein Ali的比赛建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑之上。首先看他如何在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。换到另一个阶段，要看他是否会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。

Ibrahim Bayesh.name: Ibrahim Bayesh
Ibrahim Bayesh.summary: Ibrahim Bayesh Kamil Al-Kaabawi (Arabic: إبرَاهِيْم بَايَش كَامِل الْكَعْبَاوِيّ; born 1 May 2000) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays Al-Dhafra as a midfielder for UAE Pro League club Al-Dhafra and the Iraq national team.
Ibrahim Bayesh.note: For Bayesh, the foundation is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Look first at how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Beyond the first action, he uses a clean first touch to open a shooting lane from distance.
Ibrahim Bayesh.noteZh: 观察Ibrahim Bayesh时，可以先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个比赛细节是他会用干净的第一脚触球打开远射线路。

Jalal Hassan.name: Jalal Hassan
Jalal Hassan.summary: Jalal Hassan Hachem (Arabic: جَلَال حَسَن هَاشِم; born 18 May 1991) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for and captains both Al-Zawraa and the Iraq football team.
Jalal Hassan.note: The key to Hassan is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. One more thing to notice is how Hassan sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Jalal Hassan.noteZh: 观察Jalal Hassan时，可以先看危险出现前组织好队友。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。另一个比赛细节是他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Kevin Yakob.name: Kevin Yakob
Kevin Yakob.summary: Kevin Enkido Yakob William (Syriac: ܟܒܢ ܝܥܩܘܒ, born 10 October 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Danish Superliga club AGF. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Iraq national team.
Kevin Yakob.note: For Yakob, the foundation is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Look first at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. A separate point is how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Kevin Yakob.noteZh: 理解Kevin Yakob，要先看压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Marko Farji.name: Marko Farji
Marko Farji.summary: Marko Zana Hussein Farji (Arabic: ماركو زانا حسين فرج; Kurdish: Marko Zana Husên Fercî; born 16 March 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Venezia. Born in Norway, he plays for the Iraq national team.
Marko Farji.note: What separates Farji is explosive speed once open grass appears. Farji changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. In another phase of play, he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Marko Farji.noteZh: 看Marko Farji的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Merchas Doski.name: Merchas Doski
Merchas Doski.summary: Merchas Ghazi Salih Doski (Kurdish: مێرخاس غازی ساڵح دۆسکی, romanized: Mîrxas Qazî Salih Doskî, Arabic: ميرخاس غازي صالح دوسكي) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Viktoria Plzeň. Born in Germany, he plays for the Iraq national team.
Merchas Doski.note: Doski's signature is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. Watch how he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. At another point in the move, he turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Merchas Doski.noteZh: 理解Merchas Doski，要先看封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者。他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Mohanad Ali.name: Mohanad Ali
Mohanad Ali.summary: Mohanad Ali Kadhim Al-Shammari (Arabic: مُهَنَّد عَلِيّ كَاظِم الشَّمَّرِيّ, born 20 June 2000), commonly known in Iraq as Mimi (Arabic: ميمي), is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a forward for UAE club Dibba and the Iraq national team.
Mohanad Ali.note: Watch Ali for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Also watch how Ali arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Mohanad Ali.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动是理解Mohanad Ali踢法的关键。先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。到了另一个比赛环节，他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Munaf Younus.name: Munaf Younus
Munaf Younus.summary: Manaf Younus Hashim Al-Tekreeti (Arabic: مَنَاف يُونُس هَاشِم التِّكرِيْتِيّ; born 16 November 1996) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Iraq Stars League club Al-Shorta and the Iraq national team.
Munaf Younus.note: Younis stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. Another aspect is how Younis absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Munaf Younus.noteZh: Manaf Younis的优势在于先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。最直接的表现是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个值得观察的细节是他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Mustafa Saadoon.name: Mustafa Saadoon
Mustafa Saadoon.summary: Mustafa Saadoon is an Iraq right-back from Al-Shorta who gives the national team wide defending, recovery speed, and overlap support.
Mustafa Saadoon.note: Saadoon's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He also gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Mustafa Saadoon.noteZh: Mustafa Saadoon最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Rebin Sulaka.name: Rebin Sulaka
Rebin Sulaka.summary: Rebin Gharib Sulaka Adhamat (Arabic: ريبين غريب سولاقا عظمت; born 12 April 1992) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a centre back for Thai League 1 club Port and the Iraq national team.
Rebin Sulaka.note: The key to Sulaka is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. In another phase, Sulaka slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Rebin Sulaka.noteZh: Rebin Sulaka最鲜明的特点是危险出现前组织好队友。一个直接线索是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。另一个独立细节是他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Youssef Amyn.name: Youssef Amyn
Youssef Amyn.summary: Youssef Wali Faeq Amyn (Arabic: يوسف والي فائق أمين; Kurdish: یوسف وەلی فائق ئەمین‎; born 21 August 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Cypriot First Division club AEK Larnaca. Born in Germany, he plays for the Iraq national team.
Youssef Amyn.note: What separates Amyn is explosive speed once open grass appears. Amyn changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. A separate detail appears when he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Youssef Amyn.noteZh: 看Youssef Amyn的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Zaid Tahseen.name: Zaid Tahseen

Zaid Tahseen.note: Watch Tahseen for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. The clearest example is how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. In a different phase, Tahseen meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Zaid Tahseen.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢构成Zaid Tahseen踢法的核心。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，值得留意他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Ahmed Maknzi.name: Ahmed Maknzi
Ahmed Maknzi.summary: Ahmed Maknzi is an Iraq left-back from Al-Karma who gives the national team wide defending, recovery runs, and defensive flexibility.
Ahmed Maknzi.note: For Maknzi, the foundation is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. Look first at how he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. Separately, look at how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Ahmed Maknzi.noteZh: 封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者是理解Ahmed Maknzi踢法的关键。先看他如何靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。到了另一个比赛环节，他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ali Al-Hamadi.name: Ali Al-Hamadi
Ali Al-Hamadi.summary: Ali Al-Hamadi is an Iraq centre-forward from Luton Town who gives the national team hold-up play, runs in behind, and penalty-box finishing.
Ali Al-Hamadi.note: Al-Hamadi stands out for making the next teammate's action easier. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. Al-Hamadi also moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Ali Al-Hamadi.noteZh: Ali Al-Hamadi的比赛建立在让队友下一步处理更轻松之上。首先看他如何用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。另一个方面是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Amir Al-Ammari.name: Amir Al-Ammari
Amir Al-Ammari.summary: Amir Al-Ammari is an Iraq defensive midfielder from Cracovia who gives the national team screening, left-footed passing, and set-piece support.
Amir Al-Ammari.note: Al-Ammari's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. Away from that moment, he plays the available pass with his left foot.
Amir Al-Ammari.noteZh: Amir Al-Ammari最鲜明的特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。一个直接线索是他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个独立细节是他会用左脚送出眼前可行的传球。

Zaid Ismail.name: Zaid Ismail
Zaid Ismail.summary: Zaid Ismail is an Iraq defensive midfielder from Al-Talaba who gives the national team screening, duel work, and simple central passing.
Zaid Ismail.note: Ismail stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Ismail also holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Zaid Ismail.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Zaid Ismail踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Dailon Livramento.summary: Dailon Rocha Livramento do Rosario (Portuguese: [ˈdaj.lɔn ˈʀɔ.ʃɐ li.vɾɐ.ˈmẽ.tu du ʀu.ˈza.ɾi.u]; born 4 May 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Primeira Liga club Casa Pia, on loan from Serie B club Hellas Verona.

Deroy Duarte.name: Deroy Duarte
Deroy Duarte.summary: Deroy d'Encarnação Duarte (Dutch: [də.ˈɾɔj] Portuguese: [dẽ.kɐɾ.nɐ.ˈsɐ̃w du.ˈaɾ.tɨ]; born 4 July 1999) is a professional football player who plays as a midfielder for Bulgarian First League club Ludogorets Razgrad.
Deroy Duarte.note: Watch Duarte for carrying momentum through open midfield. The clearest example is how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. A separate clue is how Duarte uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Deroy Duarte.noteZh: Deroy Duarte最鲜明的特点是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。一个直接线索是他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。另一个独立细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Garry Rodrigues.name: Garry Rodrigues
Garry Rodrigues.summary: Garry Mendes Rodrigues (Portuguese: [ɡa.ˈʀi ˈmẽ.dɨʒ ʀu.ˈdɾi.ɡɨʃ]; born 27 November 1990) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Cypriot First Division club Apollon Limassol. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.

Garry Rodrigues.noteZh: Garry Rodrigues的比赛建立在看到空当后的爆发速度之上。首先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个方面是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Gilson Benchimol.name: Gilson Benchimol
Gilson Benchimol.summary: Gilson Benchimol Tavares (Portuguese: [ˈʒil.sɔn bẽ.ʃi.ˈmɔl ta.ˈva.ɾɨʃ]; born 29 December 2001) is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a striker for Russian club Akron Tolyatti and the Cape Verde national team.
Gilson Benchimol.note: The key to Benchimol is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. There is another side to his game: he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Gilson Benchimol.noteZh: Gilson Benchimol的优势在于争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。最直接的表现是他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。另一个值得观察的细节是他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Jamiro Monteiro.name: Jamiro Monteiro
Jamiro Monteiro.summary: Jamiro Gregory Monteiro Alvarenga (Portuguese: [ʒɐ.ˈmi.ɾu ˈɡɾɛ.ɡɔ.ɾi mõ.ˈtej.ɾu al.vɐ.ˈɾẽ.ɡɐ]; born 23 November 1993), commonly known as Jamiro, is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle.

Jovane Cabral.name: Jovane Cabral
Jovane Cabral.summary: Jovane Eduardo Borges Cabral (Portuguese: [ʒɔ.ˈvɐ.nɨ e.du.ˈaɾ.du ˈbɔɾ.ʒɨʃ kɐ.ˈbɾal]; born 14 June 1998) is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a winger for Primeira Liga club Estrela da Amadora and the Cape Verde national team.
Jovane Cabral.note: What separates Cabral is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Cabral draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. A separate detail appears when he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Jovane Cabral.noteZh: 看Jovane Cabral的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Kelvin Pires.name: Kelvin Pires
Kelvin Pires.summary: Kelvin Spencer Pires (Portuguese: [ˈkɛl.vin ˈspɛ̃.sɛɾ ˈpi.ɾɨʃ]; born 5 June 2000) is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a centre back for Veikkausliiga club SJK and the Cape Verde national team.
Kelvin Pires.note: Pires stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. A different detail is how Pires moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Kelvin Pires.noteZh: Kelvin Pires的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Laros Duarte.name: Laros Duarte
Laros Duarte.summary: Laros Michael d'Encarnação Duarte (Dutch: [ˈla.ɾos mɪ.ˈxa.əl] Portuguese: [dẽ.kɐɾ.nɐ.ˈsɐ̃w du.ˈaɾ.tɨ]; born 28 February 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Hungarian club Puskás Akadémia.
Laros Duarte.note: For Duarte, the foundation is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Look first at how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Beyond that, watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.

Logan Costa.name: Logan Costa
Logan Costa.summary: Logan Evans Costa (Portuguese: [ˈlo.ɡɐn ˈɛ.vɐns ˈkɔʃ.tɐ]; born 1 April 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Villarreal. Born in France, he represents the Cape Verde national team.
Logan Costa.note: The key to Costa is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. Elsewhere in the game, Costa meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Logan Costa.noteZh: 最能体现Logan Costa特点的是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。除此之外，他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Marcio Rosa.name: Marcio Rosa
Marcio Rosa.summary: Márcio Salomão Brazão da Rosa (Portuguese: [ˈmaɾ.si.u sɐ.lu.ˈmɐ̃w bɾɐ.ˈzɐ̃w dɐ ˈʀɔ.zɐ]; born 23 February 1997) is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bulgarian First League club Montana and the Cape Verde national team.
Marcio Rosa.note: Rosa's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. Watch how he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. At another point in the move, he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Marcio Rosa.noteZh: 提前站位后的快速反应构成Márcio Rosa踢法的核心。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。除此之外，值得留意他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Steven Moreira.name: Steven Moreira
Steven Moreira.summary: Steven Moreira (Portuguese: [ˈsti˸.vən mu.ˈɾej.ɾɐ]; born 13 August 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back or centre-back for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew. Born in France, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.

Steven Moreira.noteZh: Steven Moreira的比赛建立在从后场加入进攻的启动时机之上。首先看他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个方面是他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Telmo Arcanjo.name: Telmo Arcanjo
Telmo Arcanjo.summary: Telmo Emanuel Gomes Arcanjo (Portuguese: [ˈtɛl.mu e.mɐ.nu.ˈɛl ˈɡo.mɨz ɐɾ.ˈkɐ̃.ʒu]; born 21 June 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for Vitória S.C. Born in Portugal, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.
Telmo Arcanjo.note: The key to Arcanjo is repeatable technique on dead balls. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. One more thing to notice is how Arcanjo plays forward toward an available runner when the opening appears.
Telmo Arcanjo.noteZh: 看Telmo Arcanjo的作用，关键是定位球上稳定而多变的脚法。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会线路出现时向前送给可接应的跑动者。

Wagner Pina.name: Wagner Pina
Wagner Pina.summary: Wagner Fabrício Cardoso de Pina (Portuguese: [ˈvag.nɛɾ fɐ.ˈbɾi.si.u kɐɾ.ˈdo.zu dɨ ˈpi.nɐ]; born 3 November 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Süper Lig club Trabzonspor. Born in Portugal, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.
Wagner Pina.note: What separates Pina is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Pina waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Also note how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Wagner Pina.noteZh: Wagner Pina的比赛建立在从后场加入进攻的启动时机之上。首先看他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个方面是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Willy Semedo.name: Willy Semedo
Willy Semedo.summary: Willy Johnson Semedo Afonso (Portuguese: [ˈwi.li ˈʤɔn.sɔn sɨ.ˈme.du ɐ.ˈfõ.su]; born 27 April 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger. Born in France, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.
Willy Semedo.note: Semedo stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. In a separate phase, Semedo moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Willy Semedo.noteZh: 防线重组前制造干净射门构成Willy Semedo踢法的核心。他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。除此之外，值得留意他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Yannick Semedo.name: Yannick Semedo
Yannick Semedo.summary: Jair Semedo Monteiro (Portuguese: [ʒɐ.ˈiɾ sɨ.ˈme.du mõ.ˈtej.ɾu]; born 29 December 1995), known as Yannick Semedo (Portuguese: [ja.ˈnik sɨ.ˈme.du]), is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Liga Portugal 2 club Farense and the...
Yannick Semedo.note: Watch Semedo for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. The clearest example is how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Also watch how Semedo plays forward toward an available runner when the opening appears.
Yannick Semedo.noteZh: Yannick Semedo的比赛建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑之上。首先看他如何在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个方面是他会线路出现时向前送给可接应的跑动者。

Nuno da Costa.name: Nuno da Costa
Nuno da Costa.summary: Nuno Miguel da Costa Jóia (Portuguese: [ˈnu.nu mi.ˈɡɛl dɐ ˈkɔʃ.tɐ ˈʒɔ.jɐ]; born 10 February 1991), known as Nuno da Costa, is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for Süper Lig club İstanbul Başakşehir and the Cape Verde...
Nuno da Costa.note: For da Costa, the foundation is making the next teammate's action easier. Look first at how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. Also watch how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Nuno da Costa.noteZh: Nuno da Costa的比赛建立在让队友下一步处理更轻松之上。首先看他如何用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。另一个方面是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Sidny Lopes Cabral.name: Sidny Lopes Cabral
Sidny Lopes Cabral.summary: Sidny Lopes Cabral (Portuguese: [ˈsid.ni ˈlɔ.pɨʃ kɐ.ˈbɾal]; born 18 September 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a full-back for Süper Lig club Trabzonspor. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.
Sidny Lopes Cabral.note: Cabral's signature is using strength without slowing the next action. Watch how he absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. Another detail is how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Sidny Lopes Cabral.noteZh: 最能体现Sidny Lopes Cabral特点的是对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。这一点直接体现在他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。除此之外，他也会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

CJ dos Santos.name: CJ dos Santos
CJ dos Santos.summary: Carlos Joaquim Antunes dos Santos (Portuguese: [ˈkaɾ.luʒ ʒu.ɐ.ˈkĩ ɐ̃.ˈtu.nɨʒ duʃ ˈsɐ̃.tuʃ]; born 24 August 2000), known as CJ dos Santos, is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC.
CJ dos Santos.note: Watch dos Santos for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. The clearest example is how he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. Also watch how dos Santos chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
CJ dos Santos.noteZh: CJ dos Santos最鲜明的特点是提前站位后的快速反应。一个直接线索是他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。另一个独立细节是他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Stopira.name: Stopira
Stopira.summary: Stopira is a Cabo Verde centre-back from SC União Torreense who gives the national team veteran defending, left-footed balance, and set-piece toughness.
Stopira.note: What separates Stopira is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Stopira holds the route into the box until support arrives. Also note how he steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself.
Stopira.noteZh: 最能体现Stopira特点的是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。这一点直接体现在他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，他也会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Ali Lajami.name: Ali Lajami
Ali Lajami.summary: Ali Mohammed Lajami (Arabic: علي محمد لاجامي; born 24 April 1996) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Saudi Pro League club Al-Hilal and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Ali Lajami.note: What separates Lajami is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. Lajami protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. In another phase of play, he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Ali Lajami.noteZh: 最能体现Ali Lajami特点的是对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。这一点直接体现在他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。除此之外，他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ali Majrashi.name: Ali Majrashi
Ali Majrashi.summary: Ali Hassan Majrashi (Arabic: علي حسن مجرشي; born 2 October 1999) is a Saudi Arabian footballer who plays as a right back for Saudi Pro League side Al-Ahli and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Ali Majrashi.note: Majrashi's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He also turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Ali Majrashi.noteZh: Ali Majrashi最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Mohamed Kanno.name: Mohamed Kanno
Mohamed Kanno.summary: Mohamed Ibrahim Abdullah Kanno (Arabic: محمد إبراهيم عبد الله كنو; born 22 September 1994) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Saudi Pro League club Al Hilal and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Mohamed Kanno.note: For Kanno, the foundation is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Look first at how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. A separate point is how he absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Mohamed Kanno.noteZh: Mohamed Kanno的优势在于等防守者注意力转移后再启动。最直接的表现是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个值得观察的细节是他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Saud Abdulhamid.name: Saud Abdulhamid
Saud Abdulhamid.summary: Saud Abdullah Salem Abdulhamid (Arabic: سُعُود عَبْد الله سَالِم عَبْد الْحَمِيد; born 18 July 1999) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Lens and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Saud Abdulhamid.note: Watch Abdulhamid for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Elsewhere, Abdulhamid turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Saud Abdulhamid.noteZh: 看Saud Abdulhamid的作用，关键是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Sultan Mandash.name: Sultan Mandash
Sultan Mandash.summary: Sultan Ahmed Mohammed Mandash (Arabic: سلطان مندش; born October 17, 1994), is a Saudi Arabian footballer who plays as a winger for Al Hilal and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Sultan Mandash.note: Mandash stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Also look at how Mandash draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Sultan Mandash.noteZh: Sultan Mandash最鲜明的特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。一个直接线索是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个独立细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Abdulelah Al-Amri.name: Abdulelah Al-Amri
Abdulelah Al-Amri.summary: Abdulelah Ali Awadh Al-Amri (Arabic: عَبْد الْإِلَه عَلِيّ عَوَض الْعُمَرِيّ; born 15 January 1997) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Abdulelah Al-Amri.note: What separates Al-Amri is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Al-Amri holds the route into the box until support arrives. At another point, he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Abdulelah Al-Amri.noteZh: 理解Abdulelah Al-Amri，要先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Abdullah Al-Hamdan.name: Abdullah Al-Hamdan
Abdullah Al-Hamdan.summary: Abdullah Abdulrahman Al-Hamdan (Arabic: عَبْد الله عَبْد الرَّحْمٰن الْحَمْدَان; born 13 September 1999) is a Saudi Arabian football player who plays as a forward for Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Abdullah Al-Hamdan.note: Al-Hamdan's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Watch how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Separately, he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Abdullah Al-Hamdan.noteZh: 理解Abdullah Al-Hamdan，要先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Abdullah Al-Khaibari.name: Abdullah Al-Khaibari
Abdullah Al-Khaibari.summary: Abdullah Mohammed Al-Khaibari (Arabic: عبد الله محمد الخيبري, born 16 August 1996) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Abdullah Al-Khaibari.note: For Al-Khaibari, the foundation is reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. Look first at how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. Beyond the first action, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Abdullah Al-Khaibari.noteZh: 最能体现Abdullah Al-Khaibari特点的是对抗后球权松动时的第一反应。这一点直接体现在他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。除此之外，他也会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Ahmed Al-Kassar.name: Ahmed Al-Kassar
Ahmed Al-Kassar.summary: Ahmed Al-Kassar is a Saudi Arabia goalkeeper from Al-Qadsiah who brings experience, reaction saves, and penalty-area control.
Ahmed Al-Kassar.note: The key to Al-Kassar is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. Elsewhere in the game, Al-Kassar leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Ahmed Al-Kassar.noteZh: 理解Ahmed Al-Kassar，要先看提前站位后的快速反应。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Alaa Hejji.name: Alaa Hejji
Alaa Hejji.summary: Alaa Hejji is a Saudi Arabia central midfielder from NEOM SC who helps connect possession and support counter-pressing phases.
Alaa Hejji.note: Al Hejji's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Separately, he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Alaa Hejji.noteZh: 压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定是理解Alaa Al Hejji踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Ayman Yahya.name: Ayman Yahya
Ayman Yahya.summary: Ayman Yahya Salem Ahmed (Arabic: أَيْمَن يَحْيَى سَالِم أَحْمَد, born 14 May 2001) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a winger or full-back for Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Ayman Yahya.note: Watch Yahya for changing direction without losing control of the ball. The clearest example is how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. A separate clue is how Yahya waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ayman Yahya.noteZh: Ayman Yahya的比赛建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下之上。首先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个方面是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Hassan Al-Tambakti.name: Hassan Al-Tambakti
Hassan Al-Tambakti.summary: Hassan Mohammed Osama Al-Tambakti (Arabic: حسان محمد أسامة التمبكتي; born 9 February 1999) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for the Saudi Arabia national team and for Saudi Pro League side Al Hilal.
Hassan Al-Tambakti.note: The key to Al-Tambakti is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. There is another side to his game: he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Hassan Al-Tambakti.noteZh: Hassan Al-Tambakti最鲜明的特点是防线暴露后的回追速度。一个直接线索是他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。另一个独立细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Hassan Kadesh.name: Hassan Kadesh
Hassan Kadesh.summary: Hassan Kadesh is a Saudi Arabia left-back from Al-Ittihad who gives the team left-footed balance, defensive experience, and set-piece presence.
Hassan Kadesh.note: What separates Kadesh is staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. Kadesh checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. A separate detail appears when he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Hassan Kadesh.noteZh: 看Hassan Kadesh的作用，关键是球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动。他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Jehad Thakri.name: Jehad Thakri
Jehad Thakri.summary: Jehad Thakri is a Saudi Arabia centre-back from Al-Qadsiah who adds size, aerial defending, and squad depth.
Jehad Thakri.note: For Thakri, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Beyond that, watch how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Jehad Thakri.noteZh: 观察Jehad Thakri时，可以先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个比赛细节是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Khalid Al-Ghannam.name: Khalid Al-Ghannam
Khalid Al-Ghannam.summary: Khalid Eissa Al-Ghannam (Arabic: خالد الغنام; born 8 November 2000) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Saudi Pro League side Al-Ettifaq and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Khalid Al-Ghannam.note: Al-Ghannam stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. A different question is whether he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Khalid Al-Ghannam.noteZh: Khalid Al-Ghannam的优势在于变向时仍把球控制在脚下。最直接的表现是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。想看得更完整，还要观察他是否会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.name: Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat
Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.summary: Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat is a Saudi Arabia right-back from Al-Qadsiah who offers recovery speed, overlap timing, and defensive energy.
Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.note: Al-Shamat's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He also turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.noteZh: 观察Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat时，可以先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个比赛细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Moteb Al-Harbi.name: Moteb Al-Harbi
Moteb Al-Harbi.summary: Moteb Al-Harbi is a Saudi Arabia left-back from Al-Hilal who brings overlap timing, recovery defending, and left-footed service.
Moteb Al-Harbi.note: For Al-Harbi, the foundation is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Look first at how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Beyond that, watch how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Moteb Al-Harbi.noteZh: Moteb Al-Harbi的优势在于从后场加入进攻的启动时机。最直接的表现是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个值得观察的细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Nasser Al-Dawsari.name: Nasser Al-Dawsari
Nasser Al-Dawsari.summary: Nasser Al-Dawsari is a Saudi Arabia central midfielder from Al-Hilal who adds coverage, passing discipline, and late shooting threat.
Nasser Al-Dawsari.note: What separates Al-Dawsari is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Al-Dawsari holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. Away from that action, he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Nasser Al-Dawsari.noteZh: Nasser Al-Dawsari的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个方面是他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Nawaf Al-Aqidi.name: Nawaf Al-Aqidi
Nawaf Al-Aqidi.summary: Nawaf Dhahi Faisal Al-Suwaiti Al-Aqidi (Arabic: نواف ضاحي فيصل الشويطي العقيدي; born 10 May 2000) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Nawaf Al-Aqidi.note: Al-Aqidi stands out for command of the crowded space around goal. He attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. Al-Aqidi also keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled.
Nawaf Al-Aqidi.noteZh: Nawaf Al-Aqidi最鲜明的特点是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。一个直接线索是他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。另一个独立细节是他会让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。

Nawaf Boushal.name: Nawaf Boushal
Nawaf Boushal.summary: Nawaf Boushal is a Saudi Arabia right-back from Al-Nassr who brings overlap energy, recovery speed, and wide defensive bite.
Nawaf Boushal.note: Watch Boushal for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. The clearest example is how he turns early and closes the runner before the box. In a different phase, Boushal gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Nawaf Boushal.noteZh: 理解Nawaf Boushal，要先看防线暴露后的回追速度。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Saleh Al-Shehri.name: Saleh Al-Shehri
Saleh Al-Shehri.summary: Saleh Khalid Mohammed Al-Shehri (Arabic: صالح خالد محمد الشهري; born 1 November 1993) is a Saudi Arabian professional football player who plays as a striker for Al-Ittihad and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Saleh Al-Shehri.note: The key to Al-Shehri is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Elsewhere in the game, Al-Shehri meets the pass without adding an extra touch.
Saleh Al-Shehri.noteZh: 理解Saleh Al-Shehri，要先看等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会迎球直接完成射门，不增加调整触球。

Musab Al-Juwayr.name: Musab Al-Juwayr
Musab Al-Juwayr.summary: Musab Fahd Al-Juwayr (Arabic: مُصْعَب فَهْد الْجُوَيْر; born 20 June 2003) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Saudi Pro League club Al-Qadsiah. Since 2023, he has also played for the Saudi Arabia national team.
Musab Al-Juwayr.note: Al-Juwayr stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Also look at how Al-Juwayr uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.

Ferran Torres.noteZh: 看Ferran Torres的作用，关键是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Gavi.name: Gavi
Gavi.summary: Pablo Martín Páez Gavira (born 5 August 2004), known as Gavi, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.
Gavi.note: What separates Gavi is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Gavi angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. At another point, he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Gavi.noteZh: Gavi的优势在于带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。最直接的表现是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个值得观察的细节是他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Joan Garcia.name: Joan Garcia
Joan Garcia.summary: Joan Garcia Pons (Catalan: [ʒuˈaŋ ɡəɾˈsiə]; born 4 May 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.
Joan Garcia.note: The key to García is staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. In another phase, García chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Joan Garcia.noteZh: Joan García的比赛建立在射门方向明确前保持身体平衡之上。首先看他如何保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。另一个方面是他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Marc Cucurella.name: Marc Cucurella
Marc Cucurella.summary: Marc Cucurella Saseta (Catalan pronunciation: [ˈmaɾ(k) kukuˈɾeʎə səˈzɛtə]; born 22 July 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for Premier League club Chelsea and the Spain national team.
Marc Cucurella.note: Cucurella stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Also look at how Cucurella turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Marc Cucurella.noteZh: Marc Cucurella的优势在于选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。最直接的表现是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个值得观察的细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Marc Pubill.name: Marc Pubill
Marc Pubill.summary: Marc Pubill Pagès (born 20 June 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right-back or centre-back for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Spain national team.
Marc Pubill.note: Pubill's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He also checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Marc Pubill.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机构成Marc Pubill踢法的核心。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，值得留意他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Marcos Llorente.name: Marcos Llorente
Marcos Llorente.summary: Marcos Llorente Moreno (born 30 January 1995) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or right-back for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Spain national team.
Marcos Llorente.note: Watch Llorente for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. A separate clue is how Llorente moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Marcos Llorente.noteZh: Marcos Llorente最鲜明的特点是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。一个直接线索是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个独立细节是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Martin Zubimendi.name: Martin Zubimendi
Martin Zubimendi.summary: Martín Zubimendi Ibáñez (born 2 February 1999) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Arsenal and the Spain national team.
Martin Zubimendi.note: For Zubimendi, the foundation is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Look first at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. A separate point is how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Martin Zubimendi.noteZh: Martín Zubimendi的优势在于压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。最直接的表现是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。另一个值得观察的细节是他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mikel Merino.name: Mikel Merino
Mikel Merino.summary: Mikel Merino Zazón (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈmikel meˈɾino]; born 22 June 1996) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or striker for Premier League club Arsenal and the Spain national team.
Mikel Merino.note: The key to Merino is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Elsewhere in the game, Merino meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Mikel Merino.noteZh: 最能体现Mikel Merino特点的是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。这一点直接体现在他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。除此之外，他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Pau Cubarsi.name: Pau Cubarsi
Pau Cubarsi.summary: Pau Cubarsí Paredes (born 22 January 2007) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.
Pau Cubarsi.note: Cubarsí stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Also look at how Cubarsí waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Pau Cubarsi.noteZh: Pau Cubarsí最鲜明的特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。一个直接线索是他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。另一个独立细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Pedro Porro.name: Pedro Porro
Pedro Porro.summary: Pedro Antonio Porro Sauceda (Spanish pronunciation: [peðɾo ˈporo]; born 13 September 1999) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Spain national team.
Pedro Porro.note: Watch Porro for delivering the ball without needing much space. The clearest example is how he looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. Also watch how Porro angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Pedro Porro.noteZh: 最能体现Pedro Porro特点的是很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。这一点直接体现在他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。除此之外，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Rodri.name: Rodri
Rodri.summary: Rodrigo Hernández Cascante (born 22 June 1996), known as Rodri or Rodrigo, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Manchester City and captains the Spain national team.
Rodri.note: Rodri's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Another detail is how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Rodri.noteZh: 最能体现Rodri特点的是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。这一点直接体现在他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。除此之外，他也会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Unai Simon.name: Unai Simon
Unai Simon.summary: Unai Simón Mendibil (born 11 June 1997) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao and the Spain national team.
Unai Simon.note: What separates Simón is starting high enough to protect the space behind his defense. Simón leaves his line early when a through ball escapes the back line. A separate detail appears when he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Unai Simon.noteZh: 最能体现Unai Simón特点的是用靠前站位保护后防身后空间。这一点直接体现在他会在直塞球越过后防时及时出击。除此之外，他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Victor Munoz.name: Victor Munoz
Victor Munoz.summary: Víctor Muñoz Villanueva (born 13 July 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left winger or forward for La Liga club Osasuna and the Spain national team. He will join Premier League club Liverpool on 1 July 2026.
Victor Munoz.note: What separates Muñoz is explosive speed once open grass appears. Muñoz changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. At another point, he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Victor Munoz.noteZh: Víctor Muñoz最鲜明的特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。一个直接线索是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个独立细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Yeremy Pino.name: Yeremy Pino
Yeremy Pino.summary: Yéremy Jesús Pino Santos (born 20 October 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Premier League club Crystal Palace and the Spain national team.
Yeremy Pino.note: Watch Pino for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. The clearest example is how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Also watch how Pino moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Yeremy Pino.noteZh: 理解Yéremy Pino，要先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Ahmed Fatouh.name: Ahmed Fatouh
Ahmed Fatouh.summary: Ahmed Mohamed Aboelfatouh Mohamed (Arabic: أحمد محمد أبو الفتوح محمد; born 22 March 1998), simply known as Ahmed Fatouh (Arabic: أحمد فتوح), is an Egyptian footballer who plays for Egyptian Premier League side Zamalek and the Egypt national team as a left-back...
Ahmed Fatouh.note: What separates Fatouh is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Fatouh waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. At another point, he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Ahmed Fatouh.noteZh: 观察Ahmed Fatouh时，可以先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个比赛细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Haissem Hassan.name: Haissem Hassan
Haissem Hassan.summary: Haissem Yousry Fouad A Hassan (Egyptian Arabic: هيثم يسري فؤاد حسن; born 8 February 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Segunda División club Real Oviedo. Born in France, he plays for the Egypt national team.
Haissem Hassan.note: Hassan's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. At another point in the move, he plays forward toward an available runner when the opening appears.
Haissem Hassan.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Haissem Hassan踢法的关键。先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。到了另一个比赛环节，他会线路出现时向前送给可接应的跑动者。

Hamdy Fathy.name: Hamdy Fathy
Hamdy Fathy.summary: Hamdy Fathy Abdelhalim Abdelfattah (Arabic: حمدي فتحي عبد الحليم عبد الفتاح; born 29 September 1994) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Qatar Stars League club Al-Wakrah and the Egypt national team.
Hamdy Fathy.note: For Fathy, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. A separate point is how he moves the ball to the next available teammate without holding it.
Hamdy Fathy.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Hamdy Fathy踢法的关键。先看他如何守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会不拖延持球，把球交给下一名可接应的队友。

Hamza Abdelkarim.name: Hamza Abdelkarim
Hamza Abdelkarim.summary: Hamza Mohamed Abdelkarim E Selim (Arabic: حمزة محمد عبد الكريم سليم; born 1 January 2008) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Segunda Federación – Group 3 club Barcelona Atlètic and the Egypt national team.
Hamza Abdelkarim.note: Abdelkarim stands out for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. A different detail is how Abdelkarim angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Hamza Abdelkarim.noteZh: Hamza Abdelkarim的比赛建立在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动之上。首先看他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。另一个方面是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Hossam Abdelmaguid.name: Hossam Abdelmaguid
Hossam Abdelmaguid.summary: Hossam Abdelmageed Abdelsalam Abdelmegeed (Arabic: حسام عبد المجيد عبد السلام عبد المجيد; born 30 April 2001) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Egyptian Premier League club Zamalek and the Egypt national team.
Hossam Abdelmaguid.note: Watch Abdelmaguid for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. The clearest example is how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. A separate clue is how Abdelmaguid moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Hossam Abdelmaguid.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Hossam Abdelmaguid踢法的关键。先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Ibrahim Adel.name: Ibrahim Adel
Ibrahim Adel.summary: Ibrahim Adel Aly Mohamed Hassan (Arabic: إِبْرَاهِيم عَادِل عَلِيّ مُحَمَّد حَسَن; born 23 April 2001), is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays for Danish Superliga club Nordsjælland, on loan from UAE Pro League side Al Jazira as a left winger and the...
Ibrahim Adel.note: The key to Adel is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. In another phase, Adel shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ibrahim Adel.noteZh: 看Ibrahim Adel的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Karim Hafez.name: Karim Hafez
Karim Hafez.summary: Karim Hafez Ramadan Seifeldin (Arabic: كَرِيم حَافِظ رَمَضَان سَيْف الدِّين; born 12 March 1996) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays for Egyptian Premier League club Pyramids and the Egypt national team as a left-back.
Karim Hafez.note: Hafez stands out for delivering the ball without needing much space. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. A different question is whether he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Karim Hafez.noteZh: 很小空间里也能送出传中的能力是理解Karim Hafez踢法的关键。先看他如何在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。另一个问题是，Karim Hafez是否会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Mahdy Soliman.name: Mahdy Soliman
Mahdy Soliman.summary: El Mahdy Mohamed Soliman Ibrahim (Arabic: المهدي محمد سليمان إبراهيم; born 8 June 1987) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Egyptian Premier League side Zamalek SC and the Egypt national team.
Mahdy Soliman.note: The key to Soliman is command of the crowded space around goal. He leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders. One more thing to notice is how Soliman sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Mahdy Soliman.noteZh: 看El Mahdy Soliman的作用，关键是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Mahmoud Saber.summary: Mahmoud Saber Abdelmohsen Hassan Abdelmohsen (Arabic: مَحْمُود صَابِر عَبْد الْمُحْسِن حَسَنْ عَبْد الْمُحْسِن; born 30 July 2001) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Egyptian Premier League club ZED on loan from...
Mahmoud Saber.note: What separates Saber is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Saber angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Away from that action, he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Mahmoud Saber.noteZh: 带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑构成Mahmoud Saber踢法的核心。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。除此之外，值得留意他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Marawan Attia.name: Marawan Attia
Marawan Attia.summary: Marwan Attia Fahim Ghallab (Arabic: مروان عطية فاهم غلاب رشوان; born 1 August 1998) is an Egyptian footballer who plays as a midfielder for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Egypt national team.
Marawan Attia.note: Watch Attia for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. The clearest example is how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. In a different phase, Attia holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.

Mohamed Abdelmoneim.name: Mohamed Abdelmoneim
Mohamed Abdelmoneim.summary: Mohamed Abdelmoneim is an Egypt centre-back from OGC Nice who gives the national team front-foot defending, aerial power, and aggressive stepping.
Mohamed Abdelmoneim.note: Abdelmonem's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Watch how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Another detail is how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Mohamed Abdelmoneim.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢是理解Mohamed Abdelmonem踢法的关键。先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。到了另一个比赛环节，他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Mohamed Alaa.name: Mohamed Alaa
Mohamed Alaa.summary: Mohamed Alaaeldin Soliman M Ahmed (محمد علاء الدين سليمان أحمد; born 1 January 1999) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Egyptian Premier League club El Gouna and the Egypt national team.
Mohamed Alaa.note: For Alaa, the foundation is protecting the centre before the shooter reveals the finish. Look first at how he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot. For a wider picture, notice whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Mohamed Alaa.noteZh: 最能体现Mohamed Alaa特点的是射手暴露射门方向前先守住球门中央。这一点直接体现在他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。接着可以问，他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Mohamed El Shenawy.name: Mohamed El Shenawy
Mohamed El Shenawy.summary: Mohamed El Sayed Mohamed El Shenawy Gomaa (Arabic: محمد السيد محمد الشناوي جمعة; born 18 December 1988) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly, which he captains, and the Egypt national team.
Mohamed El Shenawy.note: Watch El Shenawy for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. The clearest example is how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. A separate clue is how El Shenawy keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required.
Mohamed El Shenawy.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友是理解Mohamed El Shenawy踢法的关键。先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。

Mohanad Lashin.name: Mohanad Lashin
Mohanad Lashin.summary: Mohanad Lashin is an Egypt defensive midfielder from Pyramids FC who gives the national team central coverage, ball winning, and simple progression.
Mohanad Lashin.note: What separates Lasheen is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Lasheen waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Away from that action, he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Mohanad Lashin.noteZh: 观察Mohanad Lasheen时，可以先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Mostafa Shoubir.name: Mostafa Shoubir
Mostafa Shoubir.summary: Mostafa Shoubir is an Egypt goalkeeper from Al Ahly who gives the national team reaction saves, line command, and close-range stops.
Mostafa Shoubir.note: The key to Shobeir is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. One more thing to notice is how Shobeir keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Mostafa Shoubir.noteZh: 看Mostafa Shobeir的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Nabil Donga.name: Nabil Donga
Nabil Donga.summary: Nabil Emad Aly Elmahdy (Arabic: نبيل عماد علي المهدي; born 6 April 1996) also known as Donga (Arabic: دونجا), is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Saudi Pro League club Al-Najma and the Egypt national team.
Nabil Donga.note: For Emad, the foundation is reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. Look first at how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. Separately, look at how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Nabil Donga.noteZh: 观察Nabil Emad时，可以先看对抗后球权松动时的第一反应。他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。另一个比赛细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Ramy Rabia.name: Ramy Rabia
Ramy Rabia.summary: Ramy Hisham Abdel Aziz Mostafa Rabia (Arabic: رامي هشام عبد العزيز مصطفى ربيعة; born 20 May 1993) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for UAE Pro League club Al Ain and the Egypt national team.
Ramy Rabia.note: Rabia stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself. Rabia also slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Ramy Rabia.noteZh: Ramy Rabia最鲜明的特点是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。一个直接线索是他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。另一个独立细节是他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Tarek Alaa.name: Tarek Alaa
Tarek Alaa.summary: Tarek Alaa is an Egypt right-back from ZED FC who gives the national team right-side defending, overlap energy, and recovery runs.
Tarek Alaa.note: Alaa's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Away from that moment, he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Tarek Alaa.noteZh: Tarek Alaa的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个方面是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Yasser Ibrahim.name: Yasser Ibrahim
Yasser Ibrahim.summary: Yasser Ibrahim Ahmed El Hanafi (Arabic: يَاسِر إبرَاهِيْم أَحمَد الْحَنَفِي; born 10 February 1993) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Egypt national team.
Yasser Ibrahim.note: What separates Ibrahim is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. Ibrahim protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. Away from that action, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Yasser Ibrahim.noteZh: Yasser Ibrahim的比赛建立在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择之上。首先看他如何先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Zizo.name: Zizo
Zizo.summary: Ahmed Mostafa Mohamed Sayed (Arabic: أحمد مصطفى محمد سيد; born 10 January 1996) commonly known as Zizo (Arabic: زيزو), is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Egypt national team.
Zizo.note: Zizo stands out for delivering the ball without needing much space. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. In a separate phase, Zizo varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Zizo.noteZh: Zizo最鲜明的特点是很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。一个直接线索是他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。另一个独立细节是他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Ali Alipour.name: Ali Alipour
Ali Alipour.summary: Ali Alipour (Persian: علی علیپور; born 11 November 1995) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a Striker for Persian Gulf Pro League club Persepolis and the Iran national team.
Ali Alipour.note: What separates Alipour is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Alipour arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Away from that action, he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Ali Alipour.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动是理解Ali Alipour踢法的关键。先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Ali Nemati.name: Ali Nemati
Ali Nemati.summary: Ali Nemati is an IR Iran centre-back from Foolad FC who gives the national team left-footed defending, aerial cover, and back-line depth.

Ali Nemati.noteZh: Ali Nemati的比赛建立在球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动之上。首先看他如何在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。另一个方面是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Alireza Beiranvand.name: Alireza Beiranvand

Alireza Beiranvand.note: Beiranvand stands out for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. In a separate phase, Beiranvand chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.

Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.name: Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.summary: Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh is an IR Iran forward from Tractor FC who gives the national team quick turns, final-third carrying, and attacking spark.

Amirmohammad Razaghinia.name: Amirmohammad Razaghinia

Danial Iri.name: Danial Iri

Dennis Dargahi.name: Dennis Dargahi
Dennis Dargahi.summary: Dennis Yerai Eckert Ayensa (born 9 January 1997), also known as Dennis Dargahi, is a professional footballer who plays as a forward and midfielder for Standard Liège in the Belgian Pro League.

Ehsan Hajisafi.name: Ehsan Hajisafi

Payam Niazmand.summary: Payam Niazmand (Persian: پیام نیازمند; born 6 April 1995) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Iranian club Persepolis and the Iran national team.

Roozbeh Cheshmi.name: Roozbeh Cheshmi

Shahriyar Moghanloo.name: Shahriyar Moghanloo

Jesse Randall.name: Jesse Randall
