Joe Bell.summary: Joe Zen Robert Bell (born 27 April 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Eliteserien club Viking and the New Zealand national team.
Joe Bell.note: Bell's signature is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Watch how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Away from that moment, he varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Joe Bell.noteZh: 用传球的力度和角度移动防线构成Joe Bell踢法的核心。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。除此之外，值得留意他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Kosta Barbarouses.name: Kosta Barbarouses
Kosta Barbarouses.summary: Konstantinos "Kosta" Barbarouses (Greek: Κωνσταντίνος "Κώστας" Μπαρμπαρούσης, pronounced [konstaˈndinos barbaruˈsis]; born 19 February 1990) is a New Zealand professional footballer who last played as a winger for A-League Men club Western Sydney Wanderers and...
Kosta Barbarouses.note: Watch Barbarouses for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. The clearest example is how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. A separate clue is how Barbarouses arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Kosta Barbarouses.noteZh: 最能体现Kosta Barbarouses特点的是防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。这一点直接体现在他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。除此之外，他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Lachlan Bayliss.name: Lachlan Bayliss
Lachlan Bayliss.summary: Lachlan Ryan Bayliss (born 24 July 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for A-League Men side Auckland FC. Born in Australia, he represents the New Zealand national team.
Lachlan Bayliss.note: Bayliss stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. In a separate phase, Bayliss moves the ball to the next available teammate without holding it.
Lachlan Bayliss.noteZh: 最能体现Lachlan Bayliss特点的是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。这一点直接体现在他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。除此之外，他也会不拖延持球，把球交给下一名可接应的队友。

Logan Rogerson.name: Logan Rogerson
Logan Rogerson.summary: Logan Tipene Rogerson (Māori: [ˈti.pɛ.nɛ]; born 28 May 1998) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a winger for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national team.
Logan Rogerson.note: For Rogerson, the foundation is making purposeful movement away from the ball. Look first at how he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. A separate point is how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Logan Rogerson.noteZh: 看Logan Rogerson的作用，关键是有目的地进行无球移动。他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Marko Stamenic.name: Marko Stamenic
Marko Stamenic.summary: Marko Seufatu Nikola Stamenić (Serbian Cyrillic: Марко Сеуфату Никола Стаменић; born 19 February 2002) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the New Zealand national team.
Marko Stamenic.note: What separates Stamenic is carrying momentum through open midfield. Stamenic pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Away from that action, he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Marko Stamenic.noteZh: 带球穿过开放中场的推进力是理解Marko Stamenic踢法的关键。先看他如何把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。到了另一个比赛环节，他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Max Crocombe.name: Max Crocombe
Max Crocombe.summary: Maxime Teremoana Crocombe (born 12 August 1993) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Millwall and the New Zealand national team.
Max Crocombe.note: Crocombe stands out for command of the crowded space around goal. He attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. In a separate phase, Crocombe keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Max Crocombe.noteZh: 理解Max Crocombe，要先看掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Michael Boxall.name: Michael Boxall
Michael Boxall.summary: Michael Joseph Boxall (born 18 August 1988) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club Minnesota United and the New Zealand national team.
Michael Boxall.note: What separates Boxall is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Boxall keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Away from that action, he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Michael Boxall.noteZh: 最能体现Michael Boxall特点的是危险出现前组织好队友。这一点直接体现在他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。除此之外，他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Michael Woud.name: Michael Woud
Michael Woud.summary: Michael Cornelis Woud (Dutch: [ʋʌut]; born 16 January 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national team.
Michael Woud.note: The key to Woud is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. In another phase, Woud restarts play toward an available teammate.
Michael Woud.noteZh: 看Michael Woud的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会把球重新交给可以接应的队友。

Nando Pijnaker.name: Nando Pijnaker
Nando Pijnaker.summary: Nando Zen Pijnaker (Dutch: [ˈnɑndo zɛn ˈpɛi̯.nɑ.kər]; born 25 February 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre back for A-League Men club Auckland FC. Born in the Netherlands, he represents the New Zealand national team.
Nando Pijnaker.note: Watch Pijnaker for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. The clearest example is how he protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. A separate clue is how Pijnaker plays the available pass with his left foot.
Nando Pijnaker.noteZh: 看Nando Pijnaker的作用，关键是对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会用左脚送出眼前可行的传球。

Ryan Thomas.name: Ryan Thomas
Ryan Thomas.summary: Ryan Jared Thomas (born 20 December 1994) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle and the New Zealand national team.
Ryan Thomas.note: For Thomas, the foundation is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Look first at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Beyond that, watch how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Ryan Thomas.noteZh: 理解Ryan Thomas，要先看压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Tim Payne.name: Tim Payne
Tim Payne.summary: Tim Payne is a New Zealand right-back from Wellington Phoenix who gives the national team right-back reliability, wide defending, and overlap support.
Tim Payne.note: Payne's signature is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. Watch how he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. For a wider read, also watch whether he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Tim Payne.noteZh: 封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者是理解Tim Payne踢法的关键。先看他如何靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。另一个问题是，Tim Payne是否会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Tommy Smith.name: Tommy Smith
Tommy Smith.summary: Tommy Smith is a New Zealand centre-back from Auckland FC who gives the national team experience, aerial duels, and back-line organization.
Tommy Smith.note: Watch Smith for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. The clearest example is how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. In a different phase, Smith slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Tommy Smith.noteZh: 看Tommy Smith的作用，关键是危险出现前组织好队友。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Tyler Bindon.name: Tyler Bindon

Tyler Bindon.noteZh: 看Tyler Bindon的作用，关键是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Alexis Saelemaekers.name: Alexis Saelemaekers

Alexis Saelemaekers.noteZh: 观察Alexis Saelemaekers时，可以先看球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动。他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。另一个比赛细节是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Amadou Onana.name: Amadou Onana

Amadou Onana.noteZh: Amadou Onana最鲜明的特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。一个直接线索是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个独立细节是他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Arthur Theate.name: Arthur Theate

Arthur Theate.noteZh: Arthur Theate的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个方面是他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Brandon Mechele.note: Mechele's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Separately, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Brandon Mechele.noteZh: Brandon Mechele最鲜明的特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。一个直接线索是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个独立细节是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Charles De Ketelaere.name: Charles De Ketelaere
Charles De Ketelaere.summary: Charles Marc S. De Ketelaere (Dutch pronunciation: [də ˈkeːtəˌlaːrə]; born 10 March 2001) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or forward for Serie A club Atalanta and the Belgium national team.
Charles De Ketelaere.note: Watch De Ketelaere for making the next teammate's action easier. The clearest example is how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. Also watch how De Ketelaere opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Charles De Ketelaere.noteZh: Charles De Ketelaere的优势在于让队友下一步处理更轻松。最直接的表现是他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Diego Moreira.note: What separates Moreira is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. Moreira turns early and closes the runner before the box. At another point, he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Diego Moreira.noteZh: 理解Diego Moreira，要先看防线暴露后的回追速度。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Dodi Lukebakio.name: Dodi Lukebakio
Dodi Lukebakio.summary: Dodi Lukébakio Ngandoli (born 24 September 1997) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a right winger or right midfielder for Primeira Liga club Benfica and the Belgium national team.
Dodi Lukebakio.note: For Lukébakio, the foundation is using strength without slowing the next action. Look first at how he absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. Also watch how he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Dodi Lukebakio.noteZh: 看Dodi Lukébakio的作用，关键是对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Hans Vanaken.name: Hans Vanaken
Hans Vanaken.summary: Hans Vanaken (born 24 August 1992) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Belgian Pro League club Club Brugge and the Belgium national team.
Hans Vanaken.note: Vanaken stands out for reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. Another aspect is how Vanaken moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Hans Vanaken.noteZh: Hans Vanaken的比赛建立在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段之上。首先看他如何提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。另一个方面是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Joaquin Seys.name: Joaquin Seys
Joaquin Seys.summary: Joaquin Ronny Seys (born 28 March 2005) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Belgian Pro League club Club Brugge and the Belgium national team.
Joaquin Seys.note: The key to Seys is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. A separate part of his game is how Seys turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Joaquin Seys.noteZh: Joaquin Seys的优势在于从后场加入进攻的启动时机。最直接的表现是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个值得观察的细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Koni De Winter.name: Koni De Winter
Koni De Winter.summary: Koni De Winter (born 12 June 2002) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as centre-back for Serie A club AC Milan and the Belgium national team.

Koni De Winter.noteZh: Koni De Winter的比赛建立在第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位之上。首先看他如何提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。另一个方面是他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Matias Fernandez-Pardo.name: Matias Fernandez-Pardo
Matias Fernandez-Pardo.summary: Matias Fernandez-Pardo (born 3 February 2005) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a wide midfielder or forward for Ligue 1 club Lille and the Belgium national team.
Matias Fernandez-Pardo.note: Watch Fernandez-Pardo for carrying momentum through open midfield. The clearest example is how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. In a different phase, Fernandez-Pardo angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Matias Fernandez-Pardo.noteZh: 带球穿过开放中场的推进力是理解Matías Fernandez-Pardo踢法的关键。先看他如何把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Maxim De Cuyper.name: Maxim De Cuyper
Maxim De Cuyper.summary: Maxim Peter M. De Cuyper (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmɑksɪm də ˈkœypər]; born 22 December 2000) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a full-back or left midfielder for Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion and the Belgium national team.
Maxim De Cuyper.note: For De Cuyper, the foundation is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. Look first at how he turns early and protects the route toward goal. A separate point is how he looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Maxim De Cuyper.noteZh: Maxim De Cuyper最鲜明的特点是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。一个直接线索是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。另一个独立细节是他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Mike Penders.name: Mike Penders
Mike Penders.summary: Mike Louis Penders (born 31 July 2005) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Chelsea and the Belgium national team.
Mike Penders.note: Penders's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. Watch how he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. For a wider read, also watch whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Mike Penders.noteZh: 提前站位后的快速反应是理解Mike Penders踢法的关键。先看他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。另一个问题是，Mike Penders是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Nathan Ngoy.name: Nathan Ngoy
Nathan Ngoy.summary: Nathan Ngoy (born 10 June 2003) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays for Ligue 1 club Lille and the Belgium national team.
Nathan Ngoy.note: Ngoy stands out for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. A different detail is how Ngoy moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Nathan Ngoy.noteZh: 第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位是理解Nathan Ngoy踢法的关键。先看他如何提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。到了另一个比赛环节，他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Nicolas Raskin.name: Nicolas Raskin
Nicolas Raskin.summary: Nicolas Thierry Y. Raskin (born 23 February 2001) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Rangers and the Belgium national team.
Nicolas Raskin.note: What separates Raskin is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Raskin waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Away from that action, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.

Senne Lammens.name: Senne Lammens
Senne Lammens.summary: Senne Lammens (Dutch: ['sɛnə 'lɑməns]; born 7 July 2002) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Manchester United and the Belgium national team. Lammens commenced his senior football career at Club Brugge.
Senne Lammens.note: Lammens's signature is command of the crowded space around goal. Watch how he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders. Another detail is how he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Senne Lammens.noteZh: Senne Lammens最鲜明的特点是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。一个直接线索是他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。另一个独立细节是他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Thibaut Courtois.name: Thibaut Courtois
Thibaut Courtois.summary: Thibaut Nicolas Marc Courtois (French pronunciation: [tibo kuʁtwa]; Dutch pronunciation: [ˈtiboː kurˈtʋaː]; born 11 May 1992) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Real Madrid and the Belgium national team.
Thibaut Courtois.note: The key to Courtois is protecting the centre before the shooter reveals the finish. He sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot. Elsewhere in the game, Courtois leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Thibaut Courtois.noteZh: 最能体现Thibaut Courtois特点的是射手暴露射门方向前先守住球门中央。这一点直接体现在他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。除此之外，他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Thomas Meunier.name: Thomas Meunier
Thomas Meunier.summary: Thomas André A. Meunier (French pronunciation: [tɔma mønje]; born 12 September 1991) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Lille and the Belgium national team.
Thomas Meunier.note: For Meunier, the foundation is arriving at the far side after defenders have narrowed toward the ball. Look first at how he holds the far-post lane, then attacks it as the cross leaves the passer. Separately, look at how he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Thomas Meunier.noteZh: 观察Thomas Meunier时，可以先看等防守者向球侧收缩后再到达后点。他会先留在后点线路，等传中离脚后再启动攻击落点。另一个比赛细节是他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Timothy Castagne.name: Timothy Castagne
Timothy Castagne.summary: Timothy Castagne (French pronunciation: [timɔti kastaɲ]; born 5 December 1995) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a full back for Premier League club Fulham and the Belgium national team.
Timothy Castagne.note: Watch Castagne for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. In a different phase, Castagne changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Timothy Castagne.noteZh: Timothy Castagne最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Youri Tielemans.name: Youri Tielemans
Youri Tielemans.summary: Youri Marion A. Tielemans (born 7 May 1997) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Aston Villa and captains the Belgium national team.
Youri Tielemans.note: The key to Tielemans is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. In another phase, Tielemans uses a clean first touch to open a shooting lane from distance.
Youri Tielemans.noteZh: 用传球的力度和角度移动防线是理解Youri Tielemans踢法的关键。先看他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。到了另一个比赛环节，他会用干净的第一脚触球打开远射线路。

Zeno Debast.name: Zeno Debast
Zeno Debast.summary: Zeno Koen Debast (born 24 October 2003) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays for Primeira Liga club Sporting CP and the Belgium national team. Primarily a centre-back, he can also be deployed as a defensive midfielder.
Zeno Debast.note: Debast's signature is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Watch how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Away from that moment, he adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Zeno Debast.noteZh: Zeno Debast的优势在于用传球的力度和角度移动防线。最直接的表现是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。另一个值得观察的细节是他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Alberto Quintero.name: Alberto Quintero
Alberto Quintero.summary: Alberto Abdiel Quintero Medina (born 18 December 1987) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays for C.D. Plaza Amador and the Panama national team as a winger.
Alberto Quintero.note: Watch Quintero for changing direction without losing control of the ball. The clearest example is how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Elsewhere, Quintero slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Alberto Quintero.noteZh: Alberto Quintero的优势在于变向时仍把球控制在脚下。最直接的表现是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个值得观察的细节是他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Andres Andrade.name: Andres Andrade
Andres Andrade.summary: Andrés Alberto Andrade Cedeño (born 16 October 1998) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Austrian Football Bundesliga club LASK and the Panama national team.
Andres Andrade.note: For Andrade, the foundation is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Look first at how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Separately, look at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Andres Andrade.noteZh: 看Andrés Andrade的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Anibal Godoy.name: Anibal Godoy
Anibal Godoy.summary: Aníbal Casis Godoy Lemus (Spanish: [aˈniβal ɣoˈðoj]; born 10 February 1990) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC and captains the Panama national team.
Anibal Godoy.note: Godoy's signature is organizing the nearby unit before the next phase begins. Watch how he uses short cues to keep nearby passing and pressing options connected. Separately, he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Anibal Godoy.noteZh: 看Aníbal Godoy的作用，关键是下一阶段开始前组织身边队友。他会用简短提醒让附近的传球与逼抢选择保持连接。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Azarias Londono.name: Azarias Londono
Azarias Londono.summary: Azarias Emmanuel Londoño González (born 21 June 2001) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as forward for Universidad Católica, on loan from Alianza, and the Panama national team.
Azarias Londono.note: For Londoño, the foundation is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Look first at how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Beyond that, watch how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Azarias Londono.noteZh: 看Azarias Londoño的作用，关键是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Carlos Harvey.name: Carlos Harvey
Carlos Harvey.summary: Carlos Miguel Harvey Cesneros (born 3 February 2000) is a Panamaian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club Minnesota United FC and the Panama national team.
Carlos Harvey.note: Watch Harvey for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. The clearest example is how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. Also watch how Harvey moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Carlos Harvey.noteZh: Carlos Harvey的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Cecilio Waterman.name: Cecilio Waterman
Cecilio Waterman.summary: Cecilio Alfonso Waterman Ruiz (born 13 April 1991) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Chilean club Universidad de Concepción and the Panama national team.
Cecilio Waterman.note: What separates Waterman is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. Waterman starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. Also note how he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Cecilio Waterman.noteZh: Cecilio Waterman最鲜明的特点是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。一个直接线索是他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。另一个独立细节是他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Cesar Blackman.name: Cesar Blackman
Cesar Blackman.summary: César Rodolfo Blackman Camarena (born 2 April 1998) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Slovak First Football League club Slovan Bratislava and the Panama national team.
Cesar Blackman.note: Blackman stands out for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Another aspect is how Blackman turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Cesar Blackman.noteZh: 最能体现César Blackman特点的是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。这一点直接体现在他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Cesar Samudio.name: Cesar Samudio
Cesar Samudio.summary: César Jair Samudio Murillo (born 23 February 1994) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Honduran side Marathón and the Panama national team.
Cesar Samudio.note: The key to Samudio is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. In another phase, Samudio leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Cesar Samudio.noteZh: 最能体现César Samudio特点的是提前站位后的快速反应。这一点直接体现在他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。除此之外，他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Cesar Yanis.name: Cesar Yanis
Cesar Yanis.summary: César Augusto Yanis Velasco (born 28 January 1996) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as left winger for Chilean club Cobresal, on loan from Costa Rican club San Carlos, and the Panama national team.
Cesar Yanis.note: Yanis's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He also pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Cesar Yanis.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下构成César Yanis踢法的核心。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。除此之外，值得留意他会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Cristian Martinez.name: Cristian Martinez
Cristian Martinez.summary: Cristian Jesús Martínez (born 6 February 1997) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Israeli Premier League club Ironi Kiryat Shmona and the Panama national team.
Cristian Martinez.note: What separates Martínez is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Martínez waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. In another phase of play, he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Cristian Martinez.noteZh: 观察Cristian Martínez时，可以先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Edgar Yoel Barcenas.name: Edgar Yoel Barcenas
Edgar Yoel Barcenas.summary: Édgar Yoel Bárcenas Herrera (born 23 October 1993) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a winger for the Panama national team.
Edgar Yoel Barcenas.note: Watch Bárcenas for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. The clearest example is how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. In a different phase, Bárcenas varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Edgar Yoel Barcenas.noteZh: Yoel Bárcenas最鲜明的特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。一个直接线索是他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个独立细节是他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Edgardo Farina.name: Edgardo Farina
Edgardo Farina.summary: Edgardo Issac Fariña Wynter (born 19 October 2001) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Russian Premier League club Pari Nizhny Novgorod and the Panama national team.
Edgardo Farina.note: Fariña's signature is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. Watch how he turns early and protects the route toward goal. Away from that moment, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Edgardo Farina.noteZh: Edgardo Fariña的优势在于第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。最直接的表现是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。另一个值得观察的细节是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Eric Davis.name: Eric Davis
Eric Davis.summary: Eric Javier Davis Grajales (born 31 March 1991) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Plaza Amador and the Panama national team.
Eric Davis.note: Davis stands out for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear. In a separate phase, Davis serves corners and free kicks into the attacking area.
Eric Davis.noteZh: Eric Davis最鲜明的特点是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。一个直接线索是他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。另一个独立细节是他会把角球和任意球送入进攻区域。

Fidel Escobar.name: Fidel Escobar

Fidel Escobar.note: For Escobar, the foundation is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Look first at how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. A separate point is how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Fidel Escobar.noteZh: 最能体现Fidel Escobar特点的是危险出现前组织好队友。这一点直接体现在他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。除此之外，他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Jiovany Ramos.name: Jiovany Ramos
Jiovany Ramos.summary: Jiovany Javier Ramos Díaz (born 26 January 1997) is a Panamanian footballer who plays as a centre-back for Venezuelan Primera División side Puerto Cabello, on loan from CAI, and the Panama national team.
Jiovany Ramos.note: The key to Ramos is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. In another phase, Ramos steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself.
Jiovany Ramos.noteZh: 观察Jiovany Ramos时，可以先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个比赛细节是他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Jorge Gutierrez.name: Jorge Gutierrez
Jorge Gutierrez.summary: Jorge Abdiel Gutiérrez Cornejo (born 1 September 1998) is a Panamanian football player who plays as left-back for Deportivo La Guaira, and the Panama national team.
Jorge Gutierrez.note: What separates Gutiérrez is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Gutiérrez waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate detail appears when he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Jorge Gutierrez.noteZh: 最能体现Jorge Gutiérrez特点的是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。这一点直接体现在他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Jose Cordoba.name: Jose Cordoba
Jose Cordoba.summary: José Ángel Córdoba Chambers (born 3 June 2001) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Norwich City and the Panama national team.
Jose Cordoba.note: The key to Córdoba is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. The next thing to watch is whether he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Jose Cordoba.noteZh: 理解José Córdoba，要先看第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。下一个值得观察的问题是，他是否会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Jose Fajardo.name: Jose Fajardo
Jose Fajardo.summary: José Fajardo Nelson (born 18 August 1993) is a Panamanian footballer who plays as a forward for Universidad Catolica del Ecuador on loan from CAI and the Panama national team.
Jose Fajardo.note: For Fajardo, the foundation is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. Look first at how he starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. Beyond that, watch how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Jose Fajardo.noteZh: 看José Fajardo的作用，关键是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Jose Luis Rodriguez.name: Jose Luis Rodriguez
Jose Luis Rodriguez.summary: José Luis Rodríguez Francis (born 19 June 1998), commonly known as Puma, is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Liga MX club Juárez and the Panama national team.

Jose Luis Rodriguez.noteZh: José Luis Rodríguez的优势在于看到空当后的爆发速度。最直接的表现是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个值得观察的细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Luis Mejia.name: Luis Mejia
Luis Mejia.summary: Luis Ricardo Mejía Cajar (born 16 March 1991) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Uruguayan Primera División club Nacional and the Panama national team.
Luis Mejia.note: Watch Mejía for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. The clearest example is how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Also watch how Mejía sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Luis Mejia.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友构成Luis Mejía踢法的核心。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。除此之外，值得留意他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Orlando Mosquera.name: Orlando Mosquera
Orlando Mosquera.summary: Orlando Mosquera (born 25 December 1994), commonly known as Kuty Mosquera, is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Saudi Pro League club Al-Fayha and the Panama national team.
Orlando Mosquera.note: Mosquera stands out for staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. Mosquera also leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Orlando Mosquera.noteZh: 射门方向明确前保持身体平衡构成Orlando Mosquera踢法的核心。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。除此之外，值得留意他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Roderick Miller.name: Roderick Miller
Roderick Miller.summary: Roderick Alonso Miller Molina (born 3 April 1992) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Azerbaijan Premier League club Turan Tovuz and the Panama national team.
Roderick Miller.note: The key to Miller is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself. In another phase, Miller absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Roderick Miller.noteZh: Roderick Miller的优势在于争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。最直接的表现是他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。另一个值得观察的细节是他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Tomas Rodriguez.name: Tomas Rodriguez
Tomas Rodriguez.summary: Tomás Abdiel Rodríguez Mena (born 9 March 1999) is a Panamanian footballer who plays as a forward for Monagas and Panama national team.
Tomas Rodriguez.note: For Rodríguez, the foundation is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Look first at how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Separately, look at how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.

Anthony Gordon.name: Anthony Gordon
Anthony Gordon.summary: Anthony Michael Gordon (born 24 February 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays primarily as a winger for Premier League club Newcastle United and the England national team.
Anthony Gordon.note: Gordon stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Another aspect is how Gordon draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Anthony Gordon.noteZh: 理解Anthony Gordon，要先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Bukayo Saka.name: Bukayo Saka
Bukayo Saka.summary: Bukayo Ayoyinka Temidayo Moses Saka (, born 5 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Premier League club Arsenal and the England national team.
Bukayo Saka.note: For Saka, the foundation is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Look first at how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Separately, look at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Bukayo Saka.noteZh: 比防线早一步看到决定性的传球构成Bukayo Saka踢法的核心。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。除此之外，值得留意他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Dan Burn.name: Dan Burn
Dan Burn.summary: Daniel Johnson Burn (born 9 May 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Newcastle United and the England national team.
Dan Burn.note: Burn stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. In a separate phase, Burn meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Dan Burn.noteZh: 看Dan Burn的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Dean Henderson.name: Dean Henderson
Dean Henderson.summary: Dean Bradley Henderson (born 12 March 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Crystal Palace, whom he captains, and the England national team.
Dean Henderson.note: What separates Henderson is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. Henderson sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. In another phase of play, he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Dean Henderson.noteZh: Dean Henderson的比赛建立在提前站位后的快速反应之上。首先看他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。另一个方面是他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Djed Spence.name: Djed Spence

Djed Spence.note: Watch Spence for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. The clearest example is how he turns early and closes the runner before the box. In a different phase, Spence waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Djed Spence.noteZh: 防线暴露后的回追速度构成Djed Spence踢法的核心。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。除此之外，值得留意他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Eberechi Eze.name: Eberechi Eze
Eberechi Eze.summary: Eberechi Oluchi "Ebere" Eze ( ə-BAIR-ə-tchee EZ-ə ; born 29 June 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Premier League club Arsenal and the England national team.
Eberechi Eze.note: The key to Eze is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. There is another side to his game: he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Eberechi Eze.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Eberechi Eze踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。到了另一个比赛环节，他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Elliot Anderson.name: Elliot Anderson
Elliot Anderson.summary: Elliot Junior Anderson (born 6 November 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Nottingham Forest and the England national team.
Elliot Anderson.note: For Anderson, the foundation is carrying momentum through open midfield. Look first at how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Separately, look at how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Elliot Anderson.noteZh: 看Elliot Anderson的作用，关键是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Ezri Konsa.name: Ezri Konsa

Joris Kayembe.name: Joris Kayembe
Joris Kayembe.summary: Joris Kayembe Ditu (born 8 August 1994) is a professional footballer who as a winger plays for Belgian Pro League club Genk. Born in Belgium and formerly a Belgium international in a pair of friendly matches, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Joris Kayembe.note: Kayembe stands out for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. Also look at how Kayembe sends the ball into the attacking area from a wide position.
Joris Kayembe.noteZh: 观察Joris Kayembe时，可以先看第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。另一个比赛细节是他会在边路位置把球送入进攻区域。

Jose Manuel Lopez.name: Jose Manuel Lopez
Jose Manuel Lopez.summary: José Manuel Alberto López (born 6 December 2000), commonly known as Flaco López, is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a striker for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Palmeiras and the Argentina national team.
Jose Manuel Lopez.note: For López, the foundation is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. Look first at how he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. For a wider picture, notice whether he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Jose Manuel Lopez.noteZh: 理解José Manuel López，要先看让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。下一个值得观察的问题是，他是否会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Juan Musso.name: Juan Musso
Juan Musso.summary: Juan Agustín Musso (born 6 May 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Argentina national team.
Juan Musso.note: Watch Musso for command of the crowded space around goal. The clearest example is how he attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. Also notice how Musso sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Juan Musso.noteZh: 看Juan Musso的作用，关键是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Kevin Danso.name: Kevin Danso
Kevin Danso.summary: Kevin Danso (born 19 September 1998) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Austria national team.
Kevin Danso.note: Watch Danso for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. The clearest example is how he turns early and protects the route toward goal. A separate clue is how Danso meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Kevin Danso.noteZh: 理解Kevin Danso，要先看第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Lautaro Martinez.name: Lautaro Martinez
Lautaro Martinez.summary: Lautaro Javier Martínez (born 22 August 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for Serie A club Inter Milan, which he captains, and the Argentina national team.
Lautaro Martinez.note: Martínez's signature is the timing of his run across the nearest defender. Watch how he attacks the near-post lane before the marker can turn. At another point in the move, he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Lautaro Martinez.noteZh: 抢到近门柱身前的跑动时机构成Lautaro Martínez踢法的核心。他会在盯防者转身前冲向近门柱线路。除此之外，值得留意他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Leandro Paredes.name: Leandro Paredes
Leandro Paredes.summary: Leandro Daniel Paredes (Spanish pronunciation: [leˈandɾo paˈɾeðes]; born 29 June 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Argentine Primera División club Boca Juniors and the Argentina national team.
Leandro Paredes.note: The key to Paredes is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. In another phase, Paredes varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Leandro Paredes.noteZh: 观察Leandro Paredes时，可以先看压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。另一个比赛细节是他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Lionel Mpasi.name: Lionel Mpasi
Lionel Mpasi.summary: Lionnel Mpasi Nzau (born 1 August 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Le Havre. Born in France, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Lionel Mpasi.note: Watch Mpasi for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. The clearest example is how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Elsewhere, Mpasi keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements.
Lionel Mpasi.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友构成Lionel Mpasi踢法的核心。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。除此之外，值得留意他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。

Lisandro Martinez.name: Lisandro Martinez
Lisandro Martinez.summary: Lisandro Martínez (born 18 January 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Manchester United and the Argentina national team. Nicknamed "The Butcher", he is known for his aggressive style of play.
Lisandro Martinez.note: What separates Martínez is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Martínez holds the route into the box until support arrives. Away from that action, he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Lisandro Martinez.noteZh: 看Lisandro Martínez的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Marco Friedl.name: Marco Friedl
Marco Friedl.summary: Marco Friedl (born 16 March 1998) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen, which he captains, and the Austria national team.
Marco Friedl.note: Friedl's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. He also steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself.
Marco Friedl.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Marco Friedl踢法的关键。先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Marcos Senesi.name: Marcos Senesi
Marcos Senesi.summary: Marcos Nicolás Senesi Barón (born 10 May 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Bournemouth and the Argentina national team. He will join Tottenham Hotspur on 1 July 2026.
Marcos Senesi.note: Senesi stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Senesi also holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Marcos Senesi.noteZh: 用传球的力度和角度移动防线是理解Marcos Senesi踢法的关键。先看他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。到了另一个比赛环节，他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Matthieu Epolo.name: Matthieu Epolo
Matthieu Epolo.summary: Matthieu Epolo Luka (born 15 January 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Belgian Pro League club Standard Liège. Born in Belgium, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Matthieu Epolo.note: The key to Epolo is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. In another phase, Epolo restarts play toward an available teammate.
Matthieu Epolo.noteZh: Matthieu Epolo的比赛建立在提前站位后的快速反应之上。首先看他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。另一个方面是他会把球重新交给可以接应的队友。

Meschack Elia.name: Meschack Elia
Meschack Elia.summary: Meschak Elia Lina (born 6 August 1997) is a Congolese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Süper Lig club Alanyaspor and the DR Congo national team.
Meschack Elia.note: What separates Elia is explosive speed once open grass appears. Elia changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. In another phase of play, he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Meschack Elia.noteZh: 看Meschak Elia的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Michael Gregoritsch.name: Michael Gregoritsch
Michael Gregoritsch.summary: Michael Gregoritsch (born 18 April 1994) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club FC Augsburg, and the Austria national team.
Michael Gregoritsch.note: For Gregoritsch, the foundation is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Look first at how he shifts onto his left foot and shoots with little backlift. A separate point is how he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Michael Gregoritsch.noteZh: 看Michael Gregoritsch的作用，关键是防线重组前制造干净射门。他会把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Michael Svoboda.name: Michael Svoboda
Michael Svoboda.summary: Michael Svoboda (born 15 October 1998) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Venezia and the Austria national team.
Michael Svoboda.note: The key to Svoboda is dealing with aerial balls in his defensive area. He moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle. In another phase, Svoboda moves the ball to the next available teammate without holding it.
Michael Svoboda.noteZh: 处理防守区域内的高空球构成Michael Svoboda踢法的核心。他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。除此之外，值得留意他会不拖延持球，把球交给下一名可接应的队友。

Nahuel Molina.name: Nahuel Molina
Nahuel Molina.summary: Nahuel Molina Lucero (born 6 April 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right-back for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Argentina national team.
Nahuel Molina.note: For Molina, the foundation is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Look first at how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Separately, look at how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Nahuel Molina.noteZh: 理解Nahuel Molina，要先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Nathanael Mbuku.name: Nathanael Mbuku
Nathanael Mbuku.summary: Nathanaël Mbuku Wa Mbuku (born 16 March 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 2 club Montpellier, on loan from Bundesliga club Augsburg. Born in France, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Nathanael Mbuku.note: The key to Mbuku is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. In another phase, Mbuku shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Nathanael Mbuku.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Nathanaël Mbuku踢法的关键。先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。到了另一个比赛环节，他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ngalayel Mukau.name: Ngalayel Mukau
Ngalayel Mukau.summary: Ngal'ayel Mukau (born 3 November 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Lille. Born in Belgium, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Ngalayel Mukau.note: Mukau's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Watch how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Away from that moment, he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Ngalayel Mukau.noteZh: Ngal'ayel Mukau的比赛建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢之上。首先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个方面是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Nico Gonzalez.name: Nico Gonzalez
Nico Gonzalez.summary: Nicolás Iván González (Spanish pronunciation: [nikoˈlas iˈβaŋ ɡonˈsales]; born 6 April 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger for La Liga club Atlético Madrid, on loan from Serie A club Juventus, and the Argentina national team.
Nico Gonzalez.note: What separates González is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. González moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. In another phase of play, he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Nico Gonzalez.noteZh: Nico González最鲜明的特点是防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。一个直接线索是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。另一个独立细节是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Nico Paz.name: Nico Paz
Nico Paz.summary: Nicolás Paz Martínez (born 8 September 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Serie A club Como. Born in Spain, he plays for the Argentina national team.
Nico Paz.note: Paz stands out for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Also look at how Paz opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Nico Paz.noteZh: Nico Paz的优势在于等防守者注意力转移后再启动。最直接的表现是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Nicolas Otamendi.name: Nicolas Otamendi
Nicolas Otamendi.summary: Nicolás Hernán Gonzalo Otamendi (born 12 February 1988) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Primeira Liga club Benfica, which he captains, and the Argentina national team.
Nicolas Otamendi.note: The key to Otamendi is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. There is another side to his game: he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Nicolas Otamendi.noteZh: 看Nicolás Otamendi的作用，关键是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Nicolas Seiwald.name: Nicolas Seiwald
Nicolas Seiwald.summary: Nicolas Seiwald (born 4 May 2001) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Austria national team.
Nicolas Seiwald.note: Seiwald stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. In a separate phase, Seiwald holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Nicolas Seiwald.noteZh: 最能体现Nicolas Seiwald特点的是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。这一点直接体现在他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。除此之外，他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Nicolas Tagliafico.name: Nicolas Tagliafico
Nicolas Tagliafico.summary: Nicolás Alejandro Tagliafico (born 31 August 1992) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Ligue 1 club Lyon and the Argentina national team.
Nicolas Tagliafico.note: Watch Tagliafico for staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. The clearest example is how he checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. Elsewhere, Tagliafico gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Nicolas Tagliafico.noteZh: Nicolás Tagliafico的比赛建立在球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动之上。首先看他如何在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。另一个方面是他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Patrick Pentz.name: Patrick Pentz
Patrick Pentz.summary: Patrick Pentz (born 2 January 1997) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Danish Superliga club Brøndby and the Austria national team.
Patrick Pentz.note: What separates Pentz is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Pentz keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Away from that action, he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Patrick Pentz.noteZh: Patrick Pentz最鲜明的特点是危险出现前组织好队友。一个直接线索是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。另一个独立细节是他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Patrick Wimmer.name: Patrick Wimmer
Patrick Wimmer.summary: Patrick Wimmer (born 30 May 2001) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Bundesliga club Hoffenheim and the Austria national team.
Patrick Wimmer.note: Wimmer stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. In a separate phase, Wimmer pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Patrick Wimmer.noteZh: 看Patrick Wimmer的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Paul Wanner.name: Paul Wanner
Paul Wanner.summary: Paul Wanner (German pronunciation: [paʊ̯l ˈvanɐ]; born 23 December 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Eredivisie club PSV.
Paul Wanner.note: For Wanner, the foundation is receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. Look first at how he opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. Beyond the first action, he plays the available pass with his left foot.
Paul Wanner.noteZh: 最能体现Paul Wanner特点的是狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。这一点直接体现在他会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。除此之外，他也会用左脚送出眼前可行的传球。

Philipp Lienhart.name: Philipp Lienhart
Philipp Lienhart.summary: Philipp Lienhart (born 11 July 1996) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club SC Freiburg and the Austria national team.
Philipp Lienhart.note: Lienhart's signature is reading the next phase before the space fully opens. Watch how he adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. At another point in the move, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Philipp Lienhart.noteZh: Philipp Lienhart最鲜明的特点是空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段。一个直接线索是他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。另一个独立细节是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Phillip Mwene.name: Phillip Mwene
Phillip Mwene.summary: Phillipp Mwene (born 29 January 1994) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a full-back for Bundesliga club Mainz 05 and the Austria national team.
Phillip Mwene.note: The key to Mwene is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. In another phase, Mwene changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Phillip Mwene.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机构成Phillipp Mwene踢法的核心。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，值得留意他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Rodrigo De Paul.name: Rodrigo De Paul
Rodrigo De Paul.summary: Rodrigo Javier De Paul (Spanish pronunciation: [roˈðɾiɣo ðe pol]; born 24 May 1994) is an Argentine professional football player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Inter Miami and the Argentina national team.
Rodrigo De Paul.note: De Paul's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Watch how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Another detail is how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Rodrigo De Paul.noteZh: 看Rodrigo De Paul的作用，关键是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Samuel Moutoussamy.name: Samuel Moutoussamy
Samuel Moutoussamy.summary: Samuel Albert Alain Arcade Moutoussamy (born 12 August 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Greek Super League club Atromitos. Born in France, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Samuel Moutoussamy.note: Watch Moutoussamy for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. The clearest example is how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Elsewhere, Moutoussamy plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Samuel Moutoussamy.noteZh: 理解Samuel Moutoussamy，要先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Simon Banza.name: Simon Banza
Simon Banza.summary: Simon Bokoté Banza (born 13 August 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for UAE Pro League side Al Jazira. Born in France, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Simon Banza.note: For Banza, the foundation is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Look first at how he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. Beyond that, watch how he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Simon Banza.noteZh: 观察Simon Banza时，可以先看防线重组前制造干净射门。他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。另一个比赛细节是他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Stefan Posch.name: Stefan Posch
Stefan Posch.summary: Stefan Posch (German pronunciation: [ˈʃtɛfa (ː)n ˈpɔʃ]; born 14 May 1997) is an Austrian footballer who plays as a right-back or centre-back for Bundesliga club Mainz 05, on loan from Serie A club Como, and the Austria national team.
Stefan Posch.note: Watch Posch for closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. The clearest example is how he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. In a different phase, Posch protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Stefan Posch.noteZh: 观察Stefan Posch时，可以先看封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者。他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。另一个比赛细节是他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Steve Kapuadi.name: Steve Kapuadi
Steve Kapuadi.summary: Steve Nkanu Kapuadi (born 30 April 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Polish club Widzew Łódź. Born in France, he represents the DR Congo national team.
Steve Kapuadi.note: Kapuadi stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. In a separate phase, Kapuadi moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Steve Kapuadi.noteZh: 观察Steve Kapuadi时，可以先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个比赛细节是他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Theo Bongonda.name: Theo Bongonda
Theo Bongonda.summary: Théo Bongonda Mbul'Ofeko Batombo (born 20 November 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger. Born in Belgium, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Theo Bongonda.note: Watch Bongonda for explosive speed once open grass appears. The clearest example is how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Elsewhere, Bongonda pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Theo Bongonda.noteZh: 看到空当后的爆发速度是理解Théo Bongonda踢法的关键。先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。到了另一个比赛环节，他会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Thiago Almada.name: Thiago Almada
Thiago Almada.summary: Thiago Ezequiel Almada (born 26 April 2001) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Argentina national team.
Thiago Almada.note: What separates Almada is taking responsibility for attacking dead-ball deliveries. Almada serves corners and free kicks into the attacking area. Away from that action, he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Thiago Almada.noteZh: 负责进攻定位球的输送构成Thiago Almada踢法的核心。他会把角球和任意球送入进攻区域。除此之外，值得留意他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Timothy Fayulu.name: Timothy Fayulu
Timothy Fayulu.summary: Timothy Bruce Fayulu (born 24 July 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Armenian Premier League club FC Noah on loan from Sion. Born in Switzerland, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Timothy Fayulu.note: Fayulu's signature is command of the crowded space around goal. Watch how he attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. Away from that moment, he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Timothy Fayulu.noteZh: 最能体现Timothy Fayulu特点的是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。这一点直接体现在他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。除此之外，他也会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Valentin Barco.name: Valentin Barco
Valentin Barco.summary: Valentín Barco (born 23 July 2004), better known as Colo Barco, is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg and the Argentina national team.
Valentin Barco.note: Barco stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Barco also looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Valentin Barco.noteZh: Valentín Barco的优势在于比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。最直接的表现是他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Xaver Schlager.name: Xaver Schlager
Xaver Schlager.summary: Xaver Schlager (German pronunciation: [ˈksaːvɐ ˈʃlaːɡɐ]; born 28 September 1997) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Austria national team.
Xaver Schlager.note: For Schlager, the foundation is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Look first at how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Beyond that, watch how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Xaver Schlager.noteZh: Xaver Schlager的优势在于选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。最直接的表现是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Sasa Kalajdzic.name: Sasa Kalajdzic
Sasa Kalajdzic.summary: Saša Kalajdžić (Serbian Cyrillic: Саша Калајџић; born 7 July 1997) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Austrian Bundesliga club LASK on loan from EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Austria national team.
Sasa Kalajdzic.note: Kalajdžić's signature is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. Watch how he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. Separately, he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Sasa Kalajdzic.noteZh: 最能体现Saša Kalajdžić特点的是让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。这一点直接体现在他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。除此之外，他也会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Abdulla Abdullaev.name: Abdulla Abdullaev
Abdulla Abdullaev.summary: Abdulla Abdullaev (Uzbek: Abdulla Qahramonjon oʻgʻli Abdullayev, Абдулла Қаҳрамонжон ўғли Абдуллаев; born 1 September 1997) is an Uzbek professional footballer who plays for Dibba and the Uzbekistan national team.
Abdulla Abdullaev.note: Watch Abdullaev for reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. The clearest example is how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. Also watch how Abdullaev moves the ball to the next available teammate without holding it.
Abdulla Abdullaev.noteZh: 对抗后球权松动时的第一反应是理解Abdulla Abdullaev踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。到了另一个比赛环节，他会不拖延持球，把球交给下一名可接应的队友。

Achref Abada.name: Achref Abada
Achref Abada.summary: Achref Abada (Arabic: أشرف عبادة; born 15 June 1999) is an Algerian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1 club USM Alger and the Algeria national team.
Achref Abada.note: For Abada, the foundation is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Look first at how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Also watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Achref Abada.noteZh: Achref Abada的比赛建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢之上。首先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个方面是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Adil Boulbina.name: Adil Boulbina
Adil Boulbina.summary: Adil Boulbina (Arabic: عادل بولبينة; born May 2, 2003) is an Algerian professional footballer who plays as forward for Al-Duhail and the Algeria national team.
Adil Boulbina.note: The key to Boulbina is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. One more thing to notice is how Boulbina shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Adil Boulbina.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Adil Boulbina踢法的关键。先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。到了另一个比赛环节，他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Aissa Mandi.name: Aissa Mandi
Aissa Mandi.summary: Aïssa Mandi (Arabic: عيسى ماندي; born 22 October 1991) is a professional footballer who plays for Ligue 1 club Lille. Born in France, he plays for the Algeria national team.
Aissa Mandi.note: Mandi stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Another aspect is how Mandi slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Aissa Mandi.noteZh: 观察Aïssa Mandi时，可以先看用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。另一个比赛细节是他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Akmal Mozgovoy.name: Akmal Mozgovoy
Akmal Mozgovoy.summary: Akmal Vladimirovich Mozgovoy (Uzbek: Akmal Mozgovoy; born 2 April 1999) is an Uzbek professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Pakhtakor and the Uzbekistan national team.
Akmal Mozgovoy.note: The key to Mozgovoy is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. Elsewhere in the game, Mozgovoy turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Akmal Mozgovoy.noteZh: 理解Akmal Mozgovoy，要先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Alvaro Montero.name: Alvaro Montero
Alvaro Montero.summary: Álvaro David Montero Perales (born 29 March 1995) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Argentine Primera División club Vélez Sarsfield, on loan from Categoría Primera A club Millonarios and the Colombia national team.
Alvaro Montero.note: Montero stands out for staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. Also look at how Montero leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Alvaro Montero.noteZh: Álvaro Montero最鲜明的特点是射门方向明确前保持身体平衡。一个直接线索是他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。另一个独立细节是他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Andres Gomez.name: Andres Gomez
Andres Gomez.summary: Carlos Andrés Gómez Hinestroza (born 12 September 2002) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Vasco da Gama and the Colombia national team.
Andres Gomez.note: Watch Gómez for explosive speed once open grass appears. The clearest example is how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Also watch how Gómez draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Andres Gomez.noteZh: 观察Andrés Gómez时，可以先看看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个比赛细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Anis Hadj Moussa.name: Anis Hadj Moussa
Anis Hadj Moussa.summary: Anis Hadj Moussa (born 11 February 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Eredivisie club Feyenoord. Born in France, he represents the Algeria national team.
Anis Hadj Moussa.note: Moussa's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Away from that moment, he pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Anis Hadj Moussa.noteZh: Anis Hadj Moussa最鲜明的特点是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。一个直接线索是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个独立细节是他会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Avazbek Ulmasaliyev.name: Avazbek Ulmasaliyev
Avazbek Ulmasaliyev.summary: Avazbek Alisher oʻgʻli Oʻlmasaliyev (born 27 March 2000) is an Uzbekistani professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for AGMK and the Uzbekistan national team.
Avazbek Ulmasaliyev.note: Watch Ulmasaliyev for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Also watch how Ulmasaliyev turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Avazbek Ulmasaliyev.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机是理解Avazbek Ulmasaliyev踢法的关键。先看他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。到了另一个比赛环节，他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Azizbek Amonov.name: Azizbek Amonov
Azizbek Amonov.summary: Azizbek Amonov (Uzbek Cyrillic: Азизбек Аскарович Аманов; born 30 October 1997) is an Uzbek footballer who plays as a midfielder for Buxoro and the Uzbekistan national team.
Azizbek Amonov.note: Amonov's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Watch how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Another detail is how he pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Azizbek Amonov.noteZh: 最能体现Azizbek Amonov特点的是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。这一点直接体现在他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。除此之外，他也会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Azizjon Ganiev.name: Azizjon Ganiev
Azizjon Ganiev.summary: Azizjon Ganiev (Uzbek: Azizjon Alijon oʻgʻli Gʻaniyev, Азизжон Алижон ўғли Ғаниев; born 22 February 1998) is an Uzbek footballer who plays as a midfielder for Al Bataeh and the Uzbekistan national team.
Azizjon Ganiev.note: What separates Ganiev is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Ganiev plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. In another phase of play, he varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Azizjon Ganiev.noteZh: 观察Aziz Ganiev时，可以先看用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。另一个比赛细节是他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Behruzjon Karimov.name: Behruzjon Karimov
Behruzjon Karimov.summary: Bekhruzdjon Karimov (Uzbek: Behruzjon Karimov, Беҳрузжон Каримов; born 7 August 2007) is an Uzbekistani professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Uzbekistan Super League club Surkhon, and the Uzbekistan national team.
Behruzjon Karimov.note: Karimov stands out for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. A different detail is how Karimov plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Behruzjon Karimov.noteZh: 对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择是理解Bekhruz Karimov踢法的关键。先看他如何先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。到了另一个比赛环节，他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Bernardo Silva.name: Bernardo Silva
Bernardo Silva.summary: Bernardo Mota Veiga de Carvalho e Silva (Portuguese pronunciation: [bɨɾˈnaɾðu ˈsilvɐ]; born 10 August 1994) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Manchester City and the Portugal national team.
Bernardo Silva.note: Watch Silva for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. The clearest example is how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Elsewhere, Silva angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Bernardo Silva.noteZh: 压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定是理解Bernardo Silva踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Botirali Ergashev.name: Botirali Ergashev
Botirali Ergashev.summary: Botirali Ergashev (Uzbek Cyrillic: Ботирали Эргашев; born 23 June 1995) is an Uzbekistani footballer who plays for Neftchi Fergana and Uzbekistan national team.
Botirali Ergashev.note: For Ergashev, the foundation is command of the crowded space around goal. Look first at how he attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. Also watch how he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Botirali Ergashev.noteZh: 最能体现Botirali Ergashev特点的是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。这一点直接体现在他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。除此之外，他也会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Camilo Vargas.name: Camilo Vargas
Camilo Vargas.summary: Camilo Andrés Vargas Gil (born 9 March 1989) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Liga MX club Atlas and the Colombia national team.
Camilo Vargas.note: What separates Vargas is staying ready through long quiet spells. Vargas keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. Also note how he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Camilo Vargas.noteZh: 理解Camilo Vargas，要先看长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Cucho Hernandez.name: Cucho Hernandez
Cucho Hernandez.summary: Juan Camilo Hernández Suárez (born 20 April 1999), known simply as Cucho Hernández, is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a striker or winger for La Liga club Real Betis and the Colombia national team.
Cucho Hernandez.note: Hernández stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. Hernández also angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Cucho Hernandez.noteZh: 理解Cucho Hernández，要先看防线重组前制造干净射门。他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

David Ospina.name: David Ospina
David Ospina.summary: David Ospina Ramírez (born 31 August 1988) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Colombia national team.
David Ospina.note: The key to Ospina is staying ready through long quiet spells. He keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. There is another side to his game: he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
David Ospina.noteZh: 观察David Ospina时，可以先看长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。另一个比赛细节是他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Davinson Sanchez.name: Davinson Sanchez
Davinson Sanchez.summary: Davinson Sánchez Mina (born 12 June 1996) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club Galatasaray and the Colombia national team.
Davinson Sanchez.note: For Sánchez, the foundation is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. Look first at how he turns early and closes the runner before the box. A separate point is how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Davinson Sanchez.noteZh: 防线暴露后的回追速度构成Davinson Sánchez踢法的核心。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。除此之外，值得留意他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Deiver Machado.name: Deiver Machado
Deiver Machado.summary: Deiver Andrés Machado Mena (born 2 September 1993) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for Ligue 2 club Nantes and the Colombia national team.
Deiver Machado.note: Machado's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Separately, he sends the ball into the attacking area from a wide position.
Deiver Machado.noteZh: Deiver Machado最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会在边路位置把球送入进攻区域。

Diogo Costa.name: Diogo Costa
Diogo Costa.summary: Diogo Meireles da Costa (European Portuguese pronunciation: [diˈoɣu ˈkɔʃtɐ]; born 19 September 1999) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Primeira Liga club Porto, which he captains, and the Portugal national team.
Diogo Costa.note: For Costa, the foundation is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Look first at how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Beyond the first action, he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Diogo Costa.noteZh: 看Diogo Costa的作用，关键是危险出现前组织好队友。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Diogo Dalot.name: Diogo Dalot
Diogo Dalot.summary: José Diogo Dalot Teixeira (European Portuguese pronunciation: [diˈoɣu ðaˈlo]; born 18 March 1999) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a full-back or a wing-back for Premier League club Manchester United and the Portugal national team.
Diogo Dalot.note: Dalot's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He also changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Diogo Dalot.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机构成Diogo Dalot踢法的核心。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，值得留意他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Dostonbek Khamdamov.name: Dostonbek Khamdamov
Dostonbek Khamdamov.summary: Dostonbek Khamdamov (Uzbek: Dostonbek Xurshid oʻgʻli Xamdamov, Достонбек Хуршид ўғли Хамдамов; born 24 July 1996) is an Uzbek professional footballer who plays as a winger for Pakhtakor and the Uzbekistan national team.
Dostonbek Khamdamov.note: What separates Khamdamov is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. Khamdamov moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. Also note how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Dostonbek Khamdamov.noteZh: 观察Dostonbek Khamdamov时，可以先看防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。另一个比赛细节是他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Fares Chaibi.name: Fares Chaibi
Fares Chaibi.summary: Farès Chaïbi (Arabic: فارس شايبي; born 28 November 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt. Born in France, he plays for the Algeria national team.
Fares Chaibi.note: Watch Chaïbi for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. The clearest example is how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. A separate clue is how Chaïbi serves corners and free kicks into the attacking area.
Fares Chaibi.noteZh: 理解Farès Chaïbi，要先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会把角球和任意球送入进攻区域。

Fares Ghedjemis.name: Fares Ghedjemis
Fares Ghedjemis.summary: Farès Ghedjemis (born 6 September 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Frosinone. Born in France, he plays for the Algeria national team.
Fares Ghedjemis.note: The key to Ghedjemis is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Elsewhere in the game, Ghedjemis moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Fares Ghedjemis.noteZh: 观察Farès Ghedjemis时，可以先看看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个比赛细节是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Farrukh Sayfiev.name: Farrukh Sayfiev
Farrukh Sayfiev.summary: Farrukh Sayfiyev (Uzbek: Farrux Sayfiyev, Фаррух Сайфиев; born 17 January 1991) is an Uzbek professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Neftchi Fergana and the Uzbekistan national team.
Farrukh Sayfiev.note: Watch Sayfiyev for closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. The clearest example is how he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. A separate clue is how Sayfiyev slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Farrukh Sayfiev.noteZh: 封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者构成Farrukh Sayfiyev踢法的核心。他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。除此之外，值得留意他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Francisco Conceicao.name: Francisco Conceicao
Francisco Conceicao.summary: Francisco "Chico" Fernandes da Conceição (Portuguese pronunciation: [fɾɐ̃ˈsiʃku kõsɐjˈsɐ̃w̃]; born 14 December 2002) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Serie A club Juventus and the Portugal national team.
Francisco Conceicao.note: Conceição stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Another aspect is how Conceição pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Francisco Conceicao.noteZh: 看Francisco Conceição的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Francisco Trincao.name: Francisco Trincao
Francisco Trincao.summary: Francisco António Machado Mota de Castro Trincão (European Portuguese: [fɾɐ̃ˈsiʃku tɾĩˈkɐ̃w̃]; born 29 December 1999) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a winger for Primeira Liga club Sporting CP and the Portugal national team.
Francisco Trincao.note: What separates Trincão is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Trincão draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. At another point, he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Francisco Trincao.noteZh: 最能体现Francisco Trincão特点的是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。这一点直接体现在他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。除此之外，他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Goncalo Guedes.name: Goncalo Guedes
Goncalo Guedes.summary: Gonçalo Manuel Ganchinho Guedes (European Portuguese: [ɡõˈsalu ˈɣɛðɨʃ]; born 29 November 1996) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for La Liga club Real Sociedad and the Portugal national team.
Goncalo Guedes.note: Guedes stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. A different detail is how Guedes uses a clean first touch to open a shooting lane from distance.
Goncalo Guedes.noteZh: 观察Gonçalo Guedes时，可以先看有目的地进行无球移动。他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。另一个比赛细节是他会用干净的第一脚触球打开远射线路。

Goncalo Inacio.name: Goncalo Inacio

Goncalo Inacio.note: Watch Inácio for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. The clearest example is how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes. A separate question is whether Inácio waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Goncalo Inacio.noteZh: Gonçalo Inácio的优势在于用传球的力度和角度移动防线。最直接的表现是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。想看得更完整，还要观察他是否会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Goncalo Ramos.name: Goncalo Ramos

Goncalo Ramos.note: Ramos is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Goncalo Ramos.noteZh: 拉莫斯的特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住，也会在接近持球人时调整逼抢路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Gustavo Puerta.name: Gustavo Puerta

Gustavo Puerta.note: Puerta stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Also look at how Puerta plays forward toward an available runner when the opening appears.

Hicham Boudaoui.noteZh: 压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定构成Hicham Boudaoui踢法的核心。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。除此之外，值得留意他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。
